name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  Algebra.FiniteType ℂ A ∧ IsDomain A ∧ ringKrullDim A = 4 ∧
  Nonempty (Polynomial A ≃ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin 5) ℂ) ∧
  ¬ Nonempty (A ≃ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℂ)

name: OAI.PermanentBorder.HasBorderDeterminant
head: def HasBorderDeterminant {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] (n : ℕ) (p : Poly σ) : Prop
text:
def HasBorderDeterminant {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] (n : ℕ) (p : Poly σ) : Prop :=
  0 < n ∧ ∃ (A₀ : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (A : ℕ → σ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
    ∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ, Tendsto
      (fun j => (affineMatrixPolynomial n (A₀ j) (A j)).coeff d)
      atTop (𝓝 (p.coeff d))

name: OAI.PermanentBorder.HasExactDeterminant
head: def HasExactDeterminant {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] (n : ℕ) (p : Poly σ) : Prop

name: OAI.LittleFinitistic.InjectivesGenerate
head: def InjectivesGenerate : Prop
text:
def InjectivesGenerate : Prop :=
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
  ∀ (P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))),
    P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms → P.IsTriangulated →
    (∀ I : Type u, P.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)) →
    (∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u} A), Injective M →
      P ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj M)) →
    ∀ X, P X

name: OAI.MaximalSeshadri.Geometry.LineBundle.IsAmple
head: def LineBundle.IsAmple (L : LineBundle X) : Prop
text:
def LineBundle.IsAmple (L : LineBundle X) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : X) (V : X.Opens), x ∈ V → ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧
    ∃ s : GlobalSections X (modulePow X L.sheaf n),
      x ∈ sectionOpen X s ∧ sectionOpen X s ≤ V ∧ IsAffineOpen (sectionOpen X s)

name: OAI.MaximalSeshadri.Geometry.PresentsPullbackIdeal
head:
def PresentsPullbackIdeal {X Y : Scheme} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (J : LineBundle Y) (ι : J.sheaf ⟶ structureSheaf Y) : Prop
text:
def PresentsPullbackIdeal {X Y : Scheme} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (J : LineBundle Y) (ι : J.sheaf ⟶ structureSheaf Y) : Prop :=
  Mono ι ∧ ∀ (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (e : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
    sectionImageIdeal J ι U.1 = (I.ideal V).map (f.appLE V.1 U.1 e).hom

name: OAI.MaximalSeshadri.Geometry.InvertiblePullbackIdeal
head: def InvertiblePullbackIdeal {X Y : Scheme} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) : Prop
text:
def InvertiblePullbackIdeal {X Y : Scheme} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) : Prop :=
  ∃ (J : LineBundle Y) (ι : J.sheaf ⟶ structureSheaf Y), PresentsPullbackIdeal I f J ι

name: OAI.MaximalSeshadri.Geometry.IsBlowup
head: def IsBlowup {X B : Scheme} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (π : B ⟶ X) : Prop

name: OAI.MaximalSeshadri.Geometry.PointBlowup.BoundaryNef
head:
def PointBlowup.BoundaryNef {S : Surface} {r : ℕ} {p : Configuration S r}
    (B : PointBlowup S r p) (L : LineBundle S.scheme) : Prop
text:
def PointBlowup.BoundaryNef {S : Surface} {r : ℕ} {p : Configuration S r}
    (B : PointBlowup S r p) (L : LineBundle S.scheme) : Prop :=
  ∀ C : IntegralCurve B.surface,
    0 ≤ (moduleCurveDegree B.surface
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback B.projection).obj L.sheaf) C : ℝ) +
      Real.sqrt ((selfIntersection S L : ℝ) / r) *
        ∑ i : Fin r, (curveDegree B.surface (B.exceptionalIdeal i) C : ℝ)

name: OAI.MaximalSeshadri.Geometry.EventualMaximalSeshadri
head: def EventualMaximalSeshadri (S : Surface) (L : LineBundle S.scheme) : Prop
text:
def EventualMaximalSeshadri (S : Surface) (L : LineBundle S.scheme) : Prop :=
  ∃ r₀ : ℕ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, r₀ ≤ r →
    ∃ Z : ℕ → Set (Configuration S r),
      (∀ n, IsClosed (Z n) ∧ Z n ≠ Set.univ) ∧
      (∃ p : Configuration S r, ∀ n, p ∉ Z n) ∧
      ∀ p : Configuration S r, (∀ n, p ∉ Z n) →
        (∃ B : PointBlowup S r p, B.BoundaryNef L) ∧
        seshadriConstant S L r p = Real.sqrt ((selfIntersection S L : ℝ) / r)

name: OAI.Bernoulli.Test
doc: Compactly supported smooth real tests in the open set.
head: def Test {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d)) (φ : Space d → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Test {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d)) (φ : Space d → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ tsupport φ ⊆ D

name: OAI.Bernoulli.WeakGradient
doc: Distributional gradient, tested in every constant direction.
head:
def WeakGradient {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop
text:
def WeakGradient {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop :=
  ∀ φ, Test D φ → ∀ h : Space d,
    (∫ x in D, u x * (fderiv ℝ φ x) h) =
      -(∫ x in D, inner ℝ (G x) h * φ x)

name: OAI.Bernoulli.H1
doc: H¹(D), with its weak gradient.
head:
def H1 {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop
text:
def H1 {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop :=
  MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict D) ∧
  MemLp G 2 (volume.restrict D) ∧ WeakGradient D u G

name: OAI.Bernoulli.H10
doc: H¹₀(D) is H¹-closure of C∞ compactly supported functions. Both L² errors tend to zero. This does not restrict competitors to smooth ones.
head:
def H10 {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop
text:
def H10 {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop :=
  H1 D u G ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ φ : Space d → ℝ,
    Test D φ ∧
    eLpNorm (fun x => u x - φ x) 2 (volume.restrict D) < ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧
    eLpNorm (fun x => G x - gradient φ x) 2 (volume.restrict D) < ENNReal.ofReal ε

name: OAI.Bernoulli.H1Loc
doc: Ballwise H¹_loc, on an open set (balls have compact closure inside D).
head:
def H1Loc {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop
text:
def H1Loc {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d))
    (u : Space d → ℝ) (G : Space d → Space d) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : Space d, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ D →
    H1 (Metric.ball c r) u G

name: OAI.Bernoulli.LocalMinimizer
doc: Full ballwise local comparison. Competitor and gradient are arbitrary Sobolev representatives on the ball, with zero-trace difference.
head: def LocalMinimizer {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d)) (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def LocalMinimizer {d : ℕ} (D : Set (Space d)) (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsOpen D ∧ ∃ G : Space d → Space d,
    H1Loc D u G ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict D, 0 ≤ u x) ∧
    ∀ c : Space d, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ D →
      ∀ (v : Space d → ℝ) (V : Space d → Space d),
        H1 (Metric.ball c r) v V →
        (∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Metric.ball c r), 0 ≤ v x) →
        H10 (Metric.ball c r) (fun x => v x - u x) (fun x => V x - G x) →
        energy (Metric.ball c r) u G ≤ energy (Metric.ball c r) v V

name: OAI.Bernoulli.GlobalMinimizer
doc: Nonnegative global minimizer, with all centers and all positive radii.
head: def GlobalMinimizer {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def GlobalMinimizer {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop :=
  LocalMinimizer Set.univ u

name: OAI.Bernoulli.OneHomogeneous
head: def OneHomogeneous {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def OneHomogeneous {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, u (r • x) = r * u x

name: OAI.Bernoulli.Nonzero
head: def Nonzero {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Nonzero {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ¬ (u =ᵐ[volume] fun _ => 0)

name: OAI.Bernoulli.Flat
doc: Flatness is a.e. equality of H¹ representatives.
head: def Flat {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Flat {d : ℕ} (u : Space d → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ e : Space d, ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, u x = max (inner ℝ x e) 0

name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.AdmissibleDensity
doc: Almost-everywhere measurable probability densities between fixed bounds.
head: def AdmissibleDensity (vol : Measure M) (lam cap : ℝ) (rho : M → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.IsOptimalMap
doc: Optimality for the Monge minimization problem.
head: def IsOptimalMap (vol : Measure M) (rho0 rho1 : M → ℝ) (T : M → M) : Prop
text:
def IsOptimalMap (vol : Measure M) (rho0 rho1 : M → ℝ) (T : M → M) : Prop :=
  Measurable T ∧ Measure.map T (densityMeasure vol rho0) = densityMeasure vol rho1 ∧
  ∀ S : M → M, Measurable S →
    Measure.map S (densityMeasure vol rho0) = densityMeasure vol rho1 →
    (∫ x, cost x (T x) * rho0 x ∂vol) ≤
      (∫ x, cost x (S x) * rho0 x ∂vol)

name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.BiHolderEstimate
doc: The two global estimates have the very same exponent and constant.
head: def BiHolderEstimate (alpha C : ℝ) (T : M ≃ₜ M) : Prop

name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.IsGeodesicWithInitialData
doc: Complete affinely parametrized geodesic with prescribed initial tangent. Local metric minimization is an intrinsic definition of Riemannian geodesics.
head:
def IsGeodesicWithInitialData (x : M) (v : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) x)
    (gamma : ℝ → M) : Prop
text:
def IsGeodesicWithInitialData (x : M) (v : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) x)
    (gamma : ℝ → M) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) ∞ gamma ∧
  (⟨gamma 0, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) gamma 0 (1 : ℝ)⟩ :
    TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) M) = ⟨x, v⟩ ∧
  ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ eps : ℝ, 0 < eps ∧
    ∀ s u : ℝ, |s - t| < eps → |u - t| < eps →
      dist (gamma s) (gamma u) = |s - u| * ‖v‖

name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.WeakMTW
doc: Weak MTW only at interior velocities and only for orthogonal test vectors.
head: def WeakMTW : Prop
text:
def WeakMTW : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : M) (p : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) x), p ∈ injectivityDomain x →
    ∀ xi eta : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) x,
      inner ℝ xi eta = 0 → 0 ≤ mtw x p xi eta

name: OAI.FiniteFactor.IsBrownMeasure
head: def IsBrownMeasure (τ : ProductOp → ℂ) (T : ProductOp) (μ : Measure ℂ) : Prop
text:
def IsBrownMeasure (τ : ProductOp → ℂ) (T : ProductOp) (μ : Measure ℂ) : Prop :=
  let translate := fun (Hilbert : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup Hilbert]
    [NormedSpace ℂ Hilbert] (operator : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) (scalar : ℂ) =>
      operator - algebraMap ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) scalar
  IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsCompact μ.support ∧
  ∀ z : ℂ, FugledeKadisonDeterminant τ
    (@translate (SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate) productHilbertGroup
      (@InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace ℂ (SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate) Complex.instRCLike
        (@NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
          (SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate) productHilbertGroup)
        productHilbertInner) T z) = expLogPotential μ z

name: OAI.FiniteFactor.ProductBrownClaim
head: def ProductBrownClaim : Prop
text:
def ProductBrownClaim : Prop :=
  ∀ (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ),
    IsBrownMeasure sourceVacuumFunctional
      (sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg) (Measure.dirac 0)

name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.Harmonic
head: def Harmonic (γ : R3 → ℝ) (u : H1) : Prop
text:
def Harmonic (γ : R3 → ℝ) (u : H1) : Prop :=
  ∀ h : H1, h ∈ H10 → energy γ u h = 0

name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.IsDirichletToNeumann
head: def IsDirichletToNeumann (γ : R3 → ℝ) (Λ : DNOperator) : Prop
text:
def IsDirichletToNeumann (γ : R3 → ℝ) (Λ : DNOperator) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : TraceSpace, ∃ u : H1,
    trace u = f ∧ Harmonic γ u ∧
    (∀ u' : H1, trace u' = f → Harmonic γ u' → u' = u) ∧
    ∀ v : H1, Λ f (trace v) = energy γ u v

name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.EqualOneNearBoundary
head: def EqualOneNearBoundary (γ : R3 → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def EqualOneNearBoundary (γ : R3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < 3 ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, r < ‖x‖ → γ x = 1

name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (γ₀ γ₁ : R3 → ℝ) (c C : ℝ) (Λ : DNOperator),
    0 < c ∧ c < C ∧
    Measurable γ₀ ∧ Measurable γ₁ ∧
    MemLp γ₀ ∞ ballMeasure ∧ MemLp γ₁ ∞ ballMeasure ∧
    (∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c ≤ γ₀ x ∧ γ₀ x ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c ≤ γ₁ x ∧ γ₁ x ≤ C) ∧
    EqualOneNearBoundary γ₀ ∧ EqualOneNearBoundary γ₁ ∧
    0 < ballMeasure {x | γ₀ x ≠ γ₁ x} ∧
    IsDirichletToNeumann γ₀ Λ ∧ IsDirichletToNeumann γ₁ Λ

name: OAI.Cotype.KConvex
head: def KConvex : Prop
text:
def KConvex : Prop := ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → E),
  cubeL2 E (radProjection E f) ≤ K * cubeL2 E f

name: OAI.Cotype.HasCotype
head: def HasCotype (q : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def HasCotype (q : ℝ) : Prop := 2 ≤ q ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → E),
    (∑ i, ‖x i‖ ^ q) ^ (1 / q) ≤ C * cubeL2 E (rademacherSum E x)

name: OAI.Cotype.FiniteCotype
head: def FiniteCotype : Prop
text: def FiniteCotype : Prop := ∃ q : ℝ, HasCotype E q

name: OAI.Cotype.ApproximationProperty
head: def ApproximationProperty : Prop
text:
def ApproximationProperty : Prop := ∀ (M : Set E), IsCompact M →
  ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ S : E →L[ℝ] E,
    FiniteDimensional ℝ (LinearMap.range S.toLinearMap) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ M, ‖S x - x‖ < δ

name: OAI.Cotype.MainTarget
head: def MainTarget [CompleteSpace E] [Nontrivial E] : Prop

name: OAI.CoulombAtom.FormAdmissible
head: def FormAdmissible {N : ℕ} (ψ : FormVector N) : Prop
text:
def FormAdmissible {N : ℕ} (ψ : FormVector N) : Prop :=
  (∀ s, MemLp (ψ.value s) 2) ∧
  (∀ s i a, MemLp (ψ.gradient s i a) 2) ∧
  (∀ s i a (φ : Configuration N → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
    (∫ x, ψ.value s x * Complex.ofReal (lineDeriv ℝ φ x (direction i a))) =
      -(∫ x, ψ.gradient s i a x * (φ x : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) s, ∀ᵐ x,
    ψ.value (s ∘ π) (x ∘ π) =
      (((Equiv.Perm.sign π : ℤ) : ℂ) * ψ.value s x)) ∧
  (∑ s : Spins N, ∫ x, ‖ψ.value s x‖ ^ 2) = 1 ∧
  (∀ s i, Integrable (fun x => ‖ψ.value s x‖ ^ 2 / ‖x i‖)) ∧
  (∀ s i j, i ≠ j →
    Integrable (fun x => ‖ψ.value s x‖ ^ 2 / ‖x i - x j‖))

name: OAI.CoulombAtom.TFAdmissible
head: def TFAdmissible (M : ℝ) (ρ : Space → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def TFAdmissible (M : ℝ) (ρ : Space → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ᵐ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧ Integrable ρ ∧ (∫ x, ρ x) = M ∧
  Integrable (fun x => ρ x ^ (5 / 3 : ℝ)) ∧
  Integrable (fun x => ρ x / ‖x‖) ∧ Integrable (directIntegrand ρ)

name: OAI.CoulombAtom.TFCharacterization
head: def TFCharacterization (a : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.CoulombAtom.JointLimit
head: def JointLimit (a : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def JointLimit (a : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m Z : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ j, 1 ≤ m j ∧ m j < Z j) →
    Tendsto m atTop atTop →
    Tendsto (fun j => (Z j : ℝ) / (m j : ℝ)) atTop atTop →
    Tendsto (fun j => ionization (m j) (Z j) / (m j : ℝ) ^ (7 / 3 : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 a)

name: OAI.CoulombAtom.IteratedLimits
head: def IteratedLimits (a : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IteratedLimits (a : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (limsup (ionization m) atTop) / (m : ℝ) ^ (7 / 3 : ℝ))
    atTop (𝓝 a) ∧
  Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (liminf (ionization m) atTop) / (m : ℝ) ^ (7 / 3 : ℝ))
    atTop (𝓝 a)

name: OAI.CoulombAtom.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ TFCharacterization a ∧ JointLimit a ∧ IteratedLimits a

name: OAI.NeutralAtom.HasWeakGradient
head: def HasWeakGradient {n : ℕ} (ψ : Wavefunction n) (g : Gradient n) : Prop
text:
def HasWeakGradient {n : ℕ} (ψ : Wavefunction n) (g : Gradient n) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ i a (φ : Configuration n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
    (∫ x, (fderiv ℝ φ x (coordinateDirection i a) : ℂ) * ψ σ x) =
      -(∫ x, (φ x : ℂ) * g σ i a x)

name: OAI.NeutralAtom.IsAntisymmetric
head: def IsAntisymmetric {n : ℕ} (ψ : Wavefunction n) : Prop
text:
def IsAntisymmetric {n : ℕ} (ψ : Wavefunction n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (σ : Spins n),
    (fun x : Configuration n => ψ (σ ∘ p) (x ∘ p)) =ᵐ[volume]
      (fun x => (((Equiv.Perm.sign p : ℤ) : ℂ)) * ψ σ x)

name: OAI.NeutralAtom.FormDomain
head: def FormDomain {n : ℕ} (ψ : Wavefunction n) (g : Gradient n) : Prop
text:
def FormDomain {n : ℕ} (ψ : Wavefunction n) (g : Gradient n) : Prop :=
  IsAntisymmetric ψ ∧ HasWeakGradient ψ g ∧
  (∀ σ, MemLp (ψ σ) 2 volume) ∧
  (∀ σ i a, MemLp (g σ i a) 2 volume) ∧
  (∀ σ i, Integrable (fun x : Configuration n => ‖x i‖⁻¹ * ‖ψ σ x‖ ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ σ i j, i < j →
    Integrable (fun x : Configuration n => ‖x i - x j‖⁻¹ * ‖ψ σ x‖ ^ 2))

name: OAI.NeutralAtom.IsNormalizedGroundState
head: def IsNormalizedGroundState (Z : ℕ) (ψ : Wavefunction Z) : Prop
text:
def IsNormalizedGroundState (Z : ℕ) (ψ : Wavefunction Z) : Prop :=
  ∃ g : Gradient Z, FormDomain ψ g ∧ normSquared ψ = 1 ∧
    ∀ (χ : Wavefunction Z) (h : Gradient Z),
      FormDomain χ h → normSquared χ = 1 → energy Z ψ g ≤ energy Z χ h

name: OAI.Problem356.IsThreeCoupling
head: def IsThreeCoupling (mu : Measure E3) (pi : Measure Triple) : Prop
text:
def IsThreeCoupling (mu : Measure E3) (pi : Measure Triple) : Prop :=
  IsProbabilityMeasure pi ∧
    Measure.map tripleFst pi = mu ∧
    Measure.map tripleSnd pi = mu ∧
    Measure.map tripleThd pi = mu

name: OAI.Problem356.Preserves
head: def Preserves (mu : Measure E3) (T : E3 → E3) : Prop
text:
def Preserves (mu : Measure E3) (T : E3 → E3) : Prop :=
  Measurable T ∧ Measure.map T mu = mu

name: OAI.Problem356.IsSmoothCompactProbabilityDensity
head: def IsSmoothCompactProbabilityDensity (rho : E3 → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsSmoothCompactProbabilityDensity (rho : E3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, 0 ≤ rho x) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) rho ∧
    HasCompactSupport rho ∧
    ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) (fun x : E3 => Real.sqrt (rho x)) ∧
    HasCompactSupport (fun x : E3 => Real.sqrt (rho x)) ∧
    (∫ x : E3, rho x ∂(volume : Measure E3)) = 1

name: OAI.Problem356.KantorovichAttained
head: def KantorovichAttained (mu : Measure E3) : Prop
text:
def KantorovichAttained (mu : Measure E3) : Prop :=
  ∃ pi : Measure Triple,
    IsThreeCoupling mu pi ∧
      (∫⁻ t, coulombCost t ∂pi) = kantorovichValue mu

name: OAI.Problem356.NoMongeOptimizer
head: def NoMongeOptimizer (mu : Measure E3) : Prop
text:
def NoMongeOptimizer (mu : Measure E3) : Prop :=
  ∀ T2 T3 : E3 → E3,
    Preserves mu T2 → Preserves mu T3 →
      kantorovichValue mu < graphCost mu T2 T3

name: OAI.Problem356.FiniteMongeApproximation
head: def FiniteMongeApproximation (mu : Measure E3) : Prop
text:
def FiniteMongeApproximation (mu : Measure E3) : Prop :=
  ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
    ∃ T2 T3 : E3 → E3,
      Preserves mu T2 ∧
      Preserves mu T3 ∧
      graphCost mu T2 T3 < ⊤ ∧
      graphCost mu T2 T3 ≤
        kantorovichValue mu + ENNReal.ofReal epsilon

name: OAI.Problem356.HasCoulombCounterexample
head: def HasCoulombCounterexample (rho : E3 → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def HasCoulombCounterexample (rho : E3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsSmoothCompactProbabilityDensity rho ∧
    IsProbabilityMeasure (densityMeasure rho) ∧
    kantorovichValue (densityMeasure rho) < ⊤ ∧
    KantorovichAttained (densityMeasure rho) ∧
    NoMongeOptimizer (densityMeasure rho)

name: OAI.Problem356.HasFullCoulombConclusion
head: def HasFullCoulombConclusion (rho : E3 → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def HasFullCoulombConclusion (rho : E3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  HasCoulombCounterexample rho ∧
    mongeValue (densityMeasure rho) =
      kantorovichValue (densityMeasure rho) ∧
    FiniteMongeApproximation (densityMeasure rho)

name: OAI.ExactModuli.Cofinite
doc: Closed linear subspaces of finite codimension.
head: def Cofinite (F : Submodule ℝ X) : Prop
text:
def Cofinite (F : Submodule ℝ X) : Prop :=
  IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)

name: OAI.ExactModuli.EquivalentNorm
doc: Two-sided comparison makes this seminorm a genuine norm equivalent to the original.
head: def EquivalentNorm (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop
text:
def EquivalentNorm (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ ∀ x, a * ‖x‖ ≤ N x ∧ N x ≤ b * ‖x‖

name: OAI.ExactModuli.AUC
head: def AUC (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop
text:
def AUC (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < oneSidedModulus N t

name: OAI.ExactModuli.Daugavet
doc: Every rank-one operator has the form `ell.smulRight v`.
head: def Daugavet (X : Type uX) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] : Prop

name: OAI.ExactModuli.MeasurePrecompactBall
doc: Finite covers of the entire unit ball in convergence-in-measure distance.
head: def MeasurePrecompactBall (E : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ 1 μ)) : Prop

name: OAI.ExactModuli.UnitSliceProperty
doc: Every nonempty unit-ball slice contains an almost antipodal unit vector.
head: def UnitSliceProperty (X : Type uX) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] : Prop
text:
def UnitSliceProperty (X : Type uX) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : X), ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (α : ℝ),
    (∃ u : X, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧ α < ell u) →
    ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y : X, ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ α < ell y ∧ 2 - ρ ≤ ‖w + y‖

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.UniversalBound
head: def UniversalBound (c : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def UniversalBound (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n m d : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < m →
    ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
      (B : Fin (d + 1) → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ‖tensorEvaluation A B‖ ≤ c * rangeMaximum A B

name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.HasWeakGradient
doc: Distributional first derivatives represented by a vector-valued function.
head: def HasWeakGradient (f : Plane → ℝ) (g : Plane → Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.InW11Loc
doc: Local W^(1,1), expressed using the same distributional gradient convention.
head: def InW11Loc (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.EndpointStatement
doc: Exact endpoint, including finiteness before passing to the real representative. Quantifying the input gradient makes the norm bound independent of a choice of representative of its weak derivatives.
head: def EndpointStatement : Prop
text:
def EndpointStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ (f : Plane → ℝ) (g : Plane → Plane),
      Integrable f → Integrable g → HasWeakGradient f g →
      (∀ᵐ x, maximal f x ≠ ⊤) ∧
      LocallyIntegrable (maximalReal f) ∧
      InW11Loc (maximalReal f) ∧
      ∃ G : Plane → Plane, Integrable G ∧
        HasWeakGradient (maximalReal f) G ∧ gradientNorm G ≤ C * gradientNorm g

name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.InW11
doc: Real inhomogeneous W^(1,1) on the whole plane.
head: def InW11 (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def InW11 (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Integrable f ∧ ∃ g : Plane → Plane, Integrable g ∧ HasWeakGradient f g

name: OAI.FiniteFactor.HasScalarCenter
doc: A concrete factor has scalar center.
head: def HasScalarCenter (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop
text:
def HasScalarCenter (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ M, (∀ b ∈ M, a * b = b * a) → ∃ z : ℂ, a = z • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)

name: OAI.FiniteFactor.IsFiniteAlgebra
doc: Finiteness: every isometry in the algebra is unitary.
head: def IsFiniteAlgebra (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop
text:
def IsFiniteAlgebra (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ M, star v * v = 1 → v * star v = 1

name: OAI.FiniteFactor.HasNoMinimalProjection
doc: No nonzero projection is minimal, excluding matrix factors.
head: def HasNoMinimalProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop

name: OAI.FiniteFactor.HasSeparablePredual
doc: A separable Banach space whose dual is conjugate-linearly isometric to M.
head: def HasSeparablePredual (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop
text:
def HasSeparablePredual (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop :=
  ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup E) (_ : NormedSpace ℂ E)
    (_ : CompleteSpace E) (_ : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E),
    Nonempty (StrongDual ℂ E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] M.toStarSubalgebra)

name: OAI.FiniteFactor.MainTarget
head: def MainTarget : Prop
text:
def MainTarget : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : Type u) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup H) (_ : InnerProductSpace ℂ H)
    (_ : CompleteSpace H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H),
    HasScalarCenter M ∧ IsFiniteAlgebra M ∧ HasNoMinimalProjection M ∧
    HasSeparablePredual M ∧
    ∃ T : H →L[ℂ] H, T ∈ M ∧ T ≠ 0 ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖T ^ n‖ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ M, IsStarProjection p → (1 - p) * T * p = 0 → p = 0 ∨ p = 1

name: OAI.FiniteEntropySeparation.FreeSubalgebras
head:
def FreeSubalgebras {ι : Type} {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (τ : TracialVector M)
    (A : ι → Subalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Prop
text:
def FreeSubalgebras {ι : Type} {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (τ : TracialVector M)
    (A : ι → Subalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → ∀ (j : Fin k → ι) (a : Fin k → H →L[ℂ] H),
    (∀ r, a r ∈ A (j r)) → (∀ r, trace τ (a r) = 0) →
    (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 1 < k),
      j ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩ ≠ j ⟨r + 1, hr⟩) →
    trace τ (List.ofFn a).prod = 0

name: OAI.FiniteEntropySeparation.FreeStandardNoise
head:
def FreeStandardNoise {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (τ : TracialVector M) {n : ℕ}
    (X S : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) : Prop
text:
def FreeStandardNoise {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (τ : TracialVector M) {n : ℕ}
    (X S : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) : Prop :=
  (∀ i k, trace τ (S i ^ k) =
    if Even k then (catalan (k / 2) : ℂ) else 0) ∧
  FreeSubalgebras τ (fun j : Option (Fin n) => match j with
    | none => Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range X)
    | some i => Algebra.adjoin ℂ {S i})

name: OAI.FiniteEntropySeparation.ConjugateSystem
head:
def ConjugateSystem {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (τ : TracialVector M) {n : ℕ}
    (X : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : Fin n → H) : Prop
text:
def ConjugateSystem {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (τ : TracialVector M) {n : ℕ}
    (X : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : Fin n → H) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, ξ i ∈ polynomialL2 τ X ∧ ∀ w : List (Fin n),
    inner ℂ (ξ i) (wordEval X w τ.vacuum) = derivativeMoment τ X i w

name: OAI.FreeGroupFactorMain.HasNormalTracialIso

name: OAI.GroupRingDeterminant.IsRegularOperator
doc: Exact coordinate specification of the bounded left-regular operator of A.
text:
def IsRegularOperator {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G))
    (T : Hilbert G n →L[ℂ] Hilbert G n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (ξ : Hilbert G n) (i : Fin n) (h : G),
    (T ξ) (i, h) = ∑ j : Fin n,
      (A i j).coeff.sum fun g z => (z : ℂ) * ξ (j, g⁻¹ * h)

name: OAI.GroupRingDeterminant.MainStatement
doc: An integral group-ring matrix with rational and bounded inverses and determinant in (0, 1).
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : Group.FG G) (n : ℕ),
    1 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G))
      (T : Hilbert G n →L[ℂ] Hilbert G n),
      IsUnit (rationalMatrix A) ∧ IsRegularOperator A T ∧ IsUnit T ∧
        0 < fkDet T ∧ fkDet T < 1

name: OAI.HardSphere.Condensation
head: def Condensation : Prop
text:
def Condensation : Prop :=
  ∃ ε₀ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧
    ∀ (a ρ : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < ρ → ρ * a ^ 3 < ε₀ →
    ∀ (N : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ → Length) (hN : ∀ k, 0 < N k),
      Tendsto N atTop atTop →
      Tendsto (fun k ↦ (L k).val) atTop atTop →
      Tendsto (fun k ↦ (N k : ℝ) / (L k).val ^ 3) atTop (𝓝 ρ) →
      ∀ (Ψ : (k : ℕ) → Jet (N k) (L k)),
        (∀ k, IsGroundVector (N k) (L k) a (Ψ k)) →
        c₀ ≤ Filter.liminf (fun k ↦ occupation (hN k) (Ψ k).1) atTop

name: OAI.HenonLaneEmden.Subcritical
head: def Subcritical (n : ℕ) (p q A B : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Subcritical (n : ℕ) (p q A B : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ((n : ℝ) + A) / (p + 1) + ((n : ℝ) + B) / (q + 1) > (n : ℝ) - (1 + 1)

name: OAI.Brennan.UnivalentOn
head: def UnivalentOn (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) : Prop
text:
def UnivalentOn (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f U ∧ Set.InjOn f U

name: OAI.Brennan.Schlicht
head: def Schlicht (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def Schlicht (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  UnivalentOn f disk ∧ f 0 = 0 ∧ deriv f 0 = 1

name: OAI.Brennan.SphericalBoundaryNontrivial
head: def SphericalBoundaryNontrivial (W : Set ℂ) : Prop
text:
def SphericalBoundaryNontrivial (W : Set ℂ) : Prop :=
  Set.Nontrivial (frontier (((↑) : ℂ → OnePoint ℂ) '' W))

name: OAI.Brennan.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, Schlicht f →
    ∀ r : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
      integralMean f (-2) r ≤ C * (1 - r) ^ (-1 - ε)) ∧
  spectrum (-2) = 1 ∧
  (∀ W : Set ℂ, IsOpen W → IsConnected W → SimplyConnectedSpace W →
    SphericalBoundaryNontrivial W → ∀ φ : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ φ W → Set.BijOn φ W disk →
      ∀ s : ℝ, 4 / 3 < s → s < 4 →
        IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv φ z‖ ^ s) W volume) ∧
  (∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, UnivalentOn f disk → ∀ t : ℝ,
    -2 < t → t < 2 / 3 →
      IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv f z‖ ^ t) disk volume)

name: OAI.TraceCone.CuntzBelow
head: def CuntzBelow (a b : Positive A) : Prop
text:
def CuntzBelow (a b : Positive A) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ v : A, ‖star v * b.1 * v - a.1‖ < ε

name: OAI.DirectComparison.StrictComparison
head: def StrictComparison (A : Type*) [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] : Prop

name: OAI.DirectComparison.UniformGamma
head:
def UniformGamma (A : Type) [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]
    [Nontrivial A] [Nonempty (TracialState A)] (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop
text:
def UniformGamma (A : Type) [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]
    [Nontrivial A] [Nonempty (TracialState A)] (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ p : Fin m → FamilyUltrapower (fun t : TracialState A => t) U,
    (∀ i, IsStarProjection (p i)) ∧ (∑ i, p i)=1 ∧
    (∀ i (a : A), Commute (p i) (familyUltrapowerMap (fun t : TracialState A => t) U a)) ∧
    ∀ i (a : A) (s : ℕ → TracialState A),
      (familyLimitTrace (fun t : TracialState A => t) U s).functional
          (familyUltrapowerMap (fun t : TracialState A => t) U a*p i) =
        (1/(m:ℂ))*(familyLimitTrace (fun t : TracialState A => t) U s).functional
          (familyUltrapowerMap (fun t : TracialState A => t) U a)

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.WeightBounded
head: def WeightBounded (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : Prop
text:
def WeightBounded (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ a : Positive A, ‖a.1‖ ≤ 1 → τ a ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞)

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.WeightDenselyFinite
head: def WeightDenselyFinite (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : Prop
text:
def WeightDenselyFinite (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : Prop :=
  Dense {a : Positive A | τ a < ∞}

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.TopologicallySimple
head: def TopologicallySimple (A : Type*) [NonUnitalNormedRing A] : Prop
text:
def TopologicallySimple (A : Type*) [NonUnitalNormedRing A] : Prop :=
  ∀ I : TwoSidedIdeal A, IsClosed (I : Set A) → I=⊥ ∨ I=⊤

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.Projectionless
head: def Projectionless (A : Type*) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] : Prop
text:
def Projectionless (A : Type*) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] : Prop :=
  ∀ p : A, IsStarProjection p → p=0

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.AllDenselyFiniteTracesBounded
head:
def AllDenselyFiniteTracesBounded (A : Type*) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
    [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] : Prop
text:
def AllDenselyFiniteTracesBounded (A : Type*) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
    [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] : Prop :=
  ∀ τ : ExtendedTrace A, WeightDenselyFinite τ → WeightBounded τ

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.StrictComparison
head: def StrictComparison (hcone : AllDenselyFiniteTracesBounded A) : Prop
text:
def StrictComparison (hcone : AllDenselyFiniteTracesBounded A) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b : Positive (MatrixLimit A), b.1 ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (τ : ExtendedTrace A) (hτ : WeightDenselyFinite τ),
      (boundedStabilized τ (hcone τ hτ)).rank b=1 →
      (boundedStabilized τ (hcone τ hτ)).rank a<1) → CuntzBelow a b

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.UniformGamma
head:
def UniformGamma (A : Type) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]
    [Nontrivial A] [Nonempty (NormalizedTrace A)] (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop
text:
def UniformGamma (A : Type) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]
    [Nontrivial A] [Nonempty (NormalizedTrace A)] (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ p : Fin m → FamilyUltrapower (fun t : NormalizedTrace A => t.unitized) U,
    (∀ i, IsStarProjection (p i)) ∧ (∑ i, p i)=1 ∧
    (∀ i (a : A), Commute (p i) (familyUltrapowerMap (fun t : NormalizedTrace A => t.unitized) U (Unitization.inr a))) ∧
    ∀ i (a : A) (s : ℕ → NormalizedTrace A),
      (familyLimitTrace (fun t : NormalizedTrace A => t.unitized) U s).functional
          (familyUltrapowerMap (fun t : NormalizedTrace A => t.unitized) U (Unitization.inr a)*p i) =
        (1/(m:ℂ))*(familyLimitTrace (fun t : NormalizedTrace A => t.unitized) U s).functional
          (familyUltrapowerMap (fun t : NormalizedTrace A => t.unitized) U (Unitization.inr a))

name: OAI.NonunitalGamma.StablyProjectionless
head: def StablyProjectionless (A : Type) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] : Prop
text:
def StablyProjectionless (A : Type) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] : Prop :=

name: OAI.NuclearUnitization.IsNuclear

name: OAI.LeanBlast.KLS.IsTestFunction
doc: The exact compactly supported smooth real test-function class.
head: def IsTestFunction {n : ℕ} (f : Space n → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsTestFunction {n : ℕ} (f : Space n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.KLS.PoincareBound
doc: Direct Poincare inequality, avoiding an infimum convention for the constant.
head: def PoincareBound {n : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Space n)) (C : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def PoincareBound {n : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Space n)) (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : Space n → ℝ, IsTestFunction f → variance μ f ≤ C * dirichletEnergy μ f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.KLS.KLSStatement
doc: The full dimension-free statement: one constant works for every dimension, every isotropic log-concave density, and every smooth compactly supported test.
head: def KLSStatement : Prop
text:
def KLSStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
    ∀ ρ : Space n → ℝ, IsLogConcaveDensity ρ → IsIsotropic (densityMeasure ρ) →
      PoincareBound (densityMeasure ρ) C

name: OAI.Laughlin.Antisymmetric
head: def Antisymmetric {N Q : ℕ} (ψ : State N Q) : Prop
text:
def Antisymmetric {N Q : ℕ} (ψ : State N Q) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Fin N), i ≠ j → ∀ a, ψ (a ∘ Equiv.swap i j) = -ψ a

name: OAI.Laughlin.MainTarget
head: def MainTarget : Prop
text:
def MainTarget : Prop :=
  ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N →
    ∀ ψ : State N (3*(N-1)), Antisymmetric ψ →
      (1/100 : ℝ) * distanceToLaughlinSq ψ ≤ energy ψ

name: OAI.LaughlinFock.FockInequality
head: def FockInequality (Q : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def FockInequality (Q : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (hamiltonian Q * hamiltonian Q - γ • hamiltonian Q).PosSemidef

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.IsNegativeEigenfunction
doc: Weak eigenfunction at the negative energy -k².
head: def IsNegativeEigenfunction (W : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ) (u : H1) : Prop
text:
def IsNegativeEigenfunction (W : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ) (u : H1) : Prop :=
  0 < k ∧ ∀ v : H1, schrodingerForm W v u = -(k ^ 2 : ℝ) * l2Pairing v u

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.IsOrthonormalFamily
head: def IsOrthonormalFamily {N : ℕ} (u : Fin N → H1) : Prop
text:
def IsOrthonormalFamily {N : ℕ} (u : Fin N → H1) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, l2Pairing (u i) (u j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.Admissible
head: def Admissible (γ : ℝ) (W : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Admissible (γ : ℝ) (W : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ᵐ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ W x) ∧ MemLp W (ENNReal.ofReal (γ + 1 / 2)) volume

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MainClaim
doc: The full spectral bound, optimal constants, and attainment at the explicit potential.
head: def MainClaim : Prop
text:
def MainClaim : Prop :=
  ∀ γ : ℝ, 1 / 2 < γ → γ < 3 / 2 →
    (∀ W : ℝ → ℝ, Admissible γ W →
      negativeMoment γ W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ) * potentialMass γ W) ∧
    optimalConstant γ = ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ) ∧
    oneStateConstant γ = ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ) ∧
    Admissible γ (equalityPotential γ) ∧
    0 < potentialMass γ (equalityPotential γ) ∧
    negativeMoment γ (equalityPotential γ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ) * potentialMass γ (equalityPotential γ)

name: OAI.QuinticLienard.IsSolution
head: def IsSolution (F : Polynomial ℝ) (z : ℝ → Plane) : Prop
text:
def IsSolution (F : Polynomial ℝ) (z : ℝ → Plane) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt z (vectorField F (z t)) t

name: OAI.QuinticLienard.IsPeriodicOrbit
head: def IsPeriodicOrbit (F : Polynomial ℝ) (C : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def IsPeriodicOrbit (F : Polynomial ℝ) (C : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ (z : ℝ → Plane) (T : ℝ),
    IsSolution F z ∧ 0 < T ∧ Function.Periodic z T ∧
    (∃ s t : ℝ, z s ≠ z t) ∧ C = Set.range z

name: OAI.QuinticLienard.IsLimitCycle
head: def IsLimitCycle (F : Polynomial ℝ) (C : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def IsLimitCycle (F : Polynomial ℝ) (C : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  IsPeriodicOrbit F C ∧
    ∃ U : Set Plane, IsOpen U ∧ C ⊆ U ∧
      ∀ C' : Set Plane, IsPeriodicOrbit F C' → C' ⊆ U → C' = C

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.ContainsLinearCopy
head:
def ContainsLinearCopy (E : Type uE) (F : Type uF) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] : Prop
text:
def ContainsLinearCopy (E : Type uE) (F : Type uF) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] : Prop :=
  ∃ (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (a : ℝ), 0 < a ∧ ∀ x : E, a * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x‖

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.MainClaim
head: def MainClaim : Prop
text:
def MainClaim : Prop :=
  ∃ X Y : SeparableRealBanach,
    ∃ Ψ : X.Carrier ≃ Y.Carrier,
      (∀ s t : X.Carrier,
        (4 / 21 : ℝ) * ‖s - t‖ ≤ ‖Ψ s - Ψ t‖ ∧
        ‖Ψ s - Ψ t‖ ≤ (76 / 25 : ℝ) * ‖s - t‖) ∧
      IsEmpty (X.Carrier ≃L[ℝ] Y.Carrier) ∧
      Nonempty (C0L2 →ₗᵢ[ℝ] X.Carrier) ∧
      ¬ ContainsLinearCopy C0L2 Y.Carrier

name: OAI.DiscreteFree.HasAP
head: def HasAP (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] : Prop
text:
def HasAP (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] : Prop :=
  ∀ C : Set X, IsCompact C → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ T : X →L[ℝ] X, Module.Finite ℝ (LinearMap.range T.toLinearMap) ∧
      ∃ η : ℝ, η < ε ∧ ∀ u ∈ C, ‖T u - u‖ ≤ η

name: OAI.DiscreteFree.BlockStatement
head: def BlockStatement : Prop
text:
def BlockStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∃ (M : Type) (d : MetricSpace M) (o : M),
    letI := d
    Countable M ∧ (∀ x y : M, x ≠ y → 1 ≤ dist x y) ∧
      (∀ x y : M, dist x y ≤ blockBound p) ∧
      ∃ A : Finset M, o ∈ A ∧ ∀ T : FreeSpace o →L[ℝ] FreeSpace o,
        Module.Finite ℝ (LinearMap.range T.toLinearMap) → ‖T‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) →
          ∃ a ∈ A, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖T (delta o a) - delta o a‖

name: OAI.DiscreteFree.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (M : Type) (d : MetricSpace M) (o : M),
    letI := d
    Countable M ∧ (∀ x y : M, x ≠ y → 1 ≤ dist x y) ∧
      (¬ Bornology.IsBounded (Set.univ : Set M)) ∧
      (¬ ProperSpace M) ∧ HasAP (FreeSpace o) ∧
      ∀ Λ : ℝ, 1 ≤ Λ → ¬ HasBAP (FreeSpace o) Λ

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.IsRealSigning
doc: Real signs in every consecutive degree 0,...,N-1.
head: def IsRealSigning {N : ℕ} (ε : Fin N → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsRealSigning {N : ℕ} (ε : Fin N → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, ε k = -1 ∨ ε k = 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N →
    ∃ ε : Fin N → ℝ, IsRealSigning ε ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖littlewoodValue ε z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * Real.sqrt N

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.GoodDimension
doc: The universal property used in the definition of d_p(n,D).
head: def GoodDimension (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (D : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def GoodDimension (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (D : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ω : Type u) (mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω) (μ : @Measure Ω mΩ)
    (x : Fin n → @Lp Ω ℝ mΩ _ (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ),
    Function.Injective x →
    ∃ (y : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s ∧
      ∀ i j, s * ‖x i - x j‖ ≤ coordinateDistance p (y i) (y j) ∧
        coordinateDistance p (y i) (y j) ≤ D * s * ‖x i - x j‖

name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.manuscript_finite_strip_geometry
head:
theorem manuscript_finite_strip_geometry (A : J → I → ℝ)
    (hRank : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (measurementLinear A)) = Fintype.card I)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    IsOpen (stripDomain A) ∧
    (0 : (I → ℝ) × (I → ℝ)) ∈ stripDomain A ∧
    (∀ z ∈ stripDomain A, (∀ j, inverseF (stripCoordinate A z j) ^ m = 0) ↔ z = 0) ∧
    deriv inverseF 0 ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ z : (I → ℝ) × (I → ℝ),
      (∀ j, (deriv inverseF 0 * stripCoordinate A z j) ^ m = 0) ↔ z = 0) ∧
    (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R < 1 →
      IsCompact (closure {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z < R}) ∧
      closure {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z < R} ⊆ stripDomain A) ∧
    IsOpen {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z < 1}

name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.manuscript_strip_regular_exhaustion
doc: The rank and exponent hypotheses yield an increasing regular exhaustion with compact boundaries, without a regular-value premise.
head:
theorem manuscript_strip_regular_exhaustion (A : J → I → ℝ)
    (hRank : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (measurementLinear A)) = Fintype.card I)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    StrictMono stripRegularLevel ∧
    (∀ k, stripRegularLevel k ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    Tendsto stripRegularLevel atTop (𝓝 1) ∧
    (∀ k z, z ∈ stripDomain A → stripTau A m z = stripRegularLevel k →
      Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (stripTau A m) z)) ∧
    (∀ k, IsCompact {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z = stripRegularLevel k}) ∧
    (∀ k, frontier {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z < stripRegularLevel k} =
      {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z = stripRegularLevel k}) ∧
    (⋃ k, {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z < stripRegularLevel k}) =
      {z | z ∈ stripDomain A ∧ stripTau A m z < 1}

name: OAI.Problem326.IsGlobalForwardSolution
text:
def IsGlobalForwardSolution {d : ℕ} (N : ReactionNetwork d)
    (κ : Reaction N → ℝ) (x0 : Fin d → ℝ)

text:
def IsForwardSolutionOn {d : ℕ} (N : ReactionNetwork d)

    (x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ)) : Prop :=

name: OAI.Problem326.IsForwardInvariant
head:
def IsForwardInvariant {d : ℕ} (N : ReactionNetwork d)
    (κ : Reaction N → ℝ) (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) : Prop
text:
def IsForwardInvariant {d : ℕ} (N : ReactionNetwork d)
    (κ : Reaction N → ℝ) (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ z, z ∈ K →
    (∃ x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ), IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ z x) ∧
    ∀ (T : ℝ) (x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ)), 0 ≤ T →
      IsForwardSolutionOn N κ z T x →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, x t ∈ K) ∧
      ∃ xg : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ),
        IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ z xg ∧
        Set.EqOn xg x (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T)

name: OAI.CurrentKS.GoodOutput
head: def GoodOutput (x : Input) (bits : List Bool) : Prop
text:
def GoodOutput (x : Input) (bits : List Bool) : Prop :=
  bits.length = x.N ∧ opNorm (signedSum x bits) ≤ 40 * Real.sqrt (opNorm (variance x))

name: OAI.CurrentKS.DeterministicRankOneSigning
head: def DeterministicRankOneSigning : Prop

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.Covers
head:
def Covers {ι : Type u} {M : ℕ} (A B : Set (RealSpace ι))
    (centers : Fin M → RealSpace ι) : Prop

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.Coverable
head: def Coverable {ι : Type u} (A B : Set (RealSpace ι)) : Prop
text:
def Coverable {ι : Type u} (A B : Set (RealSpace ι)) : Prop :=

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.HasSpectralSupport
head: def HasSpectralSupport (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (I : Set ℝ) (h : H) : Prop
text:
def HasSpectralSupport (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (I : Set ℝ) (h : H) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ, (∀ u ∈ I, f u = 0) → D.calculus f h = 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.ScalarCentralizer
head: def ScalarCentralizer (S : StandardModularData H) : Prop

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RecoveryConclusion
head:
def RecoveryConclusion (S : StandardModularData H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (s : ℝ) (delta : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def RecoveryConclusion (S : StandardModularData H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (s : ℝ) (delta : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (nj : ℕ → ℕ) (_ : StrictMono nj) (v : ℕ → (H →L[ℂ] H)) (C eta : ℝ),
    0 < eta ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, v j ∈ S.M ∧ ‖v j‖ ≤ C ∧ eta ≤ ‖T (v j S.xi)‖ ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s - 4 * delta (nj j)) (s + 4 * delta (nj j)))
        (v j S.xi)

name: OAI.MumfordShah.CompactlyContained
head: def CompactlyContained (S V : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def CompactlyContained (S V : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  IsCompact (closure S) ∧ closure S ⊆ V

name: OAI.MumfordShah.HasWeakGradientOn
head: def HasWeakGradientOn (u : Plane → ℝ) (m : Plane → Plane) (U : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def HasWeakGradientOn (u : Plane → ℝ) (m : Plane → Plane) (U : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∀ ψ : Plane → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ U →
    ∀ a : Plane,
      (∫ x in U, u x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) =
        -(∫ x in U, inner ℝ (m x) a * ψ x)

name: OAI.MumfordShah.SobolevOn
head: def SobolevOn (u : Plane → ℝ) (m : Plane → Plane) (U : Set Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.MumfordShah.Admissible
head: def Admissible (Ω : Set Plane) (p : Pair) : Prop
text:
def Admissible (Ω : Set Plane) (p : Pair) : Prop :=
  p.K ⊆ Ω ∧ IsClosed {x : Ω | (x : Plane) ∈ p.K} ∧
  lengthMeasure p.K < ⊤ ∧ MemLp p.u 2 (volume.restrict Ω) ∧
  SobolevOn p.u p.grad (Ω \ p.K)

name: OAI.MumfordShah.IsCompactComparison
head: def IsCompactComparison (p q : Pair) (V : Set Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.MumfordShah.AbsoluteMinimizer
head: def AbsoluteMinimizer (Ω : Set Plane) (g : Plane → ℝ) (p : Pair) : Prop
text:
def AbsoluteMinimizer (Ω : Set Plane) (g : Plane → ℝ) (p : Pair) : Prop :=
  Admissible Ω p ∧
  ∀ V : Set Plane, IsOpen V → CompactlyContained V Ω →
    ∀ q : Pair, Admissible Ω q → IsCompactComparison p q V →
      fidelityEnergy g p V ≤ fidelityEnergy g q V

name: OAI.MumfordShah.Reduced
head: def Reduced (Ω K : Set Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.MumfordShah.Rectifiable
head: def Rectifiable (H : Set Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.MumfordShah.GlobalAdmissible
head: def GlobalAdmissible (p : Pair) : Prop
text:
def GlobalAdmissible (p : Pair) : Prop :=
  IsClosed p.K ∧ Rectifiable p.K ∧
    (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → lengthMeasure (p.K ∩ ball (0 : Plane) R) < ⊤) ∧
    ∀ U : Set Plane, IsOpen U → Bornology.IsBounded U →
      SobolevOn p.u p.grad (U \ p.K)

name: OAI.MumfordShah.GlobalAbsoluteMinimizer
head: def GlobalAbsoluteMinimizer (p : Pair) : Prop
text:
def GlobalAbsoluteMinimizer (p : Pair) : Prop :=
  GlobalAdmissible p ∧
  ∀ V : Set Plane, IsOpen V → Bornology.IsBounded V →
    ∀ q : Pair, GlobalAdmissible q → IsCompactComparison p q V →
      homogeneousEnergy p V ≤ homogeneousEnergy q V

name: OAI.MumfordShah.PositivelySeparated
head: def PositivelySeparated (A B : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def PositivelySeparated (A B : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, d ≤ dist a b

name: OAI.MumfordShah.ContainsOpenC1Arc
head: def ContainsOpenC1Arc (A H : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def ContainsOpenC1Arc (A H : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : Set Plane, IsOpen U ∧
  ∃ γ : ℝ → Plane,
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, deriv γ s ≠ 0) ∧
    Topology.IsEmbedding (fun s : Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 => γ s) ∧
    H ∩ U = γ '' Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧ H ∩ U ⊆ A

name: OAI.MumfordShah.CompactPieceExclusion
head: def CompactPieceExclusion : Prop
text:
def CompactPieceExclusion : Prop :=
  ∀ p : Pair, GlobalAbsoluteMinimizer p → IsConnected p.Kᶜ →
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      (∫ x in ball (0 : Plane) R, ‖p.grad x‖ ^ 2) ≤ C * (1 + R)) →
    ¬ ∃ A : Set Plane, IsCompact A ∧ A ⊆ p.K ∧ 0 < lengthMeasure A ∧
      IsClosed (p.K \ A) ∧ PositivelySeparated A (p.K \ A) ∧
      ContainsOpenC1Arc A p.K

name: OAI.MumfordShah.BoundedLipschitzDomain
head: def BoundedLipschitzDomain (Ω : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def BoundedLipschitzDomain (Ω : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  IsOpen Ω ∧ IsConnected Ω ∧ Bornology.IsBounded Ω ∧
    ∀ x ∈ frontier Ω, ∃ R : Plane ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Plane,
      ∃ κ : ℝ → ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∃ r : ℝ,
        0 < r ∧ LipschitzWith C κ ∧ κ 0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ z ∈ ball x r, z ∈ Ω ↔ κ (R (z - x)).re < (R (z - x)).im

name: OAI.MumfordShah.RegularHolderArc
head: def RegularHolderArc (α a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Plane) : Prop
text:
def RegularHolderArc (α a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Plane) : Prop :=
  a < b ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (a - ε) (b + ε))) ∧
  Set.InjOn γ (Icc a b) ∧
  (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, deriv γ s ≠ 0) ∧
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
    ‖deriv γ s - deriv γ t‖ ≤ C * |s - t| ^ α

name: OAI.MumfordShah.InteriorArcModel
head: def InteriorArcModel (K W : Set Plane) (x : Plane) (α : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.MumfordShah.EndpointArcModel
head: def EndpointArcModel (K W : Set Plane) (x : Plane) (α : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.MumfordShah.TripleJunctionModel
head: def TripleJunctionModel (K W : Set Plane) (x : Plane) (α : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def TripleJunctionModel (K W : Set Plane) (x : Plane) (α : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → Plane,
    (∀ i, RegularHolderArc α 0 1 (γ i) ∧ γ i 0 = x) ∧
    K ∩ W = ⋃ i, γ i '' Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      (γ i '' Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∩ (γ j '' Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) = {x}) ∧
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      inner ℝ (deriv (γ i) 0) (deriv (γ j) 0) =
        -(‖deriv (γ i) 0‖ * ‖deriv (γ j) 0‖) / 2

name: OAI.MumfordShah.InteriorLocalModels
head: def InteriorLocalModels (Ω K : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def InteriorLocalModels (Ω K : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ W : Set Plane, IsOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ CompactlyContained W Ω ∧
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧
      (InteriorArcModel K W x α ∨ EndpointArcModel K W x α ∨
        TripleJunctionModel K W x α)

name: OAI.MumfordShah.InteriorRegularity
head: def InteriorRegularity : Prop
text:
def InteriorRegularity : Prop :=
  ∀ Ω : Set Plane, BoundedLipschitzDomain Ω →
    ∀ g : Plane → ℝ, MemLp g ⊤ (volume.restrict Ω) →
      ∀ p : Pair, AbsoluteMinimizer Ω g p → Reduced Ω p.K →
        InteriorLocalModels Ω p.K ∧
          ∀ U : Set Plane, IsOpen U → CompactlyContained U Ω →
            (ComponentsMeeting p.K U).Finite

name: OAI.MUB6.IsHadamard
head: def IsHadamard (H : CMatrix) : Prop

name: OAI.MUB6.Equivalent
doc: Full Hadamard equivalence, with arbitrary unit complex phases.
head: def Equivalent (H K : CMatrix) : Prop
text:
def Equivalent (H K : CMatrix) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r c : Equiv.Perm Coord) (u v : Coord → ℂ),
    (∀ i, Complex.normSq (u i) = 1) ∧ (∀ j, Complex.normSq (v j) = 1) ∧
    ∀ i j, K i j = u i * H (r i) (c j) * v j

name: OAI.MUB6.IsMUBFamily
head: def IsMUBFamily {n : ℕ} (B : Fin n → Basis) : Prop

name: OAI.MUB6.Attainable
head: def Attainable (n : ℕ) : Prop
text: def Attainable (n : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ B : Fin n → Basis, IsMUBFamily B

name: OAI.SharpNodal.MainStatement
head:
def MainStatement (M : Type*) [MetricSpace M] [ChartedSpace Plane M]
    [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, Plane) ∞ M]
    [RiemannianBundle (fun x : M => TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Plane) x)] : Prop
text:
def MainStatement (M : Type*) [MetricSpace M] [ChartedSpace Plane M]
    [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, Plane) ∞ M]
    [RiemannianBundle (fun x : M => TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Plane) x)] : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (u : M → ℝ),
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, Plane) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ u → u ≠ 0 →
    (∀ x, -laplaceBeltrami u x = lam * u x) →
    nodalLength u ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.sqrt lam)

name: OAI.ReflexiveFixedPoints.CanonicallyReflexive
doc: Surjectivity of the canonical map into the continuous bidual.
head: def CanonicallyReflexive : Prop
text:
def CanonicallyReflexive : Prop :=
  Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ X)

name: OAI.ReflexiveFixedPoints.NonexpansiveOn
doc: Nonexpansiveness is measured in the original ambient norm.
head: def NonexpansiveOn (C : Set X) (F : C → C) : Prop
text:
def NonexpansiveOn (C : Set X) (F : C → C) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b : C, ‖(F a : X) - (F b : X)‖ ≤ ‖(a : X) - (b : X)‖

name: OAI.ReflexiveFixedPoints.HasNonexpansiveFixedPointProperty
doc: Every nonexpansive selfmap of every nonempty closed bounded convex set has a fixed point, in the norm already carried by `X`.
head:
def HasNonexpansiveFixedPointProperty (X : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] : Prop
text:
def HasNonexpansiveFixedPointProperty (X : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Set X), C.Nonempty → IsClosed C → Bornology.IsBounded C →
    Convex ℝ C → ∀ F : C → C, NonexpansiveOn C F → ∃ a : C, F a = a

name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.ultraRel
doc: Equality modulo I_omega(B). This is equivalent to norm-null difference.
head: def ultraRel (x y : BoundedSeq B) : Prop
text:
def ultraRel (x y : BoundedSeq B) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun n => x n - y n) (ω : Filter ℕ) (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.IsFree
doc: Freeness: no finite subset of N belongs to the ultrafilter.
head: def IsFree (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop
text:
def IsFree (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ F : Finset ℕ, (F : Set ℕ) ∉ (ω : Filter ℕ)

name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.IsNuclear
doc: Nuclearity in the tensor-norm convention of the tensor-norm formulation. The second C*-algebra need not be unital, nonzero, or separable.
head: def IsNuclear (B : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] : Prop

name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.IsFullGroupAlgebra
doc: The universal property defining the full, not the reduced, group C*-algebra. The dense generation clause makes the intended completion explicit. This is definition data, not a hypothesis silently supplied to the main claim.
head: def IsFullGroupAlgebra (A : UnitalCStar.{u}) (ι : G →* unitary A) : Prop
text:
def IsFullGroupAlgebra (A : UnitalCStar.{u}) (ι : G →* unitary A) : Prop :=
  Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun g => (ι g : A))) : Set A) ∧
  ∀ (D : UnitalCStar.{u}) (ρ : G →* unitary D),
    ∃! φ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D, ∀ g, φ (ι g) = (ρ g : D)

name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.CuntzTwoRelations
doc: The two Cuntz relations, including unit preservation explicitly.
head: def CuntzTwoRelations {D : Type u} [CStarAlgebra D] (s : Fin 2 → D) : Prop
text:
def CuntzTwoRelations {D : Type u} [CStarAlgebra D] (s : Fin 2 → D) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, star (s i) * s i = 1) ∧ ∑ i, s i * star (s i) = 1

name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.IsCuntzTwoAlgebra
doc: The universal nonzero unital C*-algebra on the two Cuntz isometries.
head: def IsCuntzTwoAlgebra (O : UnitalCStar.{u}) (s : Fin 2 → O) : Prop
text:
def IsCuntzTwoAlgebra (O : UnitalCStar.{u}) (s : Fin 2 → O) : Prop :=
  CuntzTwoRelations s ∧
  ∀ (D : UnitalCStar.{u}) (r : Fin 2 → D), CuntzTwoRelations r →
    ∃! φ : O →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D, ∀ i, φ (s i) = r i

name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.MainStatementWithCuntzCorollary
doc: The manuscript's main statement including its explicitly stated O_2 corollary. Both universal C*-algebras must be constructed to prove this.
head: def MainStatementWithCuntzCorollary : Prop
text:
def MainStatementWithCuntzCorollary : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : UnitalCStar.{u}) (ι : G →* unitary A),
    IsFullGroupAlgebra A ι ∧ TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace A ∧
    (∀ (B : UnitalCStar.{u}), IsNuclear.{u, u} B →
      ∀ (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ), IsFree ω →
        ¬ ∃ φ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] NormUltrapower B ω, Function.Injective φ) ∧
    ∃ (O : UnitalCStar.{u}) (s : Fin 2 → O), IsCuntzTwoAlgebra O s ∧
      ∀ (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ), IsFree ω →
        ¬ ∃ φ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] NormUltrapower O ω, Function.Injective φ

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.UniversalBound
head: def UniversalBound (C : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def UniversalBound (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n m d : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < m →
    ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
      (B : Fin (d + 1) → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ‖polynomialAt A B‖ ≤ C * rangeMaximum A B

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.IsEquivalentNorm
doc: A seminorm with these bounds is a genuine norm equivalent to the original norm.
head: def IsEquivalentNorm (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop
text:
def IsEquivalentNorm (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ a ≤ b ∧ ∀ x, a * ‖x‖ ≤ N x ∧ N x ≤ b * ‖x‖

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.IsAUC
head: def IsAUC (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop
text: def IsAUC (N : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop := ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < oneSidedModulus X N t

name: OAI.CuntzPureness.manuscript_main
head:
theorem manuscript_main [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace A]
    (hsimple : TopologicallySimple A) (hinf : ¬FiniteDimensional ℂ A)
    (hA : IsNuclear.{u,0} A)
    (hAU : ∀ (u v : CuntzClass (MatrixLimit A)) (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k →
      (k+1) • u ≤ k • v → u ≤ v)
    (x : CuntzClass (MatrixLimit A)) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ y : CuntzClass (MatrixLimit A), n • y ≤ x ∧ x ≤ (n+1) • y

name: OAI.CuntzPureness.manuscriptStabilizationEquiv_stage
head:
lemma manuscriptStabilizationEquiv_stage (n : ℕ) (M : FinMatrix A n) :
    manuscriptStabilizationEquiv A ρ (matrixLimitStage n M)=
      CuntzComparison.spatialStage ρ.hom.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom n M

name: OAI.CuntzPureness.manuscript_has_spatial_model
head:
theorem manuscript_has_spatial_model :
    ∃ ρ : FaithfulHilbertRepresentation A, ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : FinMatrix A n),
      manuscriptStabilizationEquiv A ρ (matrixLimitStage n M)=
        CuntzComparison.spatialStage ρ.hom.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom n M

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Upper
head: def Upper (p : ι → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Upper (p : ι → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, p c ^ 2 ≤ p s ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.GlobalUpper
head: def GlobalUpper (p : ι → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper
head: def PUpper (f : ι → ℝ) : Prop
text: def PUpper (f : ι → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ s, p.agg (T.children s) f ≤ f s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.GlobalUpper
head: def GlobalUpper (f : ι → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def GlobalUpper (f : ι → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : ι) (S : Finset ι), (∀ c ∈ S, c ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent c = s) → e.agg S f ≤ f s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.FiniteTotalSupport
head: def FiniteTotalSupport (x : Xv) : Prop
text: def FiniteTotalSupport (x : Xv) : Prop := ∃ S : Finset Node, ∀ s ∉ S, coordinate s x = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.AdmissibleHeads
head: def AdmissibleHeads (x y : Xv) (A : ∀ h, Finset (ComponentNode h)) : Prop
text:
def AdmissibleHeads (x y : Xv) (A : ∀ h, Finset (ComponentNode h)) : Prop :=
  ∀ h, x h ≠ 0 → (componentTree h).Initial (A h) ∧
    (∀ s ∉ A h, componentCoordinate h s (x h) = 0) ∧

name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.AdmissibleRadius
head: def AdmissibleRadius {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (r : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def AdmissibleRadius {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (r : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧ ENNReal.ofReal r ≤ Metric.ediam μ.support

name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.ADRegularWithConstant
head:
def ADRegularWithConstant {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop
text:
def ADRegularWithConstant {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ μ.support, ∀ r : ℝ, AdmissibleRadius μ r →
    ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n / C) ≤ μ (ball x r) ∧
    μ (ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)

name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.RieszL2BoundedWithConstant
head:
def RieszL2BoundedWithConstant {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0)
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop
text:
def RieszL2BoundedWithConstant {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0)
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ f : Ambient d → ℝ,
    MemLp f 2 μ → MemLp (truncated n μ ε f) 2 μ ∧
      eLpNorm (truncated n μ ε f) 2 μ ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * eLpNorm f 2 μ

name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.BallImageConclusion
head:
def BallImageConclusion {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient d))
    (θ : ℝ) (M : ℝ≥0) : Prop
text:
def BallImageConclusion {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient d))
    (θ : ℝ) (M : ℝ≥0) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ μ.support, ∀ r : ℝ, AdmissibleRadius μ r →
    ∃ g : (ball (0 : Ambient n) r) → Ambient d,
      LipschitzWith M g ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (θ * r ^ n) ≤ μ (ball x r ∩ range g)

name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.QuantitativeFullStatement
doc: A single mass fraction and Lipschitz bound work for all measures with fixed AD and Riesz bounds.
head: def QuantitativeFullStatement : Prop
text:
def QuantitativeFullStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ d n : ℕ, 4 ≤ d → 2 ≤ n → n + 2 ≤ d →
    ∀ C_AD : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_AD → ∀ C_R : ℝ≥0,
      ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ ∃ M : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ μ : Measure (Ambient d), μ.Regular →
          ADRegularWithConstant n C_AD μ →
          RieszL2BoundedWithConstant n C_R μ →
          BallImageConclusion n μ θ M

name: OAI.ContinuousCircleWeight.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (θ : ℝ) (f : C(CircleX, ℝ)) (U V : unitary Operator) (e : TracialHilbert),
    0 < θ ∧ θ < 1 ∧ Irrational θ ∧
    IsTracialRotation θ U V e ∧
    (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) ∧
    (∃ z : CircleX, ∀ x, f x = 0 ↔ x = z) ∧
    (∫⁻ x, negativeLog (f x) ∂(volume : Measure CircleX)) = ∞ ∧
    ∀ p : Operator, p ∈ rotationAlgebra U V → IsStarProjection p →
      (1 - p) * weightedRotation U V f * p = 0 → p = 0 ∨ p = 1

name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.CH
doc: The continuum hypothesis.
head: def CH : Prop
text: def CH : Prop := Cardinal.mk ℝ = Cardinal.aleph 1

name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.HasSeparableQuotient
doc: A bounded linear surjection onto an infinite-dimensional separable Banach space.
head:
def HasSeparableQuotient (𝕜 : Type) [RCLike 𝕜]
    (X : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] : Prop
text:
def HasSeparableQuotient (𝕜 : Type) [RCLike 𝕜]
    (X : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] : Prop :=
  ∃ (Y : Type u) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup Y) (_ : NormedSpace 𝕜 Y),
    CompleteSpace Y ∧ TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace Y ∧
      (¬ FiniteDimensional 𝕜 Y) ∧ ∃ T : X →L[𝕜] Y, Function.Surjective T

name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.SQ
doc: The separable quotient assertion at an arbitrary ambient universe.
head: def SQ (𝕜 : Type) [RCLike 𝕜] : Prop

name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.RealValuedMeasurableContinuum
doc: The probability measure is defined on the full powerset of the continuum. The last clause quantifies over every smaller index set (represented as a subset of ℝ); ENNReal tsum is the supremum of finite subsums.
head: def RealValuedMeasurableContinuum : Prop
text:
def RealValuedMeasurableContinuum : Prop :=
  ∃ μ : @Measure ℝ ⊤,
    μ Set.univ = 1 ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, μ {x} = 0) ∧
    ∀ (s : Set ℝ), Cardinal.mk s < Cardinal.mk ℝ →
      ∀ (A : s → Set ℝ), Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) →
        μ (⋃ i, A i) = ∑' i, μ (A i)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CenteredDiskEndpoint.HasWeakGradient
doc: Distributional first derivatives represented by a vector-valued function.
head: def HasWeakGradient (f : Plane → ℝ) (g : Plane → Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CenteredDiskEndpoint.InW11
doc: Real inhomogeneous W^(1,1) on the whole plane.
head: def InW11 (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def InW11 (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Integrable f ∧ ∃ g : Plane → Plane, Integrable g ∧ HasWeakGradient f g

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CenteredDiskEndpoint.InW11Loc
doc: Local W^(1,1), expressed using the same distributional gradient convention.
head: def InW11Loc (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CenteredDiskEndpoint.SignedFiniteBandStatement
head: def SignedFiniteBandStatement : Prop
text:
def SignedFiniteBandStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ (f : Plane → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f →
    ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a → ∀ m : ℕ,
      LocallyIntegrable (signedBand f a ((2 : ℝ)^m * a)) ∧
      ∃ G : Plane → Plane, Integrable G ∧
        HasWeakGradient (signedBand f a ((2 : ℝ)^m * a)) G ∧
        gradientNorm G ≤ C * gradientNorm (gradient f)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CenteredDiskEndpoint.EndpointStatement
doc: Exact endpoint, including finiteness before passing to the real representative. Quantifying the input gradient makes the norm bound independent of a choice of representative of its weak derivatives.
head: def EndpointStatement : Prop
text:
def EndpointStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ (f : Plane → ℝ) (g : Plane → Plane),
      Integrable f → Integrable g → HasWeakGradient f g →
      (∀ᵐ x, maximal f x ≠ ⊤) ∧
      LocallyIntegrable (maximalReal f) ∧
      InW11Loc (maximalReal f) ∧
      ∃ G : Plane → Plane, Integrable G ∧
        HasWeakGradient (maximalReal f) G ∧ gradientNorm G ≤ C * gradientNorm g

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.SignedPrefixBound
head: def SignedPrefixBound (C : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def SignedPrefixBound (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d N : ℕ), 1 ≤ d → 1 ≤ N →
    ∀ (v : Fin N → Vector d), (∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∃ ε : Fin N → ℝ, (∀ i, ε i = -1 ∨ ε i = 1) ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N →
          ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < k), ε i • v i‖ ≤
            C * Real.sqrt d

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.OrderingPrefixBound
head: def OrderingPrefixBound (C : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def OrderingPrefixBound (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d N : ℕ), 1 ≤ d → 1 ≤ N →
    ∀ (v : Fin N → Vector d), (∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1) → (∑ i, v i) = 0 →
      ∃ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N), ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N →
        ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < k), v (π i)‖ ≤
          C * Real.sqrt d

name: OAI.StrictInverseFirstPower.NormalizedUnivalent
head: def NormalizedUnivalent (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def NormalizedUnivalent (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f disk ∧ Set.InjOn f disk ∧ f 0 = 0 ∧ deriv f 0 = 1

name: OAI.StrictInverseFirstPower.BoundedNormalizedUnivalent
head: def BoundedNormalizedUnivalent (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def BoundedNormalizedUnivalent (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  NormalizedUnivalent f ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ disk, ‖f z‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.RegularAnalyticBoundaryAt
head: def RegularAnalyticBoundaryAt (U : Set ℂ) (p : ℂ) : Prop

name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.IsMinimizing
head:
def IsMinimizing {n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (τ : ℝ) (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop
text:
def IsMinimizing {n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (τ : ℝ) (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop :=
  MetricFeasible T τ H ∧
    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      MetricFeasible T σ J → τ ≤ σ

name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.StrictlyFeasible
head: def StrictlyFeasible {n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop
text:
def StrictlyFeasible {n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (τ : ℝ) (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ), H.IsHermitian ∧
    (H - 1).PosDef ∧
    (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) τ - H).PosDef ∧
    (H - Tᴴ * H * T).PosDef

name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.FullEndpoint
head: def FullEndpoint : Prop
text:
def FullEndpoint : Prop :=
  ∀ (U : Set ℂ), IsAdmissible U →
    (∀ a ∈ U, Nonempty (DiskCoordinate U a)) ∧
    Nonempty (ExteriorCoordinate U) ∧
    ∀ (a : ℂ), a ∈ U → ∀ (f : DiskCoordinate U a) (G : ExteriorCoordinate U),
      ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
        numericalRange A ⊆ U →
        let T := matrixAnalyticEval A f.toDisk
        StrictlyFeasible T ∧
        ∃ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ ∧ κ ≤ 2 ∧
          (∃ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsMinimizing T (κ ^ 2) H) ∧
          ∀ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsMinimizing T (κ ^ 2) H →
            let S := CFC.sqrt H
            let A' := S * A * S⁻¹
            let D := S * T * S⁻¹
            H.PosDef ∧ IsUnit S ∧
            D = matrixAnalyticEval A' f.toDisk ∧
            Dᴴ * D ≤ 1 ∧ spectralRadius ℂ D < 1 ∧
            ‖S‖ * ‖S⁻¹‖ = κ ∧
            (∀ R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsUnit R →
              (R * T * R⁻¹)ᴴ * (R * T * R⁻¹) ≤ 1 →
              κ ≤ ‖R‖ * ‖R⁻¹‖) ∧
            ∃ Λ : C(UnitAddCircle, Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
              (∀ t, (Λ t).PosSemidef) ∧
              (∫ t, Λ t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1 ∧
              ∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m →
                ∀ v : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ,
                  AnalyticOnNhd ℂ v (closure U) →
                  completeAnalyticEval A' v =
                    (∫ t, Λ t ⊗ₖ v (boundaryPoint G t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) ∧
                  ‖completeAnalyticEval A v‖ ≤ κ * analyticSupNorm U v

name: OAI.Pureness.IsNuclear

name: OAI.CurrentMain.StablyFinite

name: OAI.CurrentMain.UniformPropertyGammaAt
head:
def UniformPropertyGammaAt (A : Type) [CStarAlgebra A]
    [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [Nontrivial A]
    [Nonempty (TracialState A)] (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop
text:
def UniformPropertyGammaAt (A : Type) [CStarAlgebra A]
    [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [Nontrivial A]
    [Nonempty (TracialState A)] (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U,
    IsStarProjection p ∧ ∀ x : UniformTracialCompletion (fun τ : TracialState A => τ),
      p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x =
        familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x * p ∧
      ∀ s : ℕ → TracialState A,
        (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U s).functional
          (p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x) =
        (1/2 : ℂ) *
        (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U s).functional
          (familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x)

name: OAI.TriangularHilbert.GoodPoint
head: def GoodPoint (F G : Plane → ℂ) (z : Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.TriangularHilbert.MainEstimate
head: def MainEstimate : Prop
text:
def MainEstimate : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ F G : Plane → ℂ,
    MemLp F 3 volume → MemLp G 3 volume →
    (∀ᵐ z ∂volume, GoodPoint F G z) ∧
    AEMeasurable (maximal F G) volume ∧
    maximalNorm F G ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * eLpNorm F 3 volume * eLpNorm G 3 volume

name: OAI.Dixmier.Amenable
doc: A positive normalized left-invariant complex mean.
head:
def Amenable (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [DiscreteTopology G] : Prop
text:
def Amenable (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [DiscreteTopology G] : Prop :=
  ∃ m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ,
    m (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G 1) = 1 ∧
    (∀ f : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0) →
      0 ≤ (m f).re ∧ (m f).im = 0) ∧
    ∀ (g : G) (f : G →ᵇ ℂ), m (leftTranslate g f) = m f

name: OAI.Dixmier.SimilarToUnitary
head:
def SimilarToUnitary {G : Type u} [Group G]
    {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (π : G →* (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Prop
text:
def SimilarToUnitary {G : Type u} [Group G]
    {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (π : G →* (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : H ≃L[ℂ] H, ∀ (g : G) (x : H), ‖S (π g (S.symm x))‖ = ‖x‖

name: OAI.Dixmier.NonamenableWitness
doc: A uniformly 101-bounded nonunitarizable representation on a separable complete complex Hilbert space, with its universe explicit.
head: def NonamenableWitness (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop
text:
def NonamenableWitness (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : Type v) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup H) (_ : InnerProductSpace ℂ H)
    (_ : CompleteSpace H) (_ : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace H)
    (π : G →* (H →L[ℂ] H)),
    (∀ g : G, ‖π g‖ ≤ 101) ∧ ¬ SimilarToUnitary π

name: OAI.Dixmier.Unitarizable
doc: Unitarizability at an explicitly quantified Hilbert-space universe.
head: def Unitarizable (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop
text:
def Unitarizable (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∀ (H : Type v) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (π : G →* (H →L[ℂ] H)),
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g, ‖π g‖ ≤ C) → SimilarToUnitary π

name: OAI.Dixmier.MainTheorem
doc: Every countable discrete nonamenable group has a bounded nonunitarizable witness.
head: def MainTheorem : Prop

name: OAI.RVM.BoundedSmooth
head: def BoundedSmooth (F : Vec → Vec) : Prop

name: OAI.RVM.Admissible
head: def Admissible (d : Datum) : Prop
text:
def Admissible (d : Datum) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ ∞ d.f₀ ∧ HasCompactSupport d.f₀ ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ d.f₀ z) ∧
  BoundedSmooth d.E₀ ∧ BoundedSmooth d.B₀ ∧
  MemLp d.E₀ 2 volume ∧ MemLp d.B₀ 2 volume ∧
  (∀ x, divergence d.E₀ x = rho d.f₀ x) ∧
  (∀ x, divergence d.B₀ x = 0)

name: OAI.RVM.TimeContinuousL2
head: def TimeContinuousL2 (F : Field) : Prop
text:
def TimeContinuousL2 (F : Field) : Prop :=
  ∃ F₂ : ℝ → Lp Vec 2 (volume : Measure Vec),
    ContinuousOn F₂ (Ici 0) ∧
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → (F₂ t : Vec → Vec) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => F (t, x))

name: OAI.RVM.Equations
head: def Equations (s : Solution) : Prop
text:
def Equations (s : Solution) : Prop := ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
  (∀ x v,
    derivWithin (fun t' => s.f (t', x, v)) (Ici 0) t +
    (∑ i : Fin 3, velocity v i * spatialPartial (fun y => s.f (t, y, v)) x i) +
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (s.E (t, x) + cross (velocity v) (s.B (t, x))) i *
      spatialPartial (fun v' => s.f (t, x, v')) v i) = 0) ∧
  (∀ x, derivWithin (fun t' => s.E (t', x)) (Ici 0) t -
    curl (fun y => s.B (t, y)) x = -current (fun z => s.f (t, z)) x) ∧
  (∀ x, derivWithin (fun t' => s.B (t', x)) (Ici 0) t +
    curl (fun y => s.E (t, y)) x = 0) ∧
  (∀ x, divergence (fun y => s.E (t, y)) x = rho (fun z => s.f (t, z)) x) ∧
  (∀ x, divergence (fun y => s.B (t, y)) x = 0)

name: OAI.RVM.CompactOnFiniteHorizons
head: def CompactOnFiniteHorizons (s : Solution) : Prop

name: OAI.RVM.Classical
head: def Classical (d : Datum) (s : Solution) : Prop
text:
def Classical (d : Datum) (s : Solution) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ 1 s.f particleHalfSpace ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ 1 s.E fieldHalfSpace ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 s.B fieldHalfSpace ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ z, 0 ≤ s.f (t, z)) ∧
  TimeContinuousL2 s.E ∧ TimeContinuousL2 s.B ∧
  CompactOnFiniteHorizons s ∧ Equations s ∧
  (∀ z, s.f (0, z) = d.f₀ z) ∧
  (∀ x, s.E (0, x) = d.E₀ x) ∧ (∀ x, s.B (0, x) = d.B₀ x)

name: OAI.RVM.SmoothOnFiniteHorizons
head: def SmoothOnFiniteHorizons (s : Solution) : Prop
text:
def SmoothOnFiniteHorizons (s : Solution) : Prop := ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T →
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ s.f (particleSlab T) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ s.E (fieldSlab T) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ s.B (fieldSlab T)

name: OAI.RVM.SameNonnegativeTime
head: def SameNonnegativeTime (s s' : Solution) : Prop
text:
def SameNonnegativeTime (s s' : Solution) : Prop := ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
  (∀ z, s.f (t, z) = s'.f (t, z)) ∧
  (∀ x, s.E (t, x) = s'.E (t, x)) ∧ (∀ x, s.B (t, x) = s'.B (t, x))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.Joined
head: def Joined (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (n : ℕ) (x y : X.Cell n) : Prop
text:
def Joined (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (n : ℕ) (x y : X.Cell n) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : X.Cell (n + 1), X.source n h = x ∧ X.target n h = y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TheoryData.PreservesGlobularSums
head: def PreservesGlobularSums (C : TheoryData.{v}) : Prop
text:
def PreservesGlobularSums (C : TheoryData.{v}) : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h),
    IsPushout (C.arity.map (S.seam hl)) (C.arity.map (Shape.face hr false))
      (C.arity.map (S.inl b h hl hr)) (C.arity.map (S.inr b h hl hr))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Fills
head:
def Fills {C D : GlobularTheory.{v}} (f : Morphism C D) (p : C.AdmissiblePair)
    (z : D.Hom (Shape.globe (p.n + 1)) p.arity) : Prop
text:
def Fills {C D : GlobularTheory.{v}} (f : Morphism C D) (p : C.AdmissiblePair)
    (z : D.Hom (Shape.globe (p.n + 1)) p.arity) : Prop :=
  D.comp (D.base (Shape.source p.n)) z = f.map p.source ∧
  D.comp (D.base (Shape.target p.n)) z = f.map p.target

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.IsFreeExtension
text:
def IsFreeExtension {C D : GlobularTheory.{v}} (f : Morphism C D)
    (G : Type v) (pair : G → C.AdmissiblePair)
    (filler : ∀ g, D.Hom (Shape.globe ((pair g).n + 1)) (pair g).arity) : Prop :=
  (∀ g, Fills f (pair g) (filler g)) ∧
  ∀ (E : GlobularTheory.{v}) (a : Morphism C E)
    (chosen : ∀ g, E.Hom (Shape.globe ((pair g).n + 1)) (pair g).arity),
    (∀ g, Fills a (pair g) (chosen g)) →
    ∃! b : Morphism D E, f.comp b = a ∧ ∀ g, b.map (filler g) = chosen g

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.WeakEquivalence
head:
def WeakEquivalence {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator) {X Y : C.Model}

text:
def WeakEquivalence {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator) {X Y : C.Model}

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PolynomialSimulation
doc: An alphabet-independent polynomial bound for deterministic simulation.
head: def PolynomialSimulation (positive : Bool) : Prop
text:
def PolynomialSimulation (positive : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ C c : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < c ∧
    ∀ (Alpha : Type) (_ : Fintype Alpha) (n : ℕ) (N : NMachine Alpha n),
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (D : DMachine Alpha s),
      (s : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ c ∧
      ∀ w, D.Accepts positive w ↔ N.Accepts positive w

name: OAI.Balanced.PartiteHypergraph.Covers
head: def Covers (H : PartiteHypergraph r n) (C : Finset (Vertex r n)) : Prop
text:
def Covers (H : PartiteHypergraph r n) (C : Finset (Vertex r n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ H.edges, ∃ i, (i, e i) ∈ C

name: OAI.Balanced.PartiteHypergraph.Intersecting
head: def Intersecting (H : PartiteHypergraph r n) : Prop
text:
def Intersecting (H : PartiteHypergraph r n) : Prop :=
  H.edges.Nonempty ∧ ∀ e ∈ H.edges, ∀ f ∈ H.edges, ∃ i, e i = f i

name: OAI.Balanced.PartiteHypergraph.Nonisolated
head: def Nonisolated (H : PartiteHypergraph r n) : Prop
text:
def Nonisolated (H : PartiteHypergraph r n) : Prop :=
  ∀ i v, ∃ e ∈ H.edges, e i = v

name: OAI.Balanced.PartiteHypergraph.HasCoverNumber
head: def HasCoverNumber (H : PartiteHypergraph r n) (k : ℕ) : Prop

name: OAI.Balanced.BalancedCounterexample
head: def BalancedCounterexample (q : ℕ) : Prop

name: OAI.Balanced.MainResult

text:
def MainResult : Prop :=
