name: OAI.ElementaryPositivity.NaturalUnitIntervalGraph.Edge
head: def Edge (i j : Fin n) : Prop
text:
def Edge (i j : Fin n) : Prop :=
  (i < j ∧ j ≤ G.h i) ∨ (j < i ∧ i ≤ G.h j)

name: OAI.ElementaryPositivity.NaturalUnitIntervalGraph.Nondescent
head: def Nondescent (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : Prop
text:
def Nondescent (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → σ j < σ i → G.Edge (σ i) (σ j)

name: OAI.ElementaryPositivity.NaturalUnitIntervalGraph.Proper
head: def Proper {r : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Fin r) : Prop
text:
def Proper {r : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Fin r) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Fin n, G.Edge i j → f i ≠ f j

name: OAI.ContingencyTables.HasMargins
doc: The row and column equations in both papers.
head: def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop
text:
def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ∑ j, X i j = r i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, X i j = c j)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covers
doc: A cover supplies a contained generator for every target set.
head: def Covers (G A : Family α) : Prop
text: def Covers (G A : Family α) : Prop := ∀ S ∈ A, ∃ I ∈ G, I ⊆ S

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Small
doc: Smallness is witnessed by an actual containment cover of cost at most one half.
head: def Small (p : ℝ) (A : Family α) : Prop
text:
def Small (p : ℝ) (A : Family α) : Prop :=
  ∃ G : Family α, Covers G A ∧ cost p G ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.EditDistortion.BinaryWitness
doc: A finite nonempty subset of binary words of one common length.
head: def BinaryWitness (c : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def BinaryWitness (c : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ d ∧ ∃ S : Set (List Bool), S.Finite ∧ S.Nonempty ∧
    (∀ w ∈ S, w.length = n) ∧
    exponentScale c d ≤ leastDistortion (fun x y : S => (edit x.val y.val : ℝ))

name: OAI.EditDistortion.MainClaim
doc: Uniform two-sided bounds with common positive constants and threshold.
head: def MainClaim : Prop
text:
def MainClaim : Prop :=
  ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    (∀ (Alpha : Type u) [Fintype Alpha], 2 ≤ Fintype.card Alpha →
      exponentScale c d ≤ E Alpha d ∧ E Alpha d ≤ exponentScale C d) ∧
    BinaryWitness c d ∧
    exponentScale c d ≤ alphabetSup d ∧ alphabetSup d ≤ exponentScale C d

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.Congruent
head: def Congruent {s d D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) (b : Fin s → Space D) : Prop
text:
def Congruent {s d D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) (b : Fin s → Space D) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, dist (b i) (b j) = dist (a i) (a j)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.Ramsey
head: def Ramsey {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) : Prop
text:
def Ramsey {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) : Prop :=
  ∀ r : ℕ, 2 ≤ r → ∃ D : ℕ, 1 ≤ D ∧
    ∀ c : Space D → Fin r, ∃ b : Fin s → Space D,
      Congruent a b ∧ ∃ k : Fin r, ∀ i, c (b i) = k

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.FieldCriterion
head: def FieldCriterion {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) : Prop
text:
def FieldCriterion {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) : Prop :=
  ∃ P : Matrix (Option (Fin d)) (Option (Fin d)) (TensorRing a),
    (∀ i : Fin s, ∑ α, ∑ β,
      ((augmented a i α) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : Coeff a)) * P α β *
      ((1 : Coeff a) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (augmented a i β)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ α β : Fin d, multiply a (P (some α) (some β)) = if α = β then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Covers
head: def Covers (G F : Family α) : Prop
text: def Covers (G F : Family α) : Prop := ∀ H ∈ F, ∃ S ∈ G, S ⊆ H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Small
head: def Small (p : ℝ) (F : Family α) : Prop
text:
def Small (p : ℝ) (F : Family α) : Prop :=
  ∃ G : Family α, Covers G F ∧ cost p G ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FractionalCover
head: def FractionalCover (F : Family α) (g : Finset α → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FractionalSmall
head: def FractionalSmall (p : ℝ) (F : Family α) : Prop
text:
def FractionalSmall (p : ℝ) (F : Family α) : Prop :=
  ∃ g : Finset α → ℝ, FractionalCover F g ∧ fracCost p g ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Increasing
head: def Increasing (F : Family α) : Prop
text:
def Increasing (F : Family α) : Prop :=
  ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ K : Finset α, H ⊆ K → K ∈ F

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.OffsetLocal
head: def OffsetLocal {α : Type u} {w : ℕ} (δ : ℝ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool) : Prop
text:
def OffsetLocal {α : Type u} {w : ℕ} (δ : ℝ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b : α, a ≠ b → ∀ s t : ℕ,
    s + w / 8 ≤ w → t + w / 8 ≤ w →
    (lcs (interval c a s (w / 8)) (interval c b t (w / 8)) : ℝ) ≤
      (1 - δ) * (w / 8 : ℕ)

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.AnchorLocal
head: def AnchorLocal {α : Type u} {w : ℕ} (ε : ℝ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool) : Prop
text:
def AnchorLocal {α : Type u} {w : ℕ} (ε : ℝ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b : α, ∀ is js : List (Fin w),
    is.Pairwise (fun i j => i.val < j.val) →
    js.Pairwise (fun i j => i.val < j.val) →
    is.length = js.length → (w : ℝ) / 4 ≤ is.length →
    (indexSpan is - is.length : ℕ) ≤ ε * w →
    (indexSpan js - js.length : ℕ) ≤ ε * w →
    (∀ ij ∈ is.zip js, c a ij.1 = c b ij.2) →
    a = b ∧ ∃ i : Fin w, (i, i) ∈ is.zip js

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.SubstitutionBounds
head:
def SubstitutionBounds {α : Type u} [Fintype α] {w : ℕ}
    (a C : ℝ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool) : Prop
text:
def SubstitutionBounds {α : Type u} [Fintype α] {w : ℕ}
    (a C : ℝ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool) : Prop :=
  0 < w ∧ (w : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log (2 * Fintype.card α) ∧
  (∀ L : ℕ, ∀ x y : List α, x.length = L → y.length = L →
    a * w * deficit x y ≤ (deficit (encode c x) (encode c y) : ℝ) ∧
    deficit (encode c x) (encode c y) ≤ w * deficit x y) ∧
  (∀ x y : List α, editDistance (encode c x) (encode c y) ≤ w * editDistance x y)

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.TwoCodes
head: def TwoCodes (a C δ ε : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def TwoCodes (a C δ ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) [Fintype α], 2 ≤ Fintype.card α →
    (∃ (w : ℕ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool),
      SubstitutionBounds a C c ∧ OffsetLocal δ c) ∧
    (∃ (w : ℕ) (c : α → Fin w → Bool),
      SubstitutionBounds a C c ∧ AnchorLocal ε c)

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.MaskPrimes
head: def MaskPrimes (h : ℕ) (p : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) : Prop
text:
def MaskPrimes (h : ℕ) (p : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ l k : Fin h, Nat.Prime (p (l.val + 1) k)) ∧
  Function.Injective (fun lk : Fin h × Fin h => p (lk.1.val + 1) lk.2) ∧
  ∀ l k : Fin h, h ^ 3 ≤ p (l.val + 1) k ∧ p (l.val + 1) k ≤ 2 * h ^ 3

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.ExcludedPrimes
head: def ExcludedPrimes (m : ℕ) (p : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) : Prop
text:
def ExcludedPrimes (m : ℕ) (p : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ l k : Fin m, Nat.Prime (p (l.val + 1) k)) ∧
  Function.Injective (fun lk : Fin m × Fin m => p (lk.1.val + 1) lk.2) ∧
  ∀ l k : Fin m, m ^ 3 < p (l.val + 1) k ∧ p (l.val + 1) k ≤ m ^ 5

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.MaskWitness
head: def MaskWitness (a C δ lower : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def MaskWitness (a C δ lower : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : ℕ, 2 ≤ h ∧ ∃ p : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ, MaskPrimes h p ∧
    ∃ (w : ℕ) (c : MaskAlphabet h p h → Fin w → Bool),
      SubstitutionBounds a C c ∧ OffsetLocal δ c ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n ≤ d ∧
        (∀ v : MaskState h p (circleSize h p) h,
          (encode c (maskWord h p (h ^ (2 * h)) (circleSize h p) h v)).length = n) ∧
        Real.exp (lower * exponentScale d) ≤ setDistortion
          (Set.range fun v : MaskState h p (circleSize h p) h =>
            encode c (maskWord h p (h ^ (2 * h)) (circleSize h p) h v))

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.ExcludedWitness
head: def ExcludedWitness (a C ε lower : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def ExcludedWitness (a C ε lower : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m ∧ ∃ p : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ, ExcludedPrimes m p ∧
    ∃ (w : ℕ) (c : ExcludedAlphabet m (circleSize m p) m → Fin w → Bool),
      SubstitutionBounds a C c ∧ AnchorLocal ε c ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n ≤ d ∧
        (∀ v : ExcludedState m (circleSize m p) m,
          (encode c (excludedWord m p (m ^ (2 * m)) (circleSize m p) m v)).length = n) ∧
        Real.exp (lower * exponentScale d) ≤ setDistortion
          (Set.range fun v : ExcludedState m (circleSize m p) m =>
            encode c (excludedWord m p (m ^ (2 * m)) (circleSize m p) m v))

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.UniformUpper
head: def UniformUpper (C : ℝ) (d₀ : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def UniformUpper (C : ℝ) (d₀ : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) [Fintype α], 2 ≤ Fintype.card α → ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    ∃ (M : ℕ) (F : Words α d → Fin M → ℝ), ∀ x y : Words α d,
      (editDistance x.val y.val : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, |F x i - F y i| ∧
      (∑ i, |F x i - F y i|) ≤
        Real.exp (C * exponentScale d) * editDistance x.val y.val

name: OAI.FiniteCircle.FullMain
head: def FullMain : Prop
text:
def FullMain : Prop :=
  ∃ c C a Ccode δ ε : ℝ, ∃ d₀ : ℕ,
    0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧ 0 < a ∧ 0 < Ccode ∧ 0 < δ ∧ 0 < ε ∧
    TwoCodes a Ccode δ ε ∧ UniformUpper C d₀ ∧
    (∀ (α : Type) [Fintype α], 2 ≤ Fintype.card α → ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
      Real.exp (c * exponentScale d) ≤ E α d ∧
      E α d ≤ Real.exp (C * exponentScale d)) ∧
    (∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
      MaskWitness a Ccode δ c d ∧ ExcludedWitness a Ccode ε c d ∧
      Real.exp (c * exponentScale d) ≤ alphabetSupremum d ∧
      alphabetSupremum d ≤ Real.exp (C * exponentScale d))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.IsMultilinear
doc: Every exponent in every supported monomial is at most one.
head: def IsMultilinear {n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsMultilinear {n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i : Fin n, m i ≤ 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.GotsmanLinialStatement
doc: The average-sensitivity bound for positive dimension and degree at most the dimension.
head: def GotsmanLinialStatement : Prop
text:
def GotsmanLinialStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n d : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ d → d ≤ n →
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      IsMultilinear p → p.totalDegree ≤ d →
        averageSensitivity (polynomialThreshold p) ≤ 8 * (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.SecondKahnKalaiBounds
head: def SecondKahnKalaiBounds {V : Type u} (n : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph V) : Prop
text:
def SecondKahnKalaiBounds {V : Type u} (n : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph V) : Prop :=
  criticalThreshold n H ≤
      min 1 (2048 * Real.exp 50 * expectationThreshold n H *
        (1 + logTwo (edgeCount H : ℝ))) ∧
    criticalThreshold n H ≤
      6144 * Real.exp 50 * expectationThreshold n H * logTwo (n : ℝ)

name: OAI.PlanarHalving.GeneralPosition
head: def GeneralPosition {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Point) : Prop

name: OAI.PlanarHalving.Generic
head: def Generic {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Point) : Prop
text:
def Generic {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Point) : Prop :=
  GeneralPosition P ∧
  (∀ i j, i ≠ j → (P i).1 ≠ (P j).1) ∧
  (∀ i j a b, i < j → a < b → slope (P i) (P j) = slope (P a) (P b) →
    i = a ∧ j = b) ∧
  (∀ i j a b c d, i < j → a < b → c < d →
    (i, j) ≠ (a, b) → (c, d) ≠ (i, j) → (c, d) ≠ (a, b) →
    ∀ z : Point, z ∈ openSegment ℝ (P i) (P j) →
      z ∈ openSegment ℝ (P a) (P b) → z ∉ segment ℝ (P c) (P d))

name: OAI.Barnette.Planar
doc: Planarity means existence of a crossing-free topological plane embedding.
head: def Planar {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop
text:
def Planar {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (PlaneEmbedding G)

name: OAI.Barnette.ThreeVertexConnected
doc: Deleting any set of at most two vertices leaves a connected graph of order at least two.
head: def ThreeVertexConnected {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop

name: OAI.Barnette.HasHamiltonianCycle
doc: A single spanning cycle, not a possibly disconnected spanning 2-factor.
head: def HasHamiltonianCycle {V : Type u} [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop
text:
def HasHamiltonianCycle {V : Type u} [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop :=
  ∃ v : V, ∃ p : G.Walk v v, p.IsHamiltonianCycle

name: OAI.Barnette.MainStatement
doc: Cubic bipartite three-vertex-connected plane graphs have a Hamiltonian cycle.
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj],
    G.IsRegularOfDegree 3 → G.IsBipartite → Planar G →
      ThreeVertexConnected G → HasHamiltonianCycle G

name: OAI.LargeIndependentSets.Graph.Independent

name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Complexity.FinitePolyTime
doc: Polynomial-time computation with every physical work alphabet finite.
head:
def FinitePolyTime {α β : Type} (ea : α → List Bool) (eb : β → List Bool)
    (f : α → β) : Prop
text:
def FinitePolyTime {α β : Type} (ea : α → List Bool) (eb : β → List Bool)
    (f : α → β) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime ea eb f,
    ∀ k : p.tm.K, Finite (p.tm.Γ k)

name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Complexity.PNeNP
doc: Separation of deterministic polynomial time from finite-verifier nondeterministic polynomial time.
head: def PNeNP : Prop
text: def PNeNP : Prop := P ≠ NP

name: OAI.MetricKMedian.FactorCorrect
doc: An actual nonempty feasible facility set, encoded by its membership mask.
head: def FactorCorrect (α : ℝ) (I : Instance) (output : List Bool) : Prop
text:
def FactorCorrect (α : ℝ) (I : Instance) (output : List Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : Finset (Fin I.n), S ⊆ I.facilities ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ S.card ≤ I.k ∧
    output = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin I.n => decide (i ∈ S)) ∧
    cost I S ≤ α * optimum I

name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Correct
head: def Correct (epsilon : ℝ) (I : Instance) (output : List Bool) : Prop
text:
def Correct (epsilon : ℝ) (I : Instance) (output : List Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : Finset (Fin I.n), S ⊆ I.facilities ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ S.card ≤ I.k ∧
    output = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin I.n => decide (i ∈ S)) ∧
    cost I S ≤ (1 + 2 / Real.exp 1 + epsilon) * optimum I

name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RationalMetricInput.Feasible
head: def Feasible (I : RationalMetricInput) (S : Finset (Fin I.pointCount)) : Prop
text:
def Feasible (I : RationalMetricInput) (S : Finset (Fin I.pointCount)) : Prop :=
  S ⊆ I.facilities ∧ S.card ≤ I.budget ∧ (I.clients.Nonempty → S.Nonempty)

name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.globalApplicationClaim
head: def globalApplicationClaim : Prop
text:
def globalApplicationClaim : Prop :=
  ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∃ A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm,
    (∀ (I : RationalMetricInput) (s : A.Seed I), I.Feasible (A.output I s)) ∧
    (∀ I : RationalMetricInput,
      1 - Real.rpow ((I.size : ℝ) + 2) (-a) ≤
        A.successProbability I ((2 - σ) * (I.optimum : ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ I : RationalMetricInput, A.expectedCost I ≤ (2 - σ) * (I.optimum : ℝ))

name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.Input.Bounded
head: def Bounded (I : Input) (bound : Polynomial ℕ) : Prop
text:
def Bounded (I : Input) (bound : Polynomial ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, I.metric.distance x y ≤ ((bound.eval I.size : ℕ) : ℚ)

name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.PolynomialWork
head: def PolynomialWork (A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm) (bound : Polynomial ℕ) : Prop
text:
def PolynomialWork (A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm) (bound : Polynomial ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d : ℕ,
    ∀ I : Input, I.Bounded bound → ∀ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ζ → ζ < 1 →
      (workBound A I ζ : ℝ) ≤
        c * ((I.size : ℝ) + 1) ^ d * (1 + Real.log (1 / ζ)) ^ d

name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.refinedRecoveryClaim
head: def refinedRecoveryClaim : Prop
text:
def refinedRecoveryClaim : Prop :=
  ∀ (bound : Polynomial ℕ) (ε L₀ : ℝ) (μ : ℚ),
    0 < ε → 0 < L₀ → 0 < μ → μ ≤ 1/4 → (μ : ℝ) ≤ ε/12 →
    ∃ A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm,
      PolynomialWork A bound ∧
      ∀ I : Input, I.Bounded bound → ∀ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ζ → ζ < 1 →
        (∀ s : Seed A I ζ, I.metric.Feasible (output A I ζ s)) ∧
        (∀ C : Certificate I μ L₀,
          1 - ζ ≤ successProbability A I ζ
            ((1 + 2 / Real.exp 1 + ε) * (I.metric.cost C.centers : ℝ)))

name: OAI.LinearListHadwiger.Choosable

name: OAI.LinearListHadwiger.HasCliqueMinor
head: def HasCliqueMinor {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) (t : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def HasCliqueMinor {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Fin t → Set V,
    (∀ i, (G.induce (B i)).Connected) ∧
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (B i) (B j)) ∧
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∃ v ∈ B i, ∃ w ∈ B j, G.Adj v w)

name: OAI.LowSpaceSubsetSum.Solvable
doc: The decision predicate includes the empty subset.
head: def Solvable {n : ℕ} (I : Instance n) : Prop
text:
def Solvable {n : ℕ} (I : Instance n) : Prop :=

name: OAI.LowSpaceSubsetSum.Represents
doc: A retained entry has a subset witness within its parent's allowed domain.
head:
def Represents {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a : ι → ℤ) (domain top : Finset ι) (e : Entry ι) : Prop
text:
def Represents {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a : ι → ℤ) (domain top : Finset ι) (e : Entry ι) : Prop :=
  ∃ S ⊆ domain, weight a S = e.value ∧ S ∩ top = e.mask

name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.Perfect
doc: Exactly one selected edge is incident to every vertex.
head: def Perfect (G : GraphInput) (M : Finset (Fin G.n × Fin G.n)) : Prop
text:
def Perfect (G : GraphInput) (M : Finset (Fin G.n × Fin G.n)) : Prop :=
  M ⊆ G.edges ∧ ∀ v : Fin G.n, ∃! e, e ∈ M ∧ (e.1 = v ∨ e.2 = v)

name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.Outputs
head:
def Outputs (A : RandomMachine) (input : List Symbol) {t : ℕ}
    (bits : Fin t → Bool) (q : ℚ) : Prop
text:
def Outputs (A : RandomMachine) (input : List Symbol) {t : ℕ}
    (bits : Fin t → Bool) (q : ℚ) : Prop :=
  (run A input bits).state = none ∧
    (run A input bits).tape.right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (encodeRat q)

name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.MainStatement
doc: A uniform approximation scheme using independent fair bits. All tapes halt within the fixed polynomial bound and return a nonnegative rational. A zero count always produces encoded zero.
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : RandomMachine) (C d : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      let t := timeBound C d G ε δ
      (∀ bits : Fin t → Bool, ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ q ∧ Outputs A (encodeInput G ε δ) bits q) ∧
      (Z G = 0 → ∀ bits : Fin t → Bool, Outputs A (encodeInput G ε δ) bits 0) ∧
      ((goodTapes A G ε δ t).card : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ t ≥ 1 - δ

name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.LooplessGraph.Incident

name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.LooplessGraph.IsPerfectMatching

name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.IsPerfectMatching

def IsPerfectMatching {n : ℕ} (M : Finset (Edge n)) : Prop :=

name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.Crosses

text:
def Crosses {n : ℕ} (U : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Edge n) : Prop :=

name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.HasFactorization
doc: Real PSD factors of order `r`, without equivariance or rank-one restrictions.
head: def HasFactorization (n r : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def HasFactorization (n r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : Row n → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (B : PerfectMatching n → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ),
    (∀ i, (A i).PosSemidef) ∧ (∀ M, (B M).PosSemidef) ∧
    ∀ i M, slack i M = Matrix.trace (A i * B M)

name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.MainClaim

name: OAI.ParityWL.jointColor
head:
noncomputable def jointColor {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
    (r : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → JointColor k r
  | 0, x => atomicType G x
  | r + 1, x => (jointColor G k r x,
      Finset.univ.val.map (fun y => fun i => jointColor G k r (Function.update x i y)))

noncomputable def separateColor {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
    (r : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → SeparateColor k r
  | 0, x => atomicType G x
  | r + 1, x => (separateColor G k r x,
      fun i => Finset.univ.val.map (fun y => separateColor G k r (Function.update x i y)))

noncomputable def sameHistogram {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k r : ℕ) : Prop
text:
noncomputable def jointColor {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
    (r : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → JointColor k r
  | 0, x => atomicType G x
  | r + 1, x => (jointColor G k r x,
      Finset.univ.val.map (fun y => fun i => jointColor G k r (Function.update x i y)))

name: OAI.ParityWL.separateColor
head:
noncomputable def separateColor {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
    (r : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → SeparateColor k r
  | 0, x => atomicType G x
  | r + 1, x => (separateColor G k r x,
      fun i => Finset.univ.val.map (fun y => separateColor G k r (Function.update x i y)))

noncomputable def sameHistogram {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k r : ℕ) : Prop
text:
noncomputable def separateColor {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
    (r : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → SeparateColor k r
  | 0, x => atomicType G x
  | r + 1, x => (separateColor G k r x,
      fun i => Finset.univ.val.map (fun y => separateColor G k r (Function.update x i y)))

name: OAI.ParityWL.sameHistogram
head:
noncomputable def sameHistogram {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k r : ℕ) : Prop
text:
noncomputable def sameHistogram {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  match c with
  | .joint => Finset.univ.val.map (jointColor G k r) =
      Finset.univ.val.map (jointColor H k r)
  | .separate => Finset.univ.val.map (separateColor G k r) =
      Finset.univ.val.map (separateColor H k r)

name: OAI.ParityWL.samePureHistogram
head:
noncomputable def samePureHistogram {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k r : ℕ) : Prop
text:
noncomputable def samePureHistogram {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  match c with
  | .joint =>
      Finset.univ.val.map (fun x : Fin k → V => jointColor (G.sum H) k r (Sum.inl ∘ x)) =
      Finset.univ.val.map (fun x : Fin k → W => jointColor (G.sum H) k r (Sum.inr ∘ x))
  | .separate =>
      Finset.univ.val.map (fun x : Fin k → V => separateColor (G.sum H) k r (Sum.inl ∘ x)) =
      Finset.univ.val.map (fun x : Fin k → W => separateColor (G.sum H) k r (Sum.inr ∘ x))

name: OAI.ParityWL.WLEquivalent
head:
noncomputable def WLEquivalent {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k : ℕ) : Prop
text:
noncomputable def WLEquivalent {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, sameHistogram G H c k r

name: OAI.ParityWL.PureWLEquivalent
head:
noncomputable def PureWLEquivalent {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k : ℕ) : Prop
text:
noncomputable def PureWLEquivalent {V W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (c : Convention) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, samePureHistogram G H c k r

name: OAI.ParityWL.ParityReductionStatement
head: noncomputable def ParityReductionStatement : Prop
text:
noncomputable def ParityReductionStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℕ), 4 ≤ k → ∀ c : Convention, ∀ C : ChoiceSystem (bagParameter c k),
    let T := template (bagParameter c k)
    let G := baseGraph C
    let τ := baseProjection C
    let V₀ := LiftVertex T G τ (fun _ => 0)
    let V₁ := LiftVertex T G τ (starParity (bagParameter c k))
    Fintype.card V₀ = Fintype.card V₁ ∧
    (∀ A : ℕ, 1 ≤ A → C.SizeAtMost A → Fintype.card V₀ ≤ A * orderFactor (bagParameter c k)) ∧
    (WLEquivalent (zeroLift C) (starLift C) c k ↔ ¬ C.Successful) ∧
    (PureWLEquivalent (zeroLift C) (starLift C) c k ↔ ¬ C.Successful) ∧
    (C.Successful → ¬ sameHistogram (zeroLift C) (starLift C) c k (detectionRound c) ∧
      ¬ samePureHistogram (zeroLift C) (starLift C) c k (detectionRound c))

name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.MonoAP

text:
def MonoAP {α : Type u} (c : ℕ → α) (k a d : ℕ) : Prop :=

name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.HasMonoAP

name: OAI.Erdos3.manuscript_targets_of_uniform_relative_lifting

theorem manuscript_targets_of_uniform_relative_lifting
    (hlifting : ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ n₀ : ℕ, 0 < n₀ ∧
      ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 / 2 →
        ∃ E : ℕ, 2 ≤ E ∧ RelativePatchPowerInductionRule (k - 2) n₀ (k - 2) τ E) :
    QuantitativeDensityTheorem ∧ ReciprocalProgressionTheorem

name: OAI.Erdos3.HasAP

def HasAP (A : Set ℕ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=

name: OAI.Erdos3.QuantitativeDensityBound
head: def QuantitativeDensityBound (k : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def QuantitativeDensityBound (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C c η : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < η ∧
    ∀ N : ℕ, 3 ≤ N →
      (extremalNumber k N : ℝ) ≤
        C * N * Real.exp (-c * (Real.log (Real.log N)) ^ (1 + η))

name: OAI.Erdos3.QuantitativeDensityTheorem

text:

  ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → QuantitativeDensityBound k

name: OAI.Erdos3.ReciprocalProgressionTheorem

name: OAI.Erdos3.exists_manuscriptRelativePatchPower

name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.RamseyProperty
head: def RamseyProperty (s t n : ℕ) : Prop

def RamseyProperty (s t n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n),

    (∃ B : Finset (Fin n), G.IsNIndepSet t B)

name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.SharpBounds
head: def SharpBounds : Prop
text:
def SharpBounds : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
    (t : ℝ) ^ 4 / Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3 + ε) ≤ (ramsey 5 t : ℝ) ∧
    (ramsey 5 t : ℝ) ≤ C * (t : ℝ) ^ 4 / (Real.log t) ^ 3

name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.SharpExponent
head: def SharpExponent : Prop
text:
def SharpExponent : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun t : ℕ => (4 * Real.log (t : ℝ) - Real.log (ramsey 5 t : ℝ)) /
      Real.log (Real.log (t : ℝ)))
    Filter.atTop (nhds (3 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.GoodVertex

name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.RamseyProperty

def RamseyProperty (s t N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin N),

    (∃ B : Finset (Fin N), Gᶜ.IsNClique t B)

name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.MainBounds
head: def MainBounds (s : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def MainBounds (s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      (t : ℝ) ^ (s - 1) / Real.rpow (Real.log (t : ℝ)) ((s - 2 : ℕ) + ε)
        ≤ (ramsey s t : ℝ) ∧
      (ramsey s t : ℝ) ≤ C * (t : ℝ) ^ (s - 1) /
        (Real.log (t : ℝ)) ^ (s - 2)

name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.MainLimit
head: def MainLimit (s : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def MainLimit (s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun t : ℕ =>
      (((s - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (t : ℝ) - Real.log (ramsey s t : ℝ)) /
        Real.log (Real.log (t : ℝ)))
    Filter.atTop (nhds ((s - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ))

name: OAI.GrahamSpherical.Specification.FullAuthoredResult

name: OAI.StrongThinTree.MultiGraph.SpanningTree

name: OAI.StrongThinTree.MainStatement

text:

  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → ∀ (n m : ℕ), 2 ≤ n →
    ∀ G : MultiGraph n m, G.EdgeConnected k →
      ∃ T : Finset (Fin m), G.SpanningTree T ∧
        ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), S.Nonempty → S ≠ Finset.univ →

name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLowerBound
doc: The binary main endpoint, for every sufficiently large cap (natural logarithms).
head: def BinaryLowerBound : Prop
text:
def BinaryLowerBound : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ d ∧ ∃ W : Finset (List Bool),
      2 ≤ W.card ∧ (∀ w ∈ W, w.length = n) ∧
      Real.exp (c * Real.sqrt (Real.log (d : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log (d : ℝ)))) ≤ c1 W

name: OAI.TreeEdit.FixedLengthBinaryConversion
doc: Exact polynomial-width code endpoint, including the stronger deficit inequality.
head: def FixedLengthBinaryConversion : Prop
text:
def FixedLengthBinaryConversion : Prop :=
  ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M : ℕ, M₀ ≤ M → ∀ (Γ : Type u) [Fintype Γ],
    1 ≤ Fintype.card Γ → Fintype.card Γ ≤ M →
    ∃ c : Γ → Word Bool (M ^ 2), ∀ x y : Word Γ M,
      (encode c x.val).length = M ^ 3 ∧
      (encode c y.val).length = M ^ 3 ∧
      ((M ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 804 * (ed x.val y.val : ℝ) ≤
        (ed (encode c x.val) (encode c y.val) : ℝ) ∧
      (ed (encode c x.val) (encode c y.val) : ℝ) ≤
        ((M ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (ed x.val y.val : ℝ) ∧
      ((M ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 402 * (deficit x.val y.val : ℝ) ≤
        (deficit (encode c x.val) (encode c y.val) : ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.HasTreeDecomposition
head: def HasTreeDecomposition [DecidableEq V] (k : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def HasTreeDecomposition [DecidableEq V] (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : SimpleGraph (Fin n), ∃ bag : Fin n → Finset V,
    T.IsTree ∧
    (∀ v : V, ∃ t, v ∈ bag t) ∧
    (∀ u v : V, G.Adj u v → ∃ t, u ∈ bag t ∧ v ∈ bag t) ∧
    (∀ v : V, (T.induce {t | v ∈ bag t}).Connected) ∧
    (∀ t, (bag t).card ≤ k)

name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.HasL1Embedding
doc: A map to genuine finite-dimensional real ℓ₁, not just a cut pseudometric.
head: def HasL1Embedding (ℓ : G.edgeSet → ℝ) (C : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def HasL1Embedding (ℓ : G.edgeSet → ℝ) (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ F : V → PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ),
    ∀ u v : V,
      shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v ≤ ‖F u - F v‖ ∧
      ‖F u - F v‖ ≤ C * shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v

      (∃ P : Polynomial ℕ, ∀ G,
        (encodeOutput (A G)).length ≤ P.eval (encodeInput G).length) ∧
      ∀ G, 0 < (A G).2 ∧

name: OAI.MeanPayoff.CorrectOutput
head: def CorrectOutput (G : Game) {M : Machine} (c : Configuration M) : Prop
text:
def CorrectOutput (G : Game) {M : Machine} (c : Configuration M) : Prop :=
  c.control = none ∧
  (∀ v : Fin G.n, c.tape 2 (v.val : ℤ) = some true ↔ Winning G v) ∧
  (∀ v : Fin G.n, c.tape 2 (v.val : ℤ) = some false ↔ ¬ Winning G v) ∧
  ∀ j : ℤ, (j < 0 ∨ (G.n : ℤ) ≤ j) → c.tape 2 j = none

name: OAI.MeanPayoff.MainClaim
head: noncomputable def MainClaim : Prop
text:

  classical
  exact ∃ M : Machine, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ G : Game, ∃ T : ℕ,
    (T : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (C * (Real.logb 2 ((input G).length + 2)) ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ bits : Fin T → Bool, (result M G T bits).control = none) ∧
    7 * 2 ^ T ≤ 8 * (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun bits : Fin T → Bool => CorrectOutput G (result M G T bits))).card

    ∀ n s : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ s → ∃ H : Output n,
      H.dimension ≤ C * (n + s + 1) ^ k ∧

text:
def Feasible {n : ℕ} (G : Instance n) (T : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, 1 ≤ τ v ∧ τ v ≤ T) ∧
  (∀ t, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun v => τ v = t)).card ≤ 3) ∧
  ∀ u v, G.edge u v → τ u < τ v

name: OAI.ThreeMachine.CorrectOutput
head:
def CorrectOutput {n : ℕ} (G : Instance n) (deadline : Option ℕ)
    (out : List Bool) : Prop
text:
def CorrectOutput {n : ℕ} (G : Instance n) (deadline : Option ℕ)
    (out : List Bool) : Prop :=
  match deadline with
  | none => ∃ T τ, Feasible G T τ ∧
      (∀ T' τ', Feasible G T' τ' → T ≤ T') ∧
      out = encodeAnswer (some (slots τ))
  | some T =>
      (out = encodeAnswer none ∧ ¬∃ τ, Feasible G T τ) ∨
      ∃ τ, Feasible G T τ ∧ out = encodeAnswer (some (slots τ))

name: OAI.ThreeMachine.Machine.Produces
head:
def Machine.Produces {k q g : ℕ} (M : Machine k q g)
    (input out : List Bool) (timeBound : ℕ) : Prop

def Machine.Produces {k q g : ℕ} (M : Machine k q g)
    (input out : List Bool) (timeBound : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ t ≤ timeBound, M.step (M.run input t) = none ∧
    ((M.run input t).tapes 0).right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (out.map bitSymbol)

name: OAI.ThreeMachine.ReleaseTheorem
head: def ReleaseTheorem : Prop
text:
def ReleaseTheorem : Prop :=
  ∃ (k q g : ℕ) (M : Machine k q g) (C : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
    ∀ n (G : Instance n), 1 ≤ n → G.acyclic →
      ∀ deadline : Option ℕ,
        (∀ T ∈ deadline, 1 ≤ T ∧ T ≤ n) →
        ∃ out, CorrectOutput G deadline out ∧
          M.Produces (encodeInput G deadline) out
            (C * ((encodeInput G deadline).length + 2) ^ 150020)

  ∃ t, (A.run n w t).answer = some true

name: OAI.WLTime.Model.halts
head: def Model.halts (A : Model) (n : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Prop
text:
def Model.halts (A : Model) (n : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Prop := match A with
  | .turing M => M.halts w
  | .ram M => M.halts n w

name: OAI.WLTime.Model.accepts
head: def Model.accepts (A : Model) (n : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Prop
text:
def Model.accepts (A : Model) (n : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Prop := match A with
  | .turing M => M.accepts w
  | .ram M => M.accepts n w

name: OAI.WLTime.InputClass.contains
head: def InputClass.contains (p : InputClass) {n : ℕ} (G H : Graph n) : Prop
text:
def InputClass.contains (p : InputClass) {n : ℕ} (G H : Graph n) : Prop := match p with
  | .unrestricted => True
  | .diameterTwo => G.diameterTwo ∧ H.diameterTwo

name: OAI.WLTime.Decides
head: def Decides (A : Model) (c : Convention) (k : ℕ) (p : InputClass) : Prop
text:
def Decides (A : Model) (c : Convention) (k : ℕ) (p : InputClass) : Prop :=
  ∀ n (G H : Graph n), p.contains G H →
    A.halts n (encodePair G H) ∧
      (A.accepts n (encodePair G H) ↔ Equivalent c k G H)

name: OAI.WLTime.MainClaim
head: def MainClaim : Prop
text:
def MainClaim : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, k₀ ≤ k →
    ∀ convention : Convention, ∀ p : InputClass, ∀ A : Model,
      Decides A convention k p → ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
        (n : ℝ) ^ (c * (k : ℝ)) ≤ (worstTime A p n : ℝ)

name: OAI.WitnessedChoice.BGS.Automorphism
head: def Automorphism (S : Input A) (g : Equiv.Perm A) : Prop
text:
def Automorphism (S : Input A) (g : Equiv.Perm A) : Prop :=
  ∀ r a b, S.rel r (g a) (g b) = S.rel r a b

name: OAI.WitnessedChoice.BGS.ChoicePrefix
head:
def ChoicePrefix (step : HF A → HF A → Result (HF A))
    (choice : HF A → Result (HF A)) (b c : ℕ → HF A) (k : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def ChoicePrefix (step : HF A → HF A → Result (HF A))
    (choice : HF A → Result (HF A)) (b c : ℕ → HF A) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  b 0 = emptyHF ∧ ∀ i < k,
    (∃ D, choice (b i) = some D ∧ c i ∈ elements D) ∧
    step (b i) (c i) = some (b (i+1))

name: OAI.WitnessedChoice.BGS.StrictPrefix
head: def StrictPrefix (b : ℕ → HF A) (k : ℕ) : Prop
text: def StrictPrefix (b : ℕ → HF A) (k : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ i < k, b i ≠ b (i+1)

name: OAI.WitnessedChoice.BGS.FirstPath

    (choice : HF A → Result (HF A)) (b c : ℕ → HF A) (t : ℕ) : Prop

name: OAI.WitnessedChoice.BGS.FixesParameters
head:
def FixesParameters {n : ℕ} (free : Finset (Fin n)) (env : Fin n → HF A)
    (g : Equiv.Perm A) : Prop
text:
def FixesParameters {n : ℕ} (free : Finset (Fin n)) (env : Fin n → HF A)
    (g : Equiv.Perm A) : Prop := ∀ i ∈ free, g • env i = env i

name: OAI.WitnessedChoice.BGS.WitnessesHistory
head:
def WitnessesHistory {n : ℕ} (S : Input A) (free : Finset (Fin n))
    (env : Fin n → HF A) (b : ℕ → HF A) (i : ℕ) (D M : HF A) : Prop
text:
def WitnessesHistory {n : ℕ} (S : Input A) (free : Finset (Fin n))
    (env : Fin n → HF A) (b : ℕ → HF A) (i : ℕ) (D M : HF A) : Prop :=
  isSet M = true ∧
  (∀ w ∈ elements M, ∃ g : Equiv.Perm A,
    w = permutationGraph g ∧ Automorphism S g ∧ FixesParameters free env g ∧
      ∀ j ≤ i, g • b j = b j) ∧
  (∀ u ∈ elements D, ∀ v ∈ elements D, ∃ g : Equiv.Perm A,
    permutationGraph g ∈ elements M ∧ g • u = v)

name: OAI.WitnessedChoice.BGS.GoodWSC
head:
def GoodWSC {n : ℕ} (S : Input A) (p : ℕ) (free : Finset (Fin n))
    (env : Fin n → HF A) (step : HF A → HF A → Result (HF A))
    (choice : HF A → Result (HF A)) (witness : HF A → HF A → Result (HF A))
    (output : HF A → Result Bool) : Prop
text:
def GoodWSC {n : ℕ} (S : Input A) (p : ℕ) (free : Finset (Fin n))
    (env : Fin n → HF A) (step : HF A → HF A → Result (HF A))
    (choice : HF A → Result (HF A)) (witness : HF A → HF A → Result (HF A))
    (output : HF A → Result Bool) : Prop :=
  (∀ b c k, ChoicePrefix step choice b c k → StrictPrefix b k →
    k ≤ p ∧ (TC (b k)).card ≤ p ∧ ∃ D, choice (b k) = some D ∧
      (elements D).Nonempty ∧ ∀ u ∈ elements D, (step (b k) u).isSome) ∧
  (∀ b c t, FirstPath step choice b c t → t+2 ≤ p ∧
    (∀ i ≤ t, ∃ D M, choice (b i) = some D ∧ witness (b t) (b i) = some M ∧
      WitnessesHistory S free env b i D M) ∧ (output (b t)).isSome)

name: OAI.TriangularBilliards.Triangle.HasIrrationalAngle

name: OAI.TriangularBilliards.MainConclusion
doc: The main conclusion, together with the geometric/nonvacuity guarantees needed by the concrete definition of the actual two-sided billiard.
head: def MainConclusion (Q : Triangle) : Prop
text:
def MainConclusion (Q : Triangle) : Prop :=
  phaseMeasure Q univ = 1 ∧
  (∀ᵐ z ∂phaseMeasure Q, Nonempty (FlightChain Q z)) ∧
  (∀ (z : Phase) (c d : FlightChain Q z), c = d) ∧
  (∀ t : ℝ, MeasurePreserving (billiardFlow Q t) (phaseMeasure Q) (phaseMeasure Q)) ∧
  (∀ s t : ℝ, billiardFlow Q (s + t) =ᵐ[phaseMeasure Q]
    (billiardFlow Q s ∘ billiardFlow Q t)) ∧
  (∀ A : Set Phase, MeasurableSet A →
    (∀ t : ℝ, phaseMeasure Q (((billiardFlow Q t) ⁻¹' A) ∆ A) = 0) →
    phaseMeasure Q A = 0 ∨ phaseMeasure Q A = 1)

name: OAI.ArnoldCounterexample.IsUnitQuadric
head: def IsUnitQuadric (z : CV) : Prop
text:
def IsUnitQuadric (z : CV) : Prop :=
  normSquared z = 1 ∧ quadricPolynomial z = 0

name: OAI.ArnoldCounterexample.Horizontal
doc: Horizontal lifts of the real tangent of Q3 at [z].
head: def Horizontal (z v : CV) : Prop
text:
def Horizontal (z v : CV) : Prop :=
  (∑ j, star (z j) * v j) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, z j * v j) = 0

name: OAI.ArnoldCounterexample.LocalFunctionLift
doc: A local smooth extension of the pullback of h to the unit isotropic cone.
head:
def LocalFunctionLift (h : Q3 → ℝ) (z : UnitQuadric)
    (U : Set CV) (g : CV → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def LocalFunctionLift (h : Q3 → ℝ) (z : UnitQuadric)
    (U : Set CV) (g : CV → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsOpen U ∧ (z : CV) ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U ∧
    ∀ y : UnitQuadric, (y : CV) ∈ U → g y = h (project y)

name: OAI.ArnoldCounterexample.IsSmoothFunction
head: def IsSmoothFunction (h : Q3 → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsSmoothFunction (h : Q3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ z : UnitQuadric, ∃ (U : Set CV) (g : CV → ℝ), LocalFunctionLift h z U g

name: OAI.ArnoldCounterexample.IsCritical
doc: dh_q = 0, expressed using all local lifts, independent of normal extensions.
head: def IsCritical (h : Q3 → ℝ) (q : Q3) : Prop
text:
def IsCritical (h : Q3 → ℝ) (q : Q3) : Prop :=
  ∀ z : UnitQuadric, project z = q →
    ∀ (U : Set CV) (g : CV → ℝ), LocalFunctionLift h z U g →
      ∀ v : CV, Horizontal z v → fderiv ℝ g z v = 0

name: OAI.ArnoldCounterexample.IsHamiltonian
head: def IsHamiltonian (φ : Q3 ≃ Q3) : Prop
text: def IsHamiltonian (φ : Q3 ≃ Q3) : Prop := Nonempty (HamiltonianPath φ)

name: OAI.ArnoldCounterexample.HasDegenerateFixedPoint
doc: Eigenvalue 1 in the derivative on the quotient tangent, not an ambient spurious vertical eigenvector. v is nonzero and horizontal.
head: def HasDegenerateFixedPoint (φ : Q3 ≃ Q3) : Prop
text:
def HasDegenerateFixedPoint (φ : Q3 ≃ Q3) : Prop :=
  ∃ (z : UnitQuadric) (v : CV), φ (project z) = project z ∧ v ≠ 0 ∧
    Horizontal z v ∧ ∃ (U : Set CV) (G : CV → CV),
      IsOpen U ∧ (z : CV) ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U ∧ G z = z ∧
      (∀ y : UnitQuadric, (y : CV) ∈ U →
        ∃ hy : IsUnitQuadric (G y), project ⟨G y, hy⟩ = φ (project y)) ∧
      ∃ a : ℝ, fderiv ℝ G z v - v = a • (Complex.I • (z : CV))

name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.IsCAT0
head: def IsCAT0 : Prop
text:
def IsCAT0 : Prop :=
  ∃ segment : X → X → ℝ → X,
    (∀ x y, segment x y 0 = x ∧ segment x y 1 = y) ∧
    (∀ x y s t, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      dist (segment x y s) (segment x y t) = |s - t| * dist x y) ∧
    (∀ o x y s t, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      dist (segment o x s) (segment o y t) ^ 2 ≤
        (s * dist o x - t * dist o y) ^ 2 +
          s * t * ((dist x y) ^ 2 - (dist o x - dist o y) ^ 2))

name: OAI.CannonRelease.CayleyData.ThinTriangles
doc: A uniform thinness constant for geodesic triangles in the Cayley graph.
head: def CayleyData.ThinTriangles {G : Type u} [Group G] (D : CayleyData G) : Prop
text:
def CayleyData.ThinTriangles {G : Type u} [Group G] (D : CayleyData G) : Prop :=
  ∃ δ : ℕ, ∀ x y z : G,
    ∀ p : D.graph.Walk x y, ∀ q : D.graph.Walk y z, ∀ r : D.graph.Walk z x,
      p.length = D.graph.dist x y → q.length = D.graph.dist y z →
      r.length = D.graph.dist z x →
      ∀ a ∈ p.support, ∃ b ∈ q.support ++ r.support, D.graph.dist a b ≤ δ

name: OAI.TranslativeCovering.CentrallySymmetric

name: OAI.CoveringOrder.OptimalOrder
doc: All four extremal quantities have common absolute positive comparison constants. ENNReal bounds imply finiteness rather than mapping a potentially infinite density to zero through `toReal`.
head: def OptimalOrder : Prop
text:
def OptimalOrder : Prop :=
  ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
    orderBounds c C n (translativeSup n) ∧
    orderBounds c C n (symmetricTranslativeSup n) ∧
    orderBounds c C n (latticeSup n) ∧
    orderBounds c C n (symmetricLatticeSup n)

name: OAI.TranslativeCovering.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
    ∃ K : Set (Space n), ConvexBody K ∧ CentrallySymmetric K ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (c * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ)) < thetaT K

name: OAI.CubicTorus.AdmissibleField
doc: The smooth vector fields on the flat torus with pointwise length at most one, expressed as Z³-periodic fields on its Euclidean cover. The explicit ℕ∞ index is C^∞; top of WithTop ℕ∞ would instead mean analytic in this Mathlib.
head: def AdmissibleField (F : Cover → Cover) : Prop
text:
def AdmissibleField (F : Cover → Cover) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F ∧
  (∀ (n : Fin 3 → ℤ) (x : Cover), F (x + latticeVector n) = F x) ∧
  ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.CubicTorus.FinitePerimeter
doc: Finite-perimeter measurable regions, including all null-set modifications.
head: def FinitePerimeter (E : Set Torus) : Prop
text:
def FinitePerimeter (E : Set Torus) : Prop :=
  NullMeasurableSet E torusVolume ∧ perimeter E < ⊤

name: OAI.CubicTorus.IsMinimizerAt
doc: A global perimeter minimizer under the prescribed volume constraint.
head: def IsMinimizerAt (V : ℝ) (E : Set Torus) : Prop
text:
def IsMinimizerAt (V : ℝ) (E : Set Torus) : Prop :=
  FinitePerimeter E ∧ torusVolume E = ENNReal.ofReal V ∧
  ∀ F : Set Torus, FinitePerimeter F → torusVolume F = ENNReal.ofReal V →
    perimeter E ≤ perimeter F

name: OAI.CubicTorus.CongruentAE
doc: Equality of regions up to ambient flat isometry and a null set.
head: def CongruentAE (E F : Set Torus) : Prop
text:
def CongruentAE (E F : Set Torus) : Prop :=
  ∃ φ : Torus ≃ᵢ Torus, E =ᵐ[torusVolume] (φ '' F)

name: OAI.CubicTorus.SmallStandardRegion
doc: Exactly the closed phase ranges, so adjacent types are BOTH included at ties.
head: def SmallStandardRegion (V : ℝ) (E : Set Torus) : Prop
text:
def SmallStandardRegion (V : ℝ) (E : Set Torus) : Prop :=
  (V ≤ 4 * Real.pi / 81 ∧ CongruentAE E (canonicalBall V)) ∨
  (4 * Real.pi / 81 ≤ V ∧ V ≤ 1 / Real.pi ∧ CongruentAE E (canonicalTube V)) ∨
  (1 / Real.pi ≤ V ∧ CongruentAE E (canonicalSlab V))

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.DoublingAtMost
doc: Intrinsic open-ball doubling with a specified integer bound and centers in the subset.
head: def DoublingAtMost (S : Set RealL2) (bound : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def DoublingAtMost (S : Set RealL2) (bound : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : S, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
    ∃ centers : Finset S, centers.card ≤ bound ∧
      ∀ y : S, dist y x < r → ∃ c ∈ centers, dist y c < r / 2

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.AdmitsBiLipschitzEmbedding
doc: Finite distortion includes an arbitrary positive change of scale.
head: def AdmitsBiLipschitzEmbedding (S : Set RealL2) (k : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def AdmitsBiLipschitzEmbedding (S : Set RealL2) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : S → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k),
    ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ ∃ D : ℝ, 1 ≤ D ∧
      ∀ x y : S, a * dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y) ∧
        dist (f x) (f y) ≤ D * a * dist x y

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.HolomorphicProjection
head: def HolomorphicProjection {X : ComplexManifold.{u} n} (P : ProjectionField X) : Prop
text:
def HolomorphicProjection {X : ComplexManifold.{u} n} (P : ProjectionField X) : Prop :=
  ∀ c, DifferentiableOn ℂ (projectionInChart P c) (extChartAt (model n) c).target

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.Integrable
head: def Integrable {X : ComplexManifold.{u} n} (P : ProjectionField X) : Prop
text:
def Integrable {X : ComplexManifold.{u} n} (P : ProjectionField X) : Prop :=
  ∀ c U, IsOpen U → U ⊆ (extChartAt (model n) c).target →
    ∀ V W : Model n → Model n,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ V U → DifferentiableOn ℂ W U →
      (∀ z ∈ U, projectionInChart P c z (V z) = V z) →
      (∀ z ∈ U, projectionInChart P c z (W z) = W z) →
      ∀ z ∈ U, projectionInChart P c z (VectorField.lieBracket ℂ V W z) =
        VectorField.lieBracket ℂ V W z

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.LocalBiholomorphism
head:
def LocalBiholomorphism {X : ComplexManifold.{u} n} {Z : ComplexManifold.{v} n}
    (π : Z.Carrier → X.Carrier) : Prop
text:
def LocalBiholomorphism {X : ComplexManifold.{u} n} {Z : ComplexManifold.{v} n}
    (π : Z.Carrier → X.Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ z, ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph Z.Carrier X.Carrier,
    z ∈ e.source ∧ (∀ w ∈ e.source, e w = π w) ∧
      MDifferentiableOn (model n) (model n) e e.source ∧
      MDifferentiableOn (model n) (model n) e.symm e.target

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.CompatibleProduct
text:
def CompatibleProduct {X : ComplexManifold.{u} n} {Z : ComplexManifold.{v} n}
    (S : HolomorphicSplitting X r₁ r₂) (π : OrdinaryUniversalCover X Z)
    (Y₁ : ComplexManifold.{v} r₁) (Y₂ : ComplexManifold.{v} r₂) : Prop :=
  ∃ Φ : Z.Carrier ≃ₜ (Y₁.Carrier × Y₂.Carrier),
    MDifferentiable (model n) ((model r₁).prod (model r₂)) Φ ∧
    MDifferentiable ((model r₁).prod (model r₂)) (model n) Φ.symm ∧
    (∀ z, Submodule.map
      (mfderiv (model n) ((model r₁).prod (model r₂)) Φ z).toLinearMap
      (Submodule.comap (mfderiv (model n) (model n) π.projection z).toLinearMap
        (LinearMap.range (S.projection (π.projection z)).toLinearMap)) =
      LinearMap.ker (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ (Model r₁) (Model r₂)).toLinearMap) ∧
    (∀ z, Submodule.map
      (mfderiv (model n) ((model r₁).prod (model r₂)) Φ z).toLinearMap
      (Submodule.comap (mfderiv (model n) (model n) π.projection z).toLinearMap
        (LinearMap.ker (S.projection (π.projection z)).toLinearMap)) =
      LinearMap.ker (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ (Model r₁) (Model r₂)).toLinearMap)

name: OAI.Yau.Target.MainTarget
head: def MainTarget : Prop
text:
def MainTarget : Prop :=
  ∃ (g : SmoothMetric) (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (u : ℕ → Manifold5 → ℝ),
    (∀ k, 0 < lam k) ∧
    (∀ k, u k ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ k, ContMDiff modelWithCorners 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u k)) ∧
    (∀ k x, -chartLaplacian g (extChartAt modelWithCorners x) (u k) ((extChartAt modelWithCorners x) x) =
      lam k * u k x) ∧
    Tendsto lam atTop atTop ∧
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ nodalMeasure g (u k) / ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (lam k)))
      atTop (𝓝 ⊤)

name: OAI.PeriodicTilingThree.HasTileWithoutPeriodicComplement

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.IsPowerPullbackTwist
head:
def IsPowerPullbackTwist (G : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle) (m : ℕ)
    (E : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle) : Prop
text:
def IsPowerPullbackTwist (G : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle) (m : ℕ)
    (E : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle) : Prop :=
  E.numberOfCharts=G.numberOfCharts ∧ E.chart=G.chart ∧
  (∀ i, E.equation i = (MvPolynomial.bind₁ fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.X j ^ m) (G.equation i)) ∧
  ∀ i j x, x ∈ E.domain i → x ∈ E.domain j →
    E.transition i j x = polarizationTransition (G.chart i) (G.chart j) x •
      G.transition i j (powerQuadric m x)

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.ProjectiveAlgebraicCone
head: def ProjectiveAlgebraicCone {N : ℕ} (C : Set (Fin N → ℂ)) : Prop

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.GivesClosedProjectiveEmbedding
head:
def GivesClosedProjectiveEmbedding {V : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle} {n N : ℕ}
    (s : Fin N → SymmetricSection V n) : Prop
text:
def GivesClosedProjectiveEmbedding {V : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle} {n N : ℕ}
    (s : Fin N → SymmetricSection V n) : Prop :=
  (∀ i x, x ∈ V.domain i → ∀ v : FiberCoordinates, v ≠ 0 → sectionVector s i x v ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ i j x y, x ∈ V.domain i → y ∈ V.domain j → ∀ v w : FiberCoordinates,
    v ≠ 0 → w ≠ 0 → (∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧ sectionVector s i x v = c • sectionVector s j y w) →
    x=y ∧ ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧ v=c • ((V.dualTransition i j x).mulVec w)) ∧
  ProjectiveAlgebraicCone ({0} ∪ {a | ∃ i x, x ∈ V.domain i ∧
    ∃ v : FiberCoordinates, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧ a=c • sectionVector s i x v}) ∧
  ∀ i x, x ∈ V.domain i → ∀ v : FiberCoordinates, v ≠ 0 →
    ∃ j : Fin N, ∃ b : Fin 2, v b ≠ 0 ∧ sectionVector s i x v j ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ p q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℂ,
      (∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval (fun l ↦ sectionVector s i x v l / sectionVector s i x v j) (q k) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ i' x', x' ∈ V.domain i' → ∀ v' : FiberCoordinates, v' ≠ 0 →
        sectionVector s i' x' v' j ≠ 0 →
        (∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval (fun l ↦ sectionVector s i' x' v' l / sectionVector s i' x' v' j) (q k) ≠ 0) →
        x' ∈ V.domain i ∧ ((V.dualTransition i i' x').mulVec v') b ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ k : Fin 3,
          (![ (coordQuadric (V.chart i) x').1, (coordQuadric (V.chart i) x').2,
             ((V.dualTransition i i' x').mulVec v') (1-b) /
               ((V.dualTransition i i' x').mulVec v') b ] : Fin 3 → ℂ) k =
          MvPolynomial.eval (fun l ↦ sectionVector s i' x' v' l / sectionVector s i' x' v' j) (p k) /
          MvPolynomial.eval (fun l ↦ sectionVector s i' x' v' l / sectionVector s i' x' v' j) (q k))

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.IsAmple

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.SmoothHermitianMetric.StrictlyGriffithsPositive
head:
def SmoothHermitianMetric.StrictlyGriffithsPositive {V : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle}
    (h : SmoothHermitianMetric V) : Prop
text:
def SmoothHermitianMetric.StrictlyGriffithsPositive {V : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle}
    (h : SmoothHermitianMetric V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i z, z ∈ V.coordinateDomain i → ∀ u : BaseCoordinates, u ≠ 0 →
    (metricMixedHessian (h.dualMatrix i) z u -
      (holomorphicMetricDerivative (h.dualMatrix i) z u).conjTranspose *
        (h.dualMatrix i z)⁻¹ * holomorphicMetricDerivative (h.dualMatrix i) z u).PosDef

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.SourceMainTheorem
head: def SourceMainTheorem : Prop
text:
def SourceMainTheorem : Prop :=
  ∃ G : AlgebraicRankTwoBundle, ∃ E : ℕ → AlgebraicRankTwoBundle,
    (∀ m, 0 < m → IsPowerPullbackTwist G m (E m)) ∧
    (∀ m, 0 < m → IsAmple (E m)) ∧
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, 0 < m₀ ∧ ∀ m, m₀ ≤ m →
      ¬ ∃ h : SmoothHermitianMetric (E m), h.StrictlyGriffithsPositive

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.RicciNonnegative
head: def RicciNonnegative (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop
text:
def RicciNonnegative (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop :=
  ∀ x v : E3, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, g.ricci x i j * v i * v j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.Complete
head: def Complete (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop
text:
def Complete (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : ℕ → E3,
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, N ≤ m → N ≤ n →
      g.distance (x m) (x n) < ε) →
    ∃ y : E3, Tendsto (fun n ↦ g.distance (x n) y) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.EuclideanNearOrigin
head: def EuclideanNearOrigin (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop
text:
def EuclideanNearOrigin (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop :=
  ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < ε → g.coeff x = 1

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.PolynomialGrowth
head: def PolynomialGrowth (g : SmoothMetric3) (k : ℕ) (f : E3 → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def PolynomialGrowth (g : SmoothMetric3) (k : ℕ) (f : E3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C * (1 + g.distance 0 x)^k

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.HasAVR
head: def HasAVR (g : SmoothMetric3) (a : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.NegativeRadialSequence
head: def NegativeRadialSequence (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop
text:
def NegativeRadialSequence (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop :=
  ∃ x : ℕ → E3, ∃ w : ℕ → E3,
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ g.distance 0 (x n)) atTop atTop ∧
    ∀ n, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g.distance 0) (x n) ∧
      0 < g.sectionDenominator (x n) (g.radialVector (x n)) (w n) ∧
      g.sectionNumerator (x n) (g.radialVector (x n)) (w n) < 0

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.IsTangentConeAtInfinity
head:
def IsTangentConeAtInfinity (g : SmoothMetric3) (Y : Type) [MetricSpace Y]
    [ProperSpace Y] (o : Y) : Prop
text:
def IsTangentConeAtInfinity (g : SmoothMetric3) (Y : Type) [MetricSpace Y]
    [ProperSpace Y] (o : Y) : Prop :=
  ∃ R : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < R n) ∧ Tendsto R atTop atTop ∧
    ∀ L ε : ℝ, 0 < L → 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ F : E3 → Y, F 0 = o ∧
        (∀ x y : E3, g.distance 0 x ≤ R n * L → g.distance 0 y ≤ R n * L →
          |dist (F x) (F y) - g.distance x y / R n| < ε) ∧
        (∀ y : Y, dist o y ≤ L - ε →
          ∃ x : E3, g.distance 0 x ≤ R n * L ∧ dist (F x) y < ε)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.SmoothMetric3.TwoNonisometricTangentCones
head: def TwoNonisometricTangentCones (g : SmoothMetric3) : Prop

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Main.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ k₀ : ℤ, 0 ≤ k₀ ∧ ∀ k : ℤ, k₀ ≤ k → ∃ g : SmoothMetric3,
    g.Complete ∧ g.EuclideanNearOrigin ∧ g.RicciNonnegative ∧
    ((k.toNat+2)^2 : Cardinal) ≤ g.harmonicDimension k.toNat ∧
    ((k.toNat+1)^2 : Cardinal.{0}) < ((k.toNat+2)^2 : Cardinal.{0}) ∧
    euclidean.harmonicDimension k.toNat = ((k.toNat+1)^2 : Cardinal) ∧
    g.HasAVR ((24/25 : ℝ)^2) ∧ g.TwoNonisometricTangentCones ∧
    g.NegativeRadialSequence

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.Cylinder.triangle

text: def triangle (C : Cylinder) : Prop := IsTriangle C.base

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.Cylinder.openBounded
