def openBounded (C : Cylinder) : Prop :=
  IsOpen C.base ∧ Bornology.IsBounded C.base ∧ MeasurableSet C.base

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.HasFiniteCover
head: def HasFiniteCover (shape : Cylinder → Prop) (S : Set Space) (A : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.SmoothNear
doc: No boundary hypothesis is included in this neighborhood regularity predicate.
head: def SmoothNear (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane) : Prop
text:
def SmoothNear (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : Set Plane, IsOpen U ∧ D ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ n v U

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.HyperbolicAt
doc: In dimension two these two distinct nonzero eigenvalues are all the eigenvalues.
head: def HyperbolicAt (L : ℝ) (v : Plane → Plane) (p : Plane) : Prop
text:
def HyperbolicAt (L : ℝ) (v : Plane → Plane) (p : Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ lam : ℝ, 0 < L * lam ∧ L * lam < 1 ∧
    Module.End.HasEigenvalue (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap lam ∧
    Module.End.HasEigenvalue (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap (-lam)

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.HyperbolicStatement
head: def HyperbolicStatement : Prop
text:
def HyperbolicStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane) (L : ℝ),
    IsCompact D → SmoothNear 1 D v → 0 < L →
    (∀ p ∈ D, HyperbolicAt L v p) →
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → HasFiniteCover Cylinder.parallelogram (ruled D v L)
      ((∫ p in D, weight (v p)) + e)

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.PhysicalHyperbolicStatement
head: def PhysicalHyperbolicStatement : Prop
text:
def PhysicalHyperbolicStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (h L : ℝ) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane),
    0 < h → 0 < L → IsCompact D → SmoothNear 1 D v →
    (∀ p ∈ D, HyperbolicAt L v p) →
    ∀ (e : ℝ), 0 < e → ∀ F : Space ≃ᵢ Space,
    HasFiniteCover Cylinder.parallelogram (F '' physicalRuled h D v L)
      (h * (∫ p in D, physicalWeight h (v p)) + e)

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.OpenRectangleC2
head: def OpenRectangleC2 (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.LogarithmicStatement
head: def LogarithmicStatement : Prop
text:
def LogarithmicStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (X k : ℝ) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane),
    0 < X → 0 < k → IsCompact D → volume (frontier D) = 0 →
    OpenRectangleC2 D v →
    (∀ p ∈ D, LinearMap.trace ℝ Plane (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap = 0 ∧
      LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap < 0 ∧
      k * X * Real.sqrt (-LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap) < 1) →
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → HasFiniteCover Cylinder.openBounded
      (physicalRuled 1 D (fun p => k • v p) X)
      ((∫ p in D, 1 / Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2 * ‖v p‖ ^ 2)) + e)

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.ProductCellStatement
head: def ProductCellStatement : Prop
text:
def ProductCellStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (h M : ℝ) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane),
    0 < h → 0 < M → IsCompact D → volume (frontier D) = 0 →
    SmoothNear 1 D v → (∀ p ∈ D, HyperbolicAt M v p) →
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → HasFiniteCover Cylinder.openBounded (physicalRuled h D v M)
      (h * (∫ p in D, physicalWeight h (v p)) + e)

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.OrthogonalGridStatement
head: def OrthogonalGridStatement : Prop
text:
def OrthogonalGridStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane) (kappa : ℝ),
    IsCompact D → volume (frontier D) = 0 → SmoothNear 1 D v → kappa < 1 →
    (∀ p ∈ D, LinearMap.trace ℝ Plane (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap = 0 ∧
      LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap < 0 ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ v p‖ ≤ kappa) →
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → HasFiniteCover Cylinder.parallelogram
      (physicalRuled (Real.sqrt 2) D v 1)
      (Real.sqrt 2 * (∫ p in D,
        1 / Real.sqrt (1 + v p 0 ^ 2 + 2 * v p 1 ^ 2)) + e)

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.IsSquareTile
head: def IsSquareTile (T : Set Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.NilpotentStatement
head: def NilpotentStatement : Prop
text:
def NilpotentStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : Set Plane) (G : Plane → Plane), IsCompact D → SmoothNear ∞ D G →
    (∀ b ∈ D, (fderiv ℝ G b).comp (fderiv ℝ G b) = 0) →
    ∀ h eps : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < eps →
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : Fin n → Set Plane, ∃ g : Fin n → Plane,
      (∀ i, IsSquareTile (T i)) ∧
      physicalRuled 1 D G 1 ⊆ ⋃ i, auxiliaryCylinder (T i) (g i) ∧
      (∑ i, volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i)) ≤
        (∫ b in D, physicalWeight h (G b)) + eps ∧
      ∀ a : ℝ, ∃ C₁ C₂ : Fin n → Cylinder,
        (∀ i, (C₁ i).parallelogram ∧ (C₂ i).parallelogram ∧
          (C₁ i).carrier = firstPhysicalMap h '' auxiliaryCylinder (T i) (g i) ∧
          (C₂ i).carrier = secondPhysicalMap h a '' auxiliaryCylinder (T i) (g i) ∧
          (C₁ i).area = h * volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i) ∧
          (C₂ i).area = h * volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i))

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.SingularStatement
head: def SingularStatement : Prop
text:
def SingularStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ p gamma : ℝ, 1 < p → p < (Real.sqrt 51 - 5) / 2 →
    1 < gamma → gamma < 1 / (2 - p) →
    singularCoefficient p < 0 ∧
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (fun c => 2 * singularCost p gamma c + 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * (c ^ gamma) ^ 2 -
        (Real.sqrt 2 / 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * singularCoefficient p * c ^ 2))
      (fun c => c ^ 2) ∧
    ∀ᶠ c : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
      ∃ n m : ℕ, ∃ C : Fin n → Cylinder, ∃ D : Fin m → Cylinder,
      ∃ B₁ B₂ : Cylinder,
        (∀ i, (C i).parallelogram) ∧ (∀ j, (D j).parallelogram) ∧
        B₁.triangle ∧ B₂.triangle ∧
        singularLower p gamma c ⊆ familySet C ∧
        singularUpper p gamma c ⊆ familySet D ∧
        B₁.carrier = lowerTip (c ^ gamma) ∧ B₂.carrier = upperTip (c ^ gamma) ∧
        tetrahedron ⊆ familySet C ∪ familySet D ∪ B₁.carrier ∪ B₂.carrier ∧
        familyArea C + familyArea D + B₁.area + B₂.area < Real.sqrt 2 / 2

name: OAI.RuledApproximation.FullMain
head: def FullMain : Prop

name: OAI.YauCounterexamples.IsSmoothNeighborhood
doc: The finite compact-chart derivative tests defining a C∞ neighborhood. A single positive tolerance suffices for the finitely many tests.
head: def IsSmoothNeighborhood (g₀ : SmoothMetric E M) (N : Set (SmoothMetric E M)) : Prop
text:
def IsSmoothNeighborhood (g₀ : SmoothMetric E M) (N : Set (SmoothMetric E M)) : Prop :=
  ∃ tests : List (CoordinateTest E M), ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
    ∀ g : SmoothMetric E M,
      (∀ t ∈ tests, ∀ y ∈ t.compactSet,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ t.order
          (fun z => metricCoefficients g t.center z t.row t.column -
            metricCoefficients g₀ t.center z t.row t.column) y‖ < ε) → g ∈ N

name: OAI.YauCounterexamples.HasUnboundedNodalRatio
doc: The eigensequence belongs to one fixed metric and has finite nodal measure.
head: def HasUnboundedNodalRatio [T3Space M] (g : SmoothMetric E M) (d : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def HasUnboundedNodalRatio [T3Space M] (g : SmoothMetric E M) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u : ℕ → M → ℝ) (eigenvalue : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ j, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u j) ∧ u j ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < eigenvalue j ∧
      (∀ x, -laplaceBeltrami g (u j) x = eigenvalue j * u j x) ∧
      nodalMeasure g (d - 1 : ℕ) (u j) ≠ (∞ : ℝ≥0∞)) ∧
    Tendsto eigenvalue atTop atTop ∧
    Tendsto (fun j => (nodalMeasure g (d - 1 : ℕ) (u j)).toReal / Real.sqrt (eigenvalue j))
      atTop atTop

name: OAI.YauCounterexamples.IsRound
doc: The round metric is the pullback of the Euclidean scalar product under inclusion of the unit sphere. This predicate specifies exactly that tensor.
head: def IsRound (g : SmoothMetric (Euclidean 3) (Sphere 3)) : Prop
text:
def IsRound (g : SmoothMetric (Euclidean 3) (Sphere 3)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Sphere 3) (v w : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Euclidean 3) x),
    g.inner x v w = inner ℝ
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, Euclidean 3) 𝓘(ℝ, Euclidean 4)
        (fun y : Sphere 3 => (y : Euclidean 4)) x v)
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, Euclidean 3) 𝓘(ℝ, Euclidean 4)
        (fun y : Sphere 3 => (y : Euclidean 4)) x w)

name: OAI.StableBernstein.W02.IsSmoothCompactTest
head: def IsSmoothCompactTest (η : M → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsSmoothCompactTest (η : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ η ∧ HasCompactSupport η

name: OAI.StableBernstein.W02.IntrinsicStability
head: def IntrinsicStability (μ : Measure M) (V : M → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.StableBernstein.W01.HasInducedRiemannianMetric
head:
def HasInducedRiemannianMetric (F : M → E7)
    [Bundle.RiemannianBundle (fun x : M ↦ TangentSpace I6 x)] : Prop
text:
def HasInducedRiemannianMetric (F : M → E7)
    [Bundle.RiemannianBundle (fun x : M ↦ TangentSpace I6 x)] : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I6 x),
    (Bundle.RiemannianBundle.g (E := fun x : M ↦ TangentSpace I6 x)).inner x v w =
      inducedMetric F x v w

name: OAI.StableBernstein.W18.ApproximateMidpoints
head: def ApproximateMidpoints (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] : Prop

name: OAI.StableBernstein.W01.Minimal
head: def Minimal (F ν : M → E7) : Prop
text: def Minimal (F ν : M → E7) : Prop := ∀ x, meanCurvatureTrace F ν x = 0

name: OAI.StableBernstein.W03.CanonicallyCompleteInducedMetric
head: def CanonicallyCompleteInducedMetric {F : M → E7} (hF : SmoothImmersion F) : Prop

name: OAI.StableBernstein.FullConclusion
head:
def FullConclusion {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E6 M]
    (F ν : M → E7) : Prop
text:
def FullConclusion {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E6 M]
    (F ν : M → E7) : Prop :=
  (∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I6 x), secondFundamentalForm F ν x v w = 0) ∧
  ∃ P : AffineSubspace ℝ E7,
    Module.finrank ℝ P.direction = 6 ∧ Set.range F = (P : Set E7)

name: OAI.StableBernstein.RiemannianGeometricStability
head:
def RiemannianGeometricStability {M : Type u}
    [MetricSpace M] [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace E6 M] [IsManifold I6 ∞ M]
    [SecondCountableTopology M] [Nonempty M]
    [Bundle.RiemannianBundle (fun x : M ↦ TangentSpace I6 x)]
    (F ν : M → E7) : Prop
text:
def RiemannianGeometricStability {M : Type u}
    [MetricSpace M] [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace E6 M] [IsManifold I6 ∞ M]
    [SecondCountableTopology M] [Nonempty M]
    [Bundle.RiemannianBundle (fun x : M ↦ TangentSpace I6 x)]
    (F ν : M → E7) : Prop :=
  IntrinsicStability I6 (riemannianVolume F) (curvatureNormSq F ν)

name: OAI.StableBernstein.IntrinsicStableBernstein
head: def IntrinsicStableBernstein : Prop
text:
def IntrinsicStableBernstein : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M]
    [ChartedSpace E6 M] [IsManifold I6 ∞ M] [Nonempty M] [ConnectedSpace M]
    (F ν : M → E7) (hF : SmoothImmersion F)
    (hc : CanonicallyCompleteInducedMetric hF),
    letI : RiemannianBundle (fun x : M ↦ TangentSpace I6 x) := ⟨hF.toRiemannianMetric⟩
    letI : MetricSpace M := canonicalInducedMetricSpace hF
    letI : MeasurableSpace M := borel M
    letI : BorelSpace M := ⟨rfl⟩
    letI : SecondCountableTopology M := canonical_complete_secondCountable hF hc
    GlobalUnitNormal F ν → Minimal F ν → RiemannianGeometricStability F ν →
      FullConclusion F ν

name: OAI.TamingCompatibility.IsSmooth
head: def IsSmooth (α : TwoForm X) : Prop

name: OAI.TamingCompatibility.IsClosed
head: def IsClosed (α : TwoForm X) : Prop
text:
def IsClosed (α : TwoForm X) : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Space → X) (U : Set Space), IsOpen U →
    ContMDiffOn Model Model ∞ f U → ∀ y ∈ U,
      extDerivWithin (pullback α f) U y = 0

name: OAI.TamingCompatibility.IsNondegenerate
head: def IsNondegenerate (α : TwoForm X) : Prop
text:
def IsNondegenerate (α : TwoForm X) : Prop :=
  ∀ x v, (∀ w, eval α x v w = 0) → v = 0

name: OAI.TamingCompatibility.IsSymplectic
head: def IsSymplectic (α : TwoForm X) : Prop
text:
def IsSymplectic (α : TwoForm X) : Prop :=
  IsSmooth α ∧ IsClosed α ∧ IsNondegenerate α

name: OAI.TamingCompatibility.Tames
head: def Tames (α : TwoForm X) (J : AlmostComplexStructure X) : Prop
text:
def Tames (α : TwoForm X) (J : AlmostComplexStructure X) : Prop :=
  ∀ x v, v ≠ 0 → 0 < eval α x v (J.endomorphism x v)

name: OAI.TamingCompatibility.IsInvariant
head: def IsInvariant (α : TwoForm X) (J : AlmostComplexStructure X) : Prop
text:
def IsInvariant (α : TwoForm X) (J : AlmostComplexStructure X) : Prop :=
  ∀ x u v, eval α x (J.endomorphism x u) (J.endomorphism x v) = eval α x u v

name: OAI.TamingCompatibility.Compatible
head: def Compatible (α : TwoForm X) (J : AlmostComplexStructure X) : Prop
text:
def Compatible (α : TwoForm X) (J : AlmostComplexStructure X) : Prop :=
  Tames α J ∧ IsInvariant α J

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsGeodesic
doc: The constant-speed minimizing parametrization, including constant curves.
head: def IsGeodesic (γ : Curve X) : Prop

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsAC2
doc: Absolute continuity with a square-integrable metric control.
head: def IsAC2 (γ : Curve X) : Prop
text:
def IsAC2 (γ : Curve X) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable a ∧
    (∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (a t) ^ 2) < ∞ ∧
    ∀ s t : Time, (s : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) →
      edist (γ s) (γ t) ≤ ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc (s : ℝ) (t : ℝ), a r

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsTestPlan
doc: A 2-test plan: bounded compression and finite average kinetic energy.
head: def IsTestPlan (m : Measure X) (π : Measure (Curve X)) : Prop
text:
def IsTestPlan (m : Measure X) (π : Measure (Curve X)) : Prop :=
  IsProbabilityMeasure π ∧
  (∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ t : Time,
    Measure.map (fun γ : Curve X => γ t) π ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) • m) ∧
  (∀ᵐ γ ∂π, IsAC2 γ) ∧
  (∫⁻ γ, ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (metricSpeed γ t) ^ 2 ∂volume ∂π) < ∞

name: OAI.WeakHessian.BoundedTracks
doc: Uniform bounded spatial support; used only to define the local Sobolev class.
head: def BoundedTracks (π : Measure (Curve X)) : Prop
text:
def BoundedTracks (π : Measure (Curve X)) : Prop :=
  ∃ o : X, ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ᵐ γ ∂π, ∀ t : Time, dist (γ t) o ≤ R

name: OAI.WeakHessian.LocallyL2
head: def LocallyL2 (m : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def LocallyL2 (m : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ o : X, ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → MemLp f 2 (m.restrict (Metric.ball o R))

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsLocalWeakUpperGradient
doc: Local weak upper gradients, in the integrated test-plan definition.
head: def IsLocalWeakUpperGradient (m : Measure X) (f D : X → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsLocalWeakUpperGradient (m : Measure X) (f D : X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  LocallyL2 m D ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂m, 0 ≤ D x) ∧
  ∀ π : Measure (Curve X), IsTestPlan m π → BoundedTracks π →
    (∫⁻ γ, ENNReal.ofReal |f (γ timeOne) - f (γ timeZero)| ∂π) ≤
      ∫⁻ γ, ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ENNReal.ofReal (D (evalReal γ t)) * metricSpeed γ t ∂volume ∂π

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsMinimalLocalWeakUpperGradient
head: def IsMinimalLocalWeakUpperGradient (m : Measure X) (f D : X → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.WeakHessian.LocalSobolev
head: def LocalSobolev (m : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def LocalSobolev (m : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  LocallyL2 m f ∧ ∃ D, IsMinimalLocalWeakUpperGradient m f D

name: OAI.WeakHessian.Sobolev
head: def Sobolev (m : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Sobolev (m : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  MemLp f 2 m ∧ LocalSobolev m f ∧ MemLp (weakGradient m f) 2 m

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsLaplacian
doc: Weak nonpositive generator convention, without a global L² assumption on F.
head: def IsLaplacian (m : Measure X) (u L : X → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsLaplacian (m : Measure X) (u L : X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Sobolev m u ∧ MemLp L 2 m ∧
    ∀ v : X → ℝ, Sobolev m v →
      (∫ x, gamma m u v x ∂m) = -(∫ x, L x * v x ∂m)

name: OAI.WeakHessian.InLaplacianDomain
head: def InLaplacianDomain (m : Measure X) (u : X → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def InLaplacianDomain (m : Measure X) (u : X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ L, IsLaplacian m u L

name: OAI.WeakHessian.BoundedFunction
head: def BoundedFunction (f : X → ℝ) : Prop
text: def BoundedFunction (f : X → ℝ) : Prop := ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x, |f x| ≤ B

name: OAI.WeakHessian.GloballyLipschitz
head: def GloballyLipschitz (f : X → ℝ) : Prop
text: def GloballyLipschitz (f : X → ℝ) : Prop := ∃ L : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith L f

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsTestFunction
doc: Bounded globally Lipschitz Laplacian-domain functions with Sobolev Laplacian.
head: def IsTestFunction (m : Measure X) (g : X → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.WeakHessian.WeakHessianUpperBound
head: def WeakHessianUpperBound (m : Measure X) (F G : X → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def WeakHessianUpperBound (m : Measure X) (F G : X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : X → ℝ, IsTestFunction m g → HasCompactSupport g →
    ∀ h : X → ℝ, GloballyLipschitz h → HasCompactSupport h →
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) →
      weakHessian m F g h ≤ ∫ x, h x * G x * gamma m g g x ∂m

name: OAI.WeakHessian.QuadraticCheegerEnergy
head: def QuadraticCheegerEnergy (m : Measure X) : Prop
text:
def QuadraticCheegerEnergy (m : Measure X) : Prop :=
  ∀ f g : X → ℝ, cheegerEnergy m f < ∞ → cheegerEnergy m g < ∞ →
    cheegerEnergy m (fun x => f x + g x) + cheegerEnergy m (fun x => f x - g x) =
      2 * cheegerEnergy m f + 2 * cheegerEnergy m g

name: OAI.WeakHessian.HasSecondMoment
head: def HasSecondMoment (μ : Measure X) : Prop
text:
def HasSecondMoment (μ : Measure X) : Prop :=
  ∃ o : X, (∫⁻ x, (edist x o) ^ 2 ∂μ) < ∞

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsCoupling
head: def IsCoupling (q : Measure (X × X)) (μ₀ μ₁ : Measure X) : Prop
text:
def IsCoupling (q : Measure (X × X)) (μ₀ μ₁ : Measure X) : Prop :=
  Measure.map Prod.fst q = μ₀ ∧ Measure.map Prod.snd q = μ₁

name: OAI.WeakHessian.IsOptimalCoupling
head: def IsOptimalCoupling (q : Measure (X × X)) (μ₀ μ₁ : Measure X) : Prop

name: OAI.WeakHessian.CurvatureDimension
doc: Unreduced CD(K,N), written with the standard dynamical optimal-plan formula.
head: def CurvatureDimension (m : Measure X) (K N : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def CurvatureDimension (m : Measure X) (K N : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ μ₀ μ₁ : Measure X,
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ₀ → IsProbabilityMeasure μ₁ →
    HasSecondMoment μ₀ → HasSecondMoment μ₁ →
    μ₀ ≪ m → μ₁ ≪ m →
    ∃ π : Measure (Curve X), IsProbabilityMeasure π ∧
      (∀ᵐ γ ∂π, IsGeodesic γ) ∧
      IsOptimalCoupling (endpointCoupling π) μ₀ μ₁ ∧
      ∀ N' : ℝ, N ≤ N' → ∀ t : Time,
        (∫⁻ γ,
          (tauCoeff K N' (1 - (t : ℝ)) (dist (γ timeZero) (γ timeOne)) *
            (μ₀.rnDeriv m (γ timeZero)) ^ (-1 / N') +
          tauCoeff K N' (t : ℝ) (dist (γ timeZero) (γ timeOne)) *
            (μ₁.rnDeriv m (γ timeOne)) ^ (-1 / N')) ∂π) ≤
        renyiIntegral m (interpolation π t) N'

name: OAI.WeakHessian.RCD
head: def RCD (m : Measure X) (K N : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def RCD (m : Measure X) (K N : ℝ) : Prop :=
  CurvatureDimension m K N ∧ QuadraticCheegerEnergy m

name: OAI.WeakHessian.FullSupport
head: def FullSupport (m : Measure X) : Prop
text:
def FullSupport (m : Measure X) : Prop :=
  ∀ U : Set X, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → 0 < m U

name: OAI.WeakHessian.FiniteOnBoundedSets
head: def FiniteOnBoundedSets (m : Measure X) : Prop
text:
def FiniteOnBoundedSets (m : Measure X) : Prop :=
  ∀ B : Set X, Bornology.IsBounded B → m B < ∞

name: OAI.WeakHessian.CurveSecondDerivativeBound
doc: The literal second-distributional-derivative conclusion on (0,1).
head: def CurveSecondDerivativeBound (F G : X → ℝ) (σ : Curve X) : Prop
text:
def CurveSecondDerivativeBound (F G : X → ℝ) (σ : Curve X) : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
    tsupport φ ⊆ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → (∀ t, 0 ≤ φ t) →
    (∫ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      F (evalReal σ t) * deriv (deriv φ) t) ≤
    (dist (σ timeZero) (σ timeOne)) ^ 2 *
      ∫ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, G (evalReal σ t) * φ t

name: OAI.WeakMTWGlobalSupport.WeakMTW.CompleteGeodesicWithInitialData
head:
def CompleteGeodesicWithInitialData (x : M) (v : TangentSpace (model n) x)
    (γ : ℝ → M) : Prop
text:
def CompleteGeodesicWithInitialData (x : M) (v : TangentSpace (model n) x)
    (γ : ℝ → M) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (model n) ∞ γ ∧
  ∃ h : γ 0 = x,
    (h ▸ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (model n) γ 0 (1 : ℝ)) = v ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball t ε, ∀ r ∈ Metric.ball t ε,
        dist (γ s) (γ r) = ‖v‖ * |s - r|

name: OAI.WeakMTWGlobalSupport.WeakMTW.ExpEndpoint
head: def ExpEndpoint (x : M) (v : TangentSpace (model n) x) (y : M) : Prop
text:
def ExpEndpoint (x : M) (v : TangentSpace (model n) x) (y : M) : Prop :=
  ∃ γ : ℝ → M, CompleteGeodesicWithInitialData x v γ ∧ γ 1 = y

name: OAI.WeakMTWGlobalSupport.WeakMTW.HasWeakMTW
head: def HasWeakMTW : Prop

name: OAI.WeakMTWGlobalSupport.WeakMTW.MainConvexity
head: def MainConvexity : Prop
text:
def MainConvexity : Prop :=
  ∀ x : M, Convex ℝ (injectivityDomain (n := n) x)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.Adjacent
head: def Adjacent (s t : Letters) : Prop

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.Distant
head: def Distant (s t : Letters) : Prop

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.Sentinel
head: def Sentinel (s t : Letters) : Prop

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.Segment
doc: A geodesic parametrized proportionally to length on the closed unit interval. Values outside [0,1] are irrelevant.
head: def Segment {X : Type uX} [MetricSpace X] (x y : X) (γ : ℝ → X) : Prop
text:
def Segment {X : Type uX} [MetricSpace X] (x y : X) (γ : ℝ → X) : Prop :=
  γ 0 = x ∧ γ 1 = y ∧
    ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      dist (γ s) (γ t) = |s - t| * dist x y

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.CAT0
doc: Geodesic Euclidean triangle comparison. For points of parameters t and u on the sides xy and xz, the right hand side is the squared Euclidean comparison distance, expanded by the law of cosines. All geodesic sides, also degenerate ones, are quantified. Any pair of triangle sides has a common vertex, so this is the full triangle-comparison convention, not a midpoint-only condition.
head: def CAT0 (X : Type uX) [MetricSpace X] : Prop
text:
def CAT0 (X : Type uX) [MetricSpace X] : Prop :=
  (∀ x y : X, ∃ γ : ℝ → X, Segment x y γ) ∧
  ∀ (x y z : X) (γ η : ℝ → X), Segment x y γ → Segment x z η →
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      dist (γ t) (η u) ^ 2 ≤
        (t ^ 2 - t * u) * dist x y ^ 2 +
        (u ^ 2 - t * u) * dist x z ^ 2 + t * u * dist y z ^ 2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.GeometricAction
doc: Proper and cocompact isometric action. Properness of the metric space and nonemptiness are separate standing hypotheses in the theorem below.
head: def GeometricAction (G : Type uG) (X : Type uX) [Group G] [MetricSpace X] [MulAction G X] : Prop
text:
def GeometricAction (G : Type uG) (X : Type uX) [Group G] [MetricSpace X] [MulAction G X] : Prop :=
  CAT0 X ∧
  (∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x)) ∧
  (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → {g : G | ((fun x : X => g • x) '' K ∩ K).Nonempty}.Finite) ∧
  ∃ K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ x : X, ∃ g : G, ∃ k ∈ K, g • k = x

name: OAI.Release075.TorsionFree
doc: No nonidentity element has finite order. This does not assert unique roots.
head: def TorsionFree (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop
text:
def TorsionFree (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∀ (g : G) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → g ^ n = 1 → g = 1

name: OAI.Release075.Geodesic
doc: A shortest edge path in the unit-edge graph.
head: def Geodesic {V : Type u} (X : SimpleGraph V) {x y : V} (p : X.Walk x y) : Prop
text:
def Geodesic {V : Type u} (X : SimpleGraph V) {x y : V} (p : X.Walk x y) : Prop :=
  p.length = X.dist x y

name: OAI.Release075.SideThin
doc: Each vertex of `p` is within `δ` of a vertex of `q` or `r`.
head:
def SideThin {V : Type u} (X : SimpleGraph V) (δ : ℕ) {x y z : V}
    (p : X.Walk x y) (q : X.Walk y z) (r : X.Walk z x) : Prop

name: OAI.Release075.WordHyperbolic
doc: A finitely generated group with a unit-edge Cayley graph whose geodesic triangles are uniformly thin. Connectedness of this Cayley graph asserts that `S` generates.
head: def WordHyperbolic (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop
text:
def WordHyperbolic (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ S : Set G, S.Finite ∧ (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S).Connected ∧
    ∃ δ : ℕ, ∀ (x y z : G)
      (p : (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S).Walk x y)
      (q : (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S).Walk y z)
      (r : (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S).Walk z x),
      Geodesic (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S) p →
      Geodesic (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S) q →
      Geodesic (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S) r →
      SideThin (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S) δ p q r ∧
      SideThin (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S) δ q r p ∧
      SideThin (SimpleGraph.mulCayley S) δ r p q

name: OAI.Kervaire.Unimodular
head: def Unimodular {A : Type u} [Group A] (w : WordGroup A) : Prop
text:
def Unimodular {A : Type u} [Group A] (w : WordGroup A) : Prop :=
  exponentSum w = 1 ∨ exponentSum w = -1

name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.FolnerAmenable
head: noncomputable def FolnerAmenable (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop
text:
noncomputable def FolnerAmenable (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop := by
  classical
  exact ∀ K : Finset G, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ D : Finset G, D.Nonempty ∧ ∀ g ∈ K,
      (((D.image (fun d => g * d)) ∆ D).card : ℝ) < ε * D.card

name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop := ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Group G),
    Infinite G ∧ Group.IsFinitelyPresented G ∧ IsSimpleGroup G ∧ FolnerAmenable G

name: OAI.ThompsonNonamenability.IsDyadic
head: def IsDyadic (x : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsDyadic (x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ), x = (k : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n

name: OAI.ThompsonNonamenability.HasDyadicPLPieces
head: def HasDyadicPLPieces (f : IntervalHomeomorph) : Prop
text: def HasDyadicPLPieces (f : IntervalHomeomorph) : Prop := Nonempty (DyadicPLWitness f)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HasTypeFInfinity
head: def HasTypeFInfinity (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop
text:
def HasTypeFInfinity (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (X : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace X) (_ : T2Space X)
    (_ : ConnectedSpace X) (cw : Topology.CWComplex (Set.univ : Set X)),
    (∀ n : ℕ, Finite (cw.cell n)) ∧
    (∃ x : X, Nonempty (FundamentalGroup X x ≃* G)) ∧
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace E) (_ : ContractibleSpace E)
      (p : E → X), Function.Surjective p ∧ IsCoveringMap p

name: OAI.GAD.IsState
head: def IsState {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : Prop
text:
def IsState {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : Prop :=
  P.PosSemidef ∧ Matrix.trace P = 1

name: OAI.GAD.Achievable
doc: The liminf rate condition written as its eventual lower-bound characterization. There is no preshared entanglement, feedback, or restriction on encodings/decoding.
head: def Achievable (γ ν R : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Achievable (γ ν R : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : (n : ℕ) → Code n,
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ averageError γ ν (C n)) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      R - ε ≤ Real.log ((C n).messages : ℝ) / Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ)

name: OAI.GAD.Maximizes
head: def Maximizes (γ ν p : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Maximizes (γ ν p : ℝ) : Prop :=
  p ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, objective γ ν q ≤ objective γ ν p

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.CourtadeKumarStatement
head: def CourtadeKumarStatement : Prop
text:
def CourtadeKumarStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 →
      ∀ f : Cube n → Bool, mutualInformation ε f ≤ 1 - binaryEntropy ε

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.DictatorAttainmentStatement
head: def DictatorAttainmentStatement : Prop
text:
def DictatorAttainmentStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 →
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        mutualInformation ε (dictator i) = 1 - binaryEntropy ε ∧
        mutualInformation ε (complementDictator i) = 1 - binaryEntropy ε

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.FullStatement
head: def FullStatement : Prop
text: def FullStatement : Prop := CourtadeKumarStatement ∧ DictatorAttainmentStatement

name: OAI.QAC.ParityStatement
doc: The literal measured-output, polynomial-total-qubit parity lower bound.
head: def ParityStatement : Prop
text:
def ParityStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ) (c ε : ℝ), 1 ≤ c → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 2 →
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ N : ℕ, n ≤ N → (N : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ c →
      ∀ layers : List (PhysicalLayer N), layers.length ≤ d →
        ∀ out : Fin N, ¬ (∀ x : Word n,
          1 / 2 + ε ≤ successProbability (physicalCircuitMatrix layers) out x)

name: OAI.ZeroKey.CompletelyPositive
head: def CompletelyPositive {a b : ℕ} (L : Mat a →ₗ[ℂ] Mat b) : Prop
text:
def CompletelyPositive {a b : ℕ} (L : Mat a →ₗ[ℂ] Mat b) : Prop :=
  ∀ k U, U.PosSemidef → (amplify L k U).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ZeroKey.PPTType
head: def PPTType {a b : ℕ} (L : Mat a →ₗ[ℂ] Mat b) : Prop
text:
def PPTType {a b : ℕ} (L : Mat a →ₗ[ℂ] Mat b) : Prop :=
  CompletelyPositive L ∧ CompletelyPositive (L.comp (transposeLinear a))

name: OAI.ZeroKey.Density
head: def Density {ι : Type v246_0} [Fintype ι] (R : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : Prop
text:
def Density {ι : Type v246_0} [Fintype ι] (R : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : Prop :=
  R.PosSemidef ∧ Matrix.trace R = 1

name: OAI.ZeroKey.Explicit.PairwiseOrthogonal
head: def PairwiseOrthogonal (S : EightSet) : Prop
text:
def PairwiseOrthogonal (S : EightSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ S.1, ∀ r ∈ S.1, q ≠ r → overlap q r = 0

name: OAI.ZeroKey.Separable
head:
def Separable {ι : Type v2604_0} {κ : Type v2604_1} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : Matrix (ι × κ) (ι × κ) ℂ) : Prop
text:
def Separable {ι : Type v2604_0} {κ : Type v2604_1} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : Matrix (ι × κ) (ι × κ) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Fin n → Matrix κ κ ℂ),
    (∀ s, (A s).PosSemidef) ∧ (∀ s, (B s).PosSemidef) ∧ R = ∑ s, A s ⊗ₖ B s

name: OAI.UnrestrictedQuantum.PositiveFunctional
head: def PositiveFunctional [LE A] (S : ReferenceFunctional A ι) : Prop
text:
def PositiveFunctional [LE A] (S : ReferenceFunctional A ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → (S x).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ZeroKey.Subdensity
head: def Subdensity (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : Prop
text: def Subdensity (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : Prop := U.PosSemidef ∧ (trace U).re ≤ 1

name: OAI.ZeroKey.IsCompletedKeyOutput
head:
def IsCompletedKeyOutput {a b ell e : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin a)] [Nonempty (Fin b)]
    (R : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin a × Fin b) ℂ) (_hR : Density R)
    (P : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin e) ℂ) (_hP : P * Pᴴ = R)
    (messages : ClassicalRecordSpace.{u}) (ν : Measure (ℕ → messages)) [SigmaFinite ν]
    (τ : KeyDensity ν (KeyWord ell) (Fin e)) : Prop
text:
def IsCompletedKeyOutput {a b ell e : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin a)] [Nonempty (Fin b)]
    (R : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin a × Fin b) ℂ) (_hR : Density R)
    (P : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin e) ℂ) (_hP : P * Pᴴ = R)
    (messages : ClassicalRecordSpace.{u}) (ν : Measure (ℕ → messages)) [SigmaFinite ν]
    (τ : KeyDensity ν (KeyWord ell) (Fin e)) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : ℕ → KeyImplementation a b ell messages,
    ∃ _hAC : ∀ j, (p j).discussion.transcriptLaw ≪ ν,
      Tendsto (fun j => cqDistance
        (fun a b => positiveEntryDensity
          (publicPurifiedEntries (p j).discussion.probeLaw
            (p j).discussion.sampler.publicRecord (p j).protocol.completeReference P a b) ν)
        τ.block ν) atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.ZeroKey.CompletedKeyScheme.Secure
head: def Secure : Prop
text: def Secure : Prop := Tendsto s.error atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.ZeroKey.UniformProtocolGap
head:
def UniformProtocolGap {a b : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin a)] [Nonempty (Fin b)]
    (R : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin a × Fin b) ℂ) (_hR : Density R) : Prop
text:
def UniformProtocolGap {a b : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin a)] [Nonempty (Fin b)]
    (R : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin a × Fin b) ℂ) (_hR : Density R) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℕ) (O M : Type u) [MeasurableSpace O] [MeasurableSpace M]
    [StandardBorelSpace O] [Nonempty O] [StandardBorelSpace M] [Nonempty M]
    (d : Discussion O M) (A B : ℕ → Type u)
    [∀ n, AddCommGroup (A n)] [∀ n, Module ℂ (A n)] [∀ n, One (A n)] [∀ n, LE (A n)]
    [∀ n, AddCommGroup (B n)] [∀ n, Module ℂ (B n)] [∀ n, One (B n)] [∀ n, LE (B n)]
    (TA TB CA CB : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup TA] [Module ℂ TA] [One TA] [LE TA]
    [AddCommGroup TB] [Module ℂ TB] [One TB] [LE TB]
    [AddCommGroup CA] [Module ℂ CA] [One CA] [LE CA]
    [AddCommGroup CB] [Module ℂ CB] [One CB] [LE CB]
    (p : BitProtocol (ι := Fin (copyDim a k)) (η := Fin (copyDim b k)) d A B TA TB CA CB)
    (e : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin (copyDim a k) × Fin (copyDim b k)) (Fin e) ℂ)
    (_hP : P * Pᴴ = positiveCopies R k)
    (sigma : PositiveMatrixMeasure (ℕ → M) (Fin e)),
    (trace (sigma.value Set.univ)).re = 1 →
      1/5 ≤ p.rawPurifiedSecretBitError P sigma

name: OAI.ZeroKey.UniformCompletedGap
head:
def UniformCompletedGap {a b : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin a)] [Nonempty (Fin b)]
    (R : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin a × Fin b) ℂ) (hR : Density R) : Prop
text:
def UniformCompletedGap {a b : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin a)] [Nonempty (Fin b)]
    (R : Matrix (Fin a × Fin b) (Fin a × Fin b) ℂ) (hR : Density R) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k ell : ℕ), 0 < ell →
    ∀ p : CompletedKeyTrial.{u} (positiveCopies R k) (by
      induction k with
      | zero => exact hR
      | succ k ih =>
        refine ⟨(ih.1.kronecker hR.1).submatrix _, ?_⟩
        change trace (groupTensor (positiveCopies R k) R) = 1
        have ht := Equiv.sum_comp (groupIndex (copyDim a k) (copyDim b k) a b)
          (fun x => (Matrix.kronecker (positiveCopies R k) R) x x)
        change trace (groupTensor (positiveCopies R k) R) = trace (Matrix.kronecker (positiveCopies R k) R) at ht
        rw [ht, Matrix.kronecker, trace_kronecker, ih.2, hR.2, one_mul]) ell,
      1/5 ≤ p.error

name: OAI.ZeroKey.Explicit.MainClaim
head: def MainClaim : Prop
text:
def MainClaim : Prop :=
  ∃ hR : Density rhoFin, ¬ Separable rhoFin ∧
    distillableSecretKey.{u} rhoFin hR = 0 ∧
    UniformProtocolGap.{u} rhoFin hR ∧
    UniformCompletedGap.{u} rhoFin hR

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.Closed
head: def Closed {n : ℕ} (u : Cube n → ℝ) : Prop
text: def Closed {n : ℕ} (u : Cube n → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ x, u x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.Interior
head: def Interior {n : ℕ} (g : Cube n → ℝ) : Prop
text: def Interior {n : ℕ} (g : Cube n → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.Ioo (-1) 1

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.SoftContraction
head: def SoftContraction : Prop
text:
def SoftContraction : Prop := ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Cube n → ℝ), Closed u →
  ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
    info (noise ρ u) ≤ psi (|ρ| * psiInv (info u))

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.SoftAttainment
head: def SoftAttainment : Prop
text:
def SoftAttainment : Prop := ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (a : ℝ), |a| ≤ 1 →
  ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
    info (noise ρ (softCoordinate i a)) =
      psi (|ρ| * psiInv (info (softCoordinate i a)))

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.SoftInformationIdentity
head: def SoftInformationIdentity : Prop
text:
def SoftInformationIdentity : Prop := ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Cube n → ℝ), Closed u →
  ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
    mutualInformation (softJoint ρ u) = info (noise ρ u)

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.RefinedBoolean
head: def RefinedBoolean : Prop

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.BooleanAttainment
head: def BooleanAttainment : Prop
text:
def BooleanAttainment : Prop := ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n)
  (ρ : ℝ), ρ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
  mutualInformation (boolJoint ρ (fun x => x i)) = psi |ρ| ∧
  mutualInformation (boolJoint ρ (fun x => !(x i))) = psi |ρ|

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.BitsConversion
head: def BitsConversion : Prop
text:
def BitsConversion : Prop := ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → Bool)
  (ε : ℝ), ε ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1/2) →
  psi (1 - 2 * ε) / L = 1 - binaryEntropyBits ε ∧
  mutualInformation (boolJoint (1 - 2 * ε) f) / L ≤ 1 - binaryEntropyBits ε

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.SharpProduction
head: def SharpProduction : Prop
text:
def SharpProduction : Prop := ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Cube n → ℝ), Interior g →
  hybrid (avg g) (info g) ≤ production g ∧ F (info g) ≤ hybrid (avg g) (info g)

name: OAI.SoftChannel204.FullMain
head: def FullMain : Prop
text:
def FullMain : Prop := SoftContraction ∧ SoftAttainment ∧ SoftInformationIdentity ∧
  RefinedBoolean ∧ BooleanAttainment ∧ BitsConversion ∧ SharpProduction

name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.IsBarker
head: def IsBarker {n : ℕ} (h : Fin n → ℤ) : Prop
text:
def IsBarker {n : ℕ} (h : Fin n → ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ j, IsSign (h j)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → k < n → |aperiodic h k| ≤ 1

name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.IsSign
head: def IsSign {R : Type u} [One R] [Neg R] (x : R) : Prop
text:
def IsSign {R : Type u} [One R] [Neg R] (x : R) : Prop :=
  x = 1 ∨ x = -1

name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.IsCirculant
head: def IsCirculant {n : ℕ} (H : RealMatrix n) : Prop
text:
def IsCirculant {n : ℕ} (H : RealMatrix n) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : Fin n → ℝ, ∀ i j, H i j = h (j - i)

name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.IsSignHadamard
head: def IsSignHadamard {n : ℕ} (H : RealMatrix n) : Prop

name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.ExistsRealCirculantHadamard
head: def ExistsRealCirculantHadamard (n : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def ExistsRealCirculantHadamard (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : RealMatrix n, IsCirculant H ∧ IsSignHadamard H

name: OAI.MatrixAllFields.MatrixMultiplication.Arithmetic.MatrixAlgorithm.Correct
head: def Correct (P : MatrixAlgorithm F a b c) : Prop
text:
def Correct (P : MatrixAlgorithm F a b c) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) F) (B : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin c) F), P.eval A B = A * B

name: OAI.MatrixAllFields.MatrixMultiplication.Arithmetic.AdmissibleExponent
doc: Positive slack, one uniform constant, and a correct program at every size.
head: def AdmissibleExponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (τ : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def AdmissibleExponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (τ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ P : MatrixAlgorithm F n n n,
      P.Correct ∧ (P.cost : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (τ + ε)

name: OAI.MatrixMultiplication.Arithmetic.MatrixAlgorithm.Correct
head: def Correct (P : MatrixAlgorithm F a b c) : Prop
text:
def Correct (P : MatrixAlgorithm F a b c) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) F) (B : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin c) F), P.eval A B = A * B

name: OAI.MatrixMultiplication.Arithmetic.AdmissibleExponent
doc: Positive slack, one uniform constant, and a correct program at every size.
head: def AdmissibleExponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (τ : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def AdmissibleExponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (τ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ P : MatrixAlgorithm F n n n,
      P.Correct ∧ (P.cost : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (τ + ε)

name: OAI.MatrixMultiplication.Arithmetic.RectangularAdmissibleExponent
head: def RectangularAdmissibleExponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (k τ : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def RectangularAdmissibleExponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (k τ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ P : MatrixAlgorithm F n (innerSize n k) n,
      P.Correct ∧ (P.cost : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (τ + ε)

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Machine.WellFormed
head: def WellFormed (M : Machine) : Prop
text:
def WellFormed (M : Machine) : Prop :=
  M.initialState < M.states ∧
  (∀ q ∈ M.haltingStates, q < M.states) ∧
  ∀ q a r, q < M.states → a < M.alphabet → M.instruction q a = some r →
    r.1 < M.states ∧ r.2.1 < M.alphabet

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Machine.ValidInput
head: def ValidInput (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ) : Prop
text:
def ValidInput (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ w, a < M.alphabet

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Machine.Halts
head: def Halts (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ) : Prop
text:
def Halts (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ n : ℕ, M.isHalting (M.run w n) = true

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Smooth
head:
def Smooth {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (F : Field E) : Prop
text:
def Smooth {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (F : Field E) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ (∞) (Function.uncurry F) (Set.Ici 0 ×ˢ Set.univ)

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.ClassicalRegularity
head: def ClassicalRegularity (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def ClassicalRegularity (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun t => u t x) (Set.Ici 0)) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Differentiable ℝ (u t)) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (dx i u t)) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Differentiable ℝ (p t)) ∧
  ∀ T, 0 ≤ T →
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry u) (timeCylinder T) ∧
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (dt u)) (timeCylinder T) ∧
    (∀ i, ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (dx i u)) (timeCylinder T)) ∧
    (∀ i j, ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (dx i (dx j u))) (timeCylinder T)) ∧
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry p) (timeCylinder T) ∧
    (∀ i, ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (dx i p)) (timeCylinder T))

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.ContinuousInH
head:
def ContinuousInH {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (k : ℕ) (F : Field E) (T : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def ContinuousInH {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (k : ℕ) (F : Field E) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ α : MultiIndex, (∑ i, α i) ≤ k →
    ∃ g : ℝ → Lp E 2 (volume : Measure Space),
      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
        ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure Space), (g t) x = spatial α F t x

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.C1InL2
head: def C1InL2 (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def C1InL2 (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ g g' : ℝ → Lp Space 2 (volume : Measure Space),
    ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
    ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt g (g' t) (Set.Icc 0 T) t) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure Space), (g t) x = u t x) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure Space), (g' t) x = dt u t x)

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.CompetitorEnergyClass
head: def CompetitorEnergyClass (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def CompetitorEnergyClass (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  ∀ T, 0 ≤ T →
    ContinuousInH 2 u T ∧ C1InL2 u T ∧ ContinuousInH 1 p T ∧
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ x, ‖u t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.EnergyClass
head: def EnergyClass (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def EnergyClass (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  CompetitorEnergyClass u p ∧
  ∀ T, 0 ≤ T → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ x,
    ‖u t x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ (u t) x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.NavierStokes
head: def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (f u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (f u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  ClassicalRegularity u p ∧
  (∀ x, u 0 x = 0) ∧
  ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
    div u t x = 0 ∧
    dt u t x + advection u t x = -grad p t x + ν • laplacian u t x + f t x

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Rapid
head: def Rapid (F : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def Rapid (F : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ J l : ℕ, ∀ α : MultiIndex, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
      (1 + t + ‖x‖) ^ J * ‖mixed l α F t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.SupportedIn
head: def SupportedIn (F : Velocity) (K : Set Space) : Prop
text:
def SupportedIn (F : Velocity) (K : Set Space) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Function.support (F t) ⊆ K

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.IsTrajectory
head: def IsTrajectory (u : Velocity) (a : Space) (γ : ℝ → Space) : Prop
text:
def IsTrajectory (u : Velocity) (a : Space) (γ : ℝ → Space) : Prop :=
  γ 0 = a ∧ ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt γ (u t (γ t)) (Set.Ici 0) t

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Returns
head:
def Returns {A B : Type*} [Encodable A] [Encodable B]
    (c : Program) (a : A) (b : B) : Prop
text:
def Returns {A B : Type*} [Encodable A] [Encodable B]
    (c : Program) (a : A) (b : B) : Prop :=
  Encodable.encode b ∈ c.eval (Encodable.encode a)

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.ComputableReal
head: def ComputableReal (r : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.ProgramFor
head: def ProgramFor (c : FieldProgram) (F : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def ProgramFor (c : FieldProgram) (F : Velocity) : Prop :=
  (∀ (l : ℕ) (α : IndexCode) (q : RationalPoint) (k : ℕ),
    ∃ v : RationalVector, Returns c.1 (l, α, q, k) v ∧
      (0 ≤ q.1 →
        ‖rationalVector v - mixed l (index α) F (rationalPoint q).1 (rationalPoint q).2‖
          ≤ dyadicError k)) ∧
  (∀ (l : ℕ) (α : IndexCode) (R k : ℕ),
    ∃ m : ℕ, Returns c.2.1 (l, α, R, k) m ∧
      ∀ z z' : ℝ × Space,
        0 ≤ z.1 → 0 ≤ z'.1 → ‖z‖ ≤ R → ‖z'‖ ≤ R →
        ‖z - z'‖ ≤ dyadicError m →
        ‖mixed l (index α) F z.1 z.2 - mixed l (index α) F z'.1 z'.2‖ ≤ dyadicError k) ∧
  (∀ (J l : ℕ) (α : IndexCode),
    ∃ B : ℕ, Returns c.2.2 (J, l, α) B ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
        (1 + t + ‖x‖) ^ J * ‖mixed l (index α) F t x‖ ≤ B)

name: OAI.AlternatingNS.AlternatingConclusion
head: def AlternatingConclusion (ν : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def AlternatingConclusion (ν : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (compileForce compileVelocity : Machine × List ℕ → FieldProgram),
    Computable compileForce ∧ Computable compileVelocity ∧
    ∃ K : Set Space, IsCompact K ∧
      ∀ (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ), M.WellFormed → M.ValidInput w →
        ∃ (f U : Velocity) (X : Space → ℝ → Space),
          ProgramFor (compileForce (M, w)) f ∧
          ProgramFor (compileVelocity (M, w)) U ∧
          Smooth f ∧ Smooth U ∧
          SupportedIn f K ∧ SupportedIn U K ∧ Rapid f ∧ Rapid U ∧
          f = residual ν U ∧
          NavierStokes ν f U (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ EnergyClass U (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
          (∀ (v : Velocity) (p : Pressure),
            NavierStokes ν f v p → CompetitorEnergyClass v p →
            ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, v t x = U t x ∧ p t x = 0) ∧
          (∀ a, IsTrajectory U a (X a)) ∧
          (∀ a γ, IsTrajectory U a γ → ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → γ t = X a t) ∧
          ((∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ 0 < X observedParticle t 0) ↔ M.Halts w)

name: OAI.Heisenberg.NearestNeighbor
head: def NearestNeighbor {d : ℕ} (x y : Site d) : Prop
text:
def NearestNeighbor {d : ℕ} (x y : Site d) : Prop :=
  ∑ i : Fin d, |x i - y i| = (1 : ℤ)

name: OAI.Heisenberg.DynamicsConverges
head: def DynamicsConverges (d ℓ : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def DynamicsConverges (d ℓ : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ) (A : QuasiLocal d ℓ),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => finiteDynamics d ℓ (box d n) t A)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (dynamics d ℓ t A))

name: OAI.Heisenberg.TranslationInvariant
head: def TranslationInvariant {d ℓ : ℕ} (ω : State d ℓ) : Prop
text:
def TranslationInvariant {d ℓ : ℕ} (ω : State d ℓ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Site d) (A : QuasiLocal d ℓ), ω.functional (translation d ℓ x A) = ω.functional A

name: OAI.Heisenberg.IsKMS
head: def IsKMS {d ℓ : ℕ} (β : ℝ) (ω : State d ℓ) : Prop
text:
def IsKMS {d ℓ : ℕ} (β : ℝ) (ω : State d ℓ) : Prop :=
  0 < β ∧ ∀ A B : QuasiLocal d ℓ, ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ,
    ContinuousOn F {z | 0 ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ β} ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F {z | 0 < z.im ∧ z.im < β} ∧
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ β → ‖F z‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, F t = ω.functional (A * dynamics d ℓ t B)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, F ((t : ℂ) + Complex.I * β) = ω.functional (dynamics d ℓ t B * A))

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Halts
head: def Halts (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M) : Prop

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Smooth
head: def Smooth (v : Field F) : Prop
text:
def Smooth (v : Field F) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun z : ℝ × Space => v z.1 z.2) (Set.Ici 0 ×ˢ Set.univ)

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.BoundedMixed
head: def BoundedMixed (v : Field F) : Prop
text:
def BoundedMixed (v : Field F) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : MultiIndex, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, ‖mixedD a v t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.CH
head: def CH (k : ℕ) (v : Field F) : Prop
text:
def CH (k : ℕ) (v : Field F) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : List (Fin 3), a.length ≤ k →
    ∃ V : ℝ → Lp F 2 (volume : Measure Space),
      ContinuousOn V (Set.Ici 0) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → (V t : Space → F) =ᵐ[volume] spatialD a v t

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.C1L2
head: def C1L2 (v : Field F) : Prop
text:
def C1L2 (v : Field F) : Prop :=
  ∃ V W : ℝ → Lp F 2 (volume : Measure Space),
    ContinuousOn V (Set.Ici 0) ∧ ContinuousOn W (Set.Ici 0) ∧
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
      (V t : Space → F) =ᵐ[volume] v t ∧
      (W t : Space → F) =ᵐ[volume] timeD v t ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt V (W t) (Set.Ici 0) t

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.ZeroDataSolution
head: def ZeroDataSolution (ν : ℝ) (f u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def ZeroDataSolution (ν : ℝ) (f u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  Smooth u ∧ Smooth p ∧
  (∀ x, u 0 x = 0) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, div u t x = 0) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
    timeD u t x + convection u t x =
      -gradient p t x + ν • laplacian u t x + f t x)

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.BoundedOnFiniteSlabs
head: def BoundedOnFiniteSlabs (u : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def BoundedOnFiniteSlabs (u : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x,
      ‖u t x‖ ≤ C ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, ‖spaceD i u t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.ComparisonClass
head: def ComparisonClass (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.UniqueInComparison
head: def UniqueInComparison (ν : ℝ) (f U : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def UniqueInComparison (ν : ℝ) (f U : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ u p, ZeroDataSolution ν f u p → ComparisonClass u p →
    (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, u t x = U t x) ∧
    (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x y, p t x = p t y)

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.CommonCompactSupport
head: def CommonCompactSupport (U f₀ f₁ : Velocity) : Prop

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.PeriodicAfterOne
head: def PeriodicAfterOne (v : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def PeriodicAfterOne (v : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → ∀ x, v (t + 1) x = v t x

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.IsMaterialFlow
head: def IsMaterialFlow (u : Velocity) (X : MaterialFlow) : Prop

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.EffectiveFamily
head: def EffectiveFamily (v : Family Velocity) : Prop
text:
def EffectiveFamily (v : Family Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∃ E : (ℕ × MultiIndex × RationalPoint × ℕ) → (Fin 3 → ℚ),
  ∃ b : (ℕ × MultiIndex) → ℕ,
  ∃ R : ℕ → ℕ,
    Computable E ∧ Computable b ∧ Computable R ∧
    (∀ M w a z n, 0 ≤ z.1 → ∀ i,
      |(E (inputCode M w, a, z, n) i : ℝ) -
        mixedD a (v M w) (z.1 : ℝ) (rationalSpace z.2) i| ≤ error n) ∧
    (∀ M w a t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
      ‖mixedD a (v M w) t x‖ ≤ (b (inputCode M w, a) : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ M w t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
      (R (inputCode M w) : ℝ) < ‖x‖ → v M w t x = 0)

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.EffectiveFieldIn
head: def EffectiveFieldIn (O : Set (ℕ →. ℕ)) (v : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def EffectiveFieldIn (O : Set (ℕ →. ℕ)) (v : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∃ E : (MultiIndex × RationalPoint × ℕ) → (Fin 3 → ℚ),
  ∃ b : MultiIndex → ℕ,
    ComputableIn O E ∧ ComputableIn O b ∧
    (∀ a z n, 0 ≤ z.1 → ∀ i,
      |(E (a, z, n) i : ℝ) -
        mixedD a v (z.1 : ℝ) (rationalSpace z.2) i| ≤ error n) ∧
    (∀ a t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, ‖mixedD a v t x‖ ≤ (b a : ℝ))

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.RealName
head: def RealName (name : ℕ → ℚ) (x : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def RealName (name : ℕ → ℚ) (x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, |(name n : ℝ) - x| ≤ error n

name: OAI.BalancedTransport.ComputableReal
head: def ComputableReal (x : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def ComputableReal (x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ name : ℕ → ℚ, Computable name ∧ RealName name x

name: OAI.Alternating.Machine.WellFormed
head: def Machine.WellFormed (M : Machine) : Prop
text:
def Machine.WellFormed (M : Machine) : Prop :=
  M.table.length = M.stateCount ∧
  (∀ q ∈ M.haltingStates, q < M.stateCount) ∧
  ∀ row ∈ M.table,
    row.length = M.symbolCount ∧
    ∀ i : Instruction, some i ∈ row →
      i.1 < M.stateCount ∧ i.2.1 < M.symbolCount

name: OAI.Alternating.ValidInput
head: def ValidInput (I : MachineInput) : Prop
text:
def ValidInput (I : MachineInput) : Prop :=
  I.1.WellFormed ∧ ∀ a ∈ I.2, a < I.1.symbolCount

name: OAI.Alternating.Halts
head: def Halts (I : MachineInput) : Prop
text:
def Halts (I : MachineInput) : Prop :=
  ∃ n : ℕ, I.1.isHalting (configurationAt I n).state = true

name: OAI.Alternating.SmoothUpToZero
head: def SmoothUpToZero (u : Field) : Prop
text:
def SmoothUpToZero (u : Field) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry u) timeSpace

name: OAI.Alternating.SupportedIn
head: def SupportedIn (K : Set Space) (u : Field) : Prop
text:
def SupportedIn (K : Set Space) (u : Field) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space, x ∉ K → u t x = 0

name: OAI.Alternating.RapidDecay
head: def RapidDecay (u : Field) : Prop
text:
def RapidDecay (u : Field) : Prop :=
  ∀ (J l : ℕ) (α : MultiIndex), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space,
      (1 + t + ‖x‖) ^ J * ‖mixedPartial u l α t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.Alternating.ClassicalRegularity
head: def ClassicalRegularity (u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def ClassicalRegularity (u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ContDiff ℝ 2 (u t) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (p t)) ∧
  (∀ x : Space, DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun t => u t x) (Set.Ici 0)) ∧
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T →
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (timeDerivative u)) (Set.Icc 0 T ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
    (∀ α : MultiIndex, multiOrder α ≤ 2 →
      ContinuousOn (fun tx : ℝ × Space => spatialPartial α (u tx.1) tx.2)
        (Set.Icc 0 T ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
    (∀ α : MultiIndex, multiOrder α ≤ 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun tx : ℝ × Space => spatialPartial α (p tx.1) tx.2)
        (Set.Icc 0 T ×ˢ Set.univ))

name: OAI.Alternating.NSSolution
head: def NSSolution (ν : ℝ) (f u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def NSSolution (ν : ℝ) (f u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  ClassicalRegularity u p ∧
  (∀ x : Space, u 0 x = 0) ∧
  ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space,
    divergence (u t) x = 0 ∧
    timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x =
      -gradient (p t) x + ν • laplacian (u t) x + f t x

name: OAI.Alternating.ContinuousInSobolev
head:
def ContinuousInSobolev {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (k : ℕ) (g : ℝ → Space → E) (T : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def ContinuousInSobolev {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (k : ℕ) (g : ℝ → Space → E) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ α : MultiIndex, multiOrder α ≤ k →
    ∃ G : ℝ → SpatialL2 E,
      ContinuousOn G (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (fun x : Space => (G t) x) =ᵐ[volume] spatialPartial α (g t)

name: OAI.Alternating.C1InL2
head: def C1InL2 (u : Field) (T : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def C1InL2 (u : Field) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ U W : ℝ → SpatialL2 Space,
    ContinuousOn U (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧ ContinuousOn W (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      ((fun x : Space => (U t) x) =ᵐ[volume] u t) ∧
      ((fun x : Space => (W t) x) =ᵐ[volume] timeDerivative u t) ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt U (W t) (Set.Icc 0 T) t

name: OAI.Alternating.EnergyClass
head: def EnergyClass (u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def EnergyClass (u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T →
    ContinuousInSobolev 2 u T ∧ C1InL2 u T ∧ ContinuousInSobolev 1 p T ∧
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Space,
      ‖u t x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ (u t) x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.Alternating.CompetitorEnergyClass
head: def CompetitorEnergyClass (u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def CompetitorEnergyClass (u : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T →
    ContinuousInSobolev 2 u T ∧ C1InL2 u T ∧ ContinuousInSobolev 1 p T ∧
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Space, ‖u t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.Alternating.SolvesParticle
head: def SolvesParticle (u : Field) (a : Space) (γ : ℝ → Space) : Prop

name: OAI.Alternating.GlobalMaterialFlow
head: def GlobalMaterialFlow (u : Field) (X : ℝ → Space → Space) : Prop
text:
def GlobalMaterialFlow (u : Field) (X : ℝ → Space → Space) : Prop :=
  (∀ a : Space, SolvesParticle u a (fun t => X t a)) ∧
  ∀ (a : Space) (γ : ℝ → Space), SolvesParticle u a γ →
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → γ t = X t a

name: OAI.Alternating.ComputableReal
head: def ComputableReal (x : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.Alternating.EvaluatesField
head: def EvaluatesField (c : FieldProgram) (u : Field) : Prop
text:
def EvaluatesField (c : FieldProgram) (u : Field) : Prop :=
  (∀ (l : ℕ) (α : MultiIndex) (t : ℚ), 0 ≤ t →
    ∀ (x : RationalPoint) (k : ℕ), ∃ q : RationalPoint,
      Encodable.encode q ∈ c.1.eval (Encodable.encode (l, α, t, x, k)) ∧
      ‖mixedPartial u l α (t : ℝ) (rationalPoint x) - rationalPoint q‖ ≤ error k) ∧
  (∀ (l : ℕ) (α : MultiIndex) (k : ℕ), ∃ m : ℕ,
    m ∈ c.2.1.eval (Encodable.encode (l, α, k)) ∧
    ∀ (t s : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ s → ∀ x y : Space,
      |t - s| + ‖x - y‖ ≤ error m →
      ‖mixedPartial u l α t x - mixedPartial u l α s y‖ ≤ error k) ∧
  (∀ (J l : ℕ) (α : MultiIndex), ∃ C : ℚ,
    Encodable.encode C ∈ c.2.2.eval (Encodable.encode (J, l, α)) ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space,
      (1 + t + ‖x‖) ^ J * ‖mixedPartial u l α t x‖ ≤ (C : ℝ))

name: OAI.Alternating.AlternatingOutput
head:
def AlternatingOutput (ν : ℝ) (K : Set Space) (I : MachineInput)
    (velocityProgram forceProgram : FieldProgram) : Prop
text:
def AlternatingOutput (ν : ℝ) (K : Set Space) (I : MachineInput)
    (velocityProgram forceProgram : FieldProgram) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u f : Field) (X : ℝ → Space → Space),
    EvaluatesField velocityProgram u ∧ EvaluatesField forceProgram f ∧
    SmoothUpToZero u ∧ SmoothUpToZero f ∧
    SupportedIn K u ∧ SupportedIn K f ∧ RapidDecay u ∧ RapidDecay f ∧
    f = residual ν u ∧
    NSSolution ν f u (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ EnergyClass u (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
    (∀ (v : Field) (p : Pressure), NSSolution ν f v p → CompetitorEnergyClass v p →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space, v t x = u t x ∧ p t x = 0) ∧
    GlobalMaterialFlow u X ∧
    ((∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ 0 < X t observedParticle 0) ↔ Halts I)

name: OAI.ShearFlows.RationalBox.positive
head: def positive {n : ℕ} (B : RationalBox n) : Prop
text:
def positive {n : ℕ} (B : RationalBox n) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, B.lower j < B.upper j

name: OAI.ShearFlows.RationalBox.nonemptyBox
head: def nonemptyBox {n : ℕ} (B : RationalBox n) : Prop
text:
def nonemptyBox {n : ℕ} (B : RationalBox n) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, B.lower j ≤ B.upper j

name: OAI.ShearFlows.Input.inChart
head: def inChart (d : Input) (x : Space) : Prop
text:
def inChart (d : Input) (x : Space) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, (d.chart.lower j : ℝ) < x j ∧ x j < (d.chart.upper j : ℝ)

name: OAI.ShearFlows.Input.inPlanarChart
head: def inPlanarChart (d : Input) (x : Plane) : Prop

name: OAI.ShearFlows.PositivelySeparated
head: def PositivelySeparated (A B : Set Plane) : Prop
text:
def PositivelySeparated (A B : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, ε ≤ ‖x - y‖

name: OAI.ShearFlows.SpatiallyPeriodic
head: def SpatiallyPeriodic {E : Type*} (L : ℝ) (g : SpaceTime → E) : Prop
text:
def SpatiallyPeriodic {E : Type*} (L : ℝ) (g : SpaceTime → E) : Prop :=
  ∀ t x n, g (t, x + latticeVector L n) = g (t, x)

name: OAI.ShearFlows.TimePeriodic
head: def TimePeriodic {E : Type*} (g : SpaceTime → E) : Prop
text:
def TimePeriodic {E : Type*} (g : SpaceTime → E) : Prop :=
  ∀ t x, g (t + 1, x) = g (t, x)

name: OAI.ShearFlows.HasZeroMean
head:
def HasZeroMean {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (L : ℝ) (g : SpaceTime → E) : Prop
text:
def HasZeroMean {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (L : ℝ) (g : SpaceTime → E) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, (∫ x in fundamentalCube L, g (t, x)) = 0

name: OAI.ShearFlows.Solenoidal
head: def Solenoidal (V : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def Solenoidal (V : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ t x, divergence (fun y => V (t, y)) x = 0

name: OAI.ShearFlows.ZeroAdvection
head: def ZeroAdvection (V : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def ZeroAdvection (V : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ t x, advection (fun y => V (t, y)) x = 0

name: OAI.ShearFlows.BoundedMixedDerivatives
head: def BoundedMixedDerivatives (V : Velocity) : Prop
text:
def BoundedMixedDerivatives (V : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ α, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ y, ‖mixedDerivative V α y‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.ShearFlows.ComputableReal
head: def ComputableReal (r : ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.VelocityDetection.NavierStokes
head:
def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (u : VectorField 3) (p : ScalarField 3)
    (f : VectorField 3) : Prop
text:
def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (u : VectorField 3) (p : ScalarField 3)
    (f : VectorField 3) : Prop :=
  (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Coord 3, ∀ i : Fin 3,
    timeD (fun s y => u s y i) t x + advection u (fun s y => u s y i) t x =
      -spatialD i p t x + ν * laplacian (fun s y => u s y i) t x + f t x i) ∧
  (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, divergence u t x = 0) ∧
  (∀ x, u 0 x = 0)

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.SpacePeriodic
head: def SpacePeriodic {E : Type*} (f : Spacetime → E) : Prop

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.MeanZero
head:
def MeanZero {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (f : Spacetime → E) : Prop
text:
def MeanZero {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (f : Spacetime → E) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → spatialMean f t = 0

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.ClassicalRegularity
head: def ClassicalRegularity (v : Field) (p : Pressure) (J : ClassicalJet) : Prop
text:
def ClassicalRegularity (v : Field) (p : Pressure) (J : ClassicalJet) : Prop :=
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => v (point s x)) (J.dt (point t x)) (Set.Ici 0) t) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x i,
    HasDerivAt (fun (s : ℝ) => v (point t (x + s • axis i))) (J.dx i (point t x)) 0) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x i j,
    HasDerivAt (fun (s : ℝ) => J.dx i (point t (x + s • axis j)))
      (J.dxx i j (point t x)) 0) ∧
  (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x i,
    HasDerivAt (fun (s : ℝ) => p (point t (x + s • axis i))) (J.dp i (point t x)) 0) ∧
  (∀ T, 0 ≤ T →
    ContinuousOn v (cylinder T) ∧ ContinuousOn p (cylinder T) ∧
    ContinuousOn J.dt (cylinder T) ∧
    (∀ i, ContinuousOn (J.dx i) (cylinder T)) ∧
    (∀ i j, ContinuousOn (J.dxx i j) (cylinder T)) ∧
    (∀ i, ContinuousOn (J.dp i) (cylinder T)))

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.ClassicalSolution
head: def ClassicalSolution (ν : ℝ) (f v : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop
text:
def ClassicalSolution (ν : ℝ) (f v : Field) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  SpacePeriodic v ∧ SpacePeriodic p ∧ MeanZero p ∧
  (∀ x, v (point 0 x) = 0) ∧
  ∃ J : ClassicalJet, ClassicalRegularity v p J ∧
    (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, J.dx i (point t x) i = 0) ∧
    (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
      J.dt (point t x) +
          (∑ i : Fin 3, v (point t x) i • J.dx i (point t x)) -
          ν • (∑ i : Fin 3, J.dxx i i (point t x)) +
          (fun i => J.dp i (point t x)) = f (point t x))

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.GloballySmooth
head:
def GloballySmooth {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : Spacetime → E) : Prop
text:
def GloballySmooth {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.BoundedEnergy

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.MaterialTrajectory

name: OAI.PrefixFlows.observed

def observed (x : Space) : Prop :=

name: OAI.RapidForcing.Smooth
head: def Smooth {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : Field E) : Prop
text:
def Smooth {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : Field E) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry f) (Ici (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ univ)

name: OAI.RapidForcing.Supported
head: def Supported {E : Type} [Zero E] (f : Field E) : Prop
text:
def Supported {E : Type} [Zero E] (f : Field E) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → tsupport (f t) ⊆ K

name: OAI.RapidForcing.Rapid
head: def Rapid {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : Field E) : Prop
text:
def Rapid {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : Field E) : Prop :=
  ∀ (J l : ℕ) (α : MultiIndex), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space,
      (1 + t) ^ J * ‖mixedD l α f t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.RapidForcing.RapidSpaceTime
head:
def RapidSpaceTime {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : Field E) : Prop
text:
def RapidSpaceTime {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : Field E) : Prop :=
  ∀ (J l : ℕ) (α : MultiIndex), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space,
      (1 + t + ‖x‖) ^ J * ‖mixedD l α f t x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.RapidForcing.NavierStokes
head: def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (f u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop
text:
def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (f u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space,
    timeD u t x + advection u t x =
      -gradient p t x + ν • laplace u t x + f t x) ∧
  (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space, divergence u t x = 0) ∧
  (∀ x : Space, u 0 x = 0)

name: OAI.RapidForcing.Classical
head: def Classical (u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Classical (u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := twoAtLeastTwo
  (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ContDiff ℝ 2 (u t) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (p t)) ∧
  (∀ x : Space, DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun t => u t x) (Ici 0)) ∧
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T →
    let cylinder := Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ (univ : Set Space)
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry u) cylinder ∧
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (timeD u)) cylinder ∧
    (∀ i, ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (spatialD i u)) cylinder) ∧
    (∀ i j, ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (spatialD i (spatialD j u))) cylinder) ∧
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry p) cylinder ∧
    (∀ i, ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (spatialD i p)) cylinder)

name: OAI.RapidForcing.L2ContinuousOn
head:
def L2ContinuousOn {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : Field E) (T : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def L2ContinuousOn {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : Field E) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := twoAtLeastTwo
  ∃ v : ℝ → Lp E 2 (volume : Measure Space),
    ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 T) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, (v t : Space → E) =ᵐ[volume] f t

name: OAI.RapidForcing.L2C1On
head: def L2C1On (u : Field Space) (T : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def L2C1On (u : Field Space) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := twoAtLeastTwo
  ∃ v v' : ℝ → Lp Space 2 (volume : Measure Space),
    ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 T) ∧ ContinuousOn v' (Icc 0 T) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, (v t : Space → Space) =ᵐ[volume] u t) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, (v' t : Space → Space) =ᵐ[volume] timeD u t) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt v (v' t) (Icc 0 T) t

name: OAI.RapidForcing.EnergyRegularity
head: def EnergyRegularity (u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop
text:
def EnergyRegularity (u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T →
    (∀ α : MultiIndex, order α ≤ 2 → L2ContinuousOn (spatialMulti α u) T) ∧
    L2C1On u T ∧
    (∀ α : MultiIndex, order α ≤ 1 → L2ContinuousOn (spatialMulti α p) T)

name: OAI.RapidForcing.EnergyClass
head: def EnergyClass (u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop
text:
def EnergyClass (u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop :=
  EnergyRegularity u p ∧
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x : Space,
    ‖u t x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ (u t) x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.RapidForcing.EnergyCompetitor
head: def EnergyCompetitor (u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.RapidForcing.UniqueEnergySolution
head: def UniqueEnergySolution (ν : ℝ) (f u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop
text:
def UniqueEnergySolution (ν : ℝ) (f u : Field Space) (p : Field ℝ) : Prop :=
  Classical u p ∧ EnergyClass u p ∧ NavierStokes ν f u p ∧
  ∀ (v : Field Space) (q : Field ℝ),
    Classical v q → EnergyCompetitor v q → NavierStokes ν f v q →
    ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space, v t x = u t x ∧ q t x = p t x

name: OAI.RapidForcing.TrajectoryOn
head: def TrajectoryOn (u : Field Space) (a : Space) (T : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Space) : Prop

name: OAI.RapidForcing.MaterialFlow
head: def MaterialFlow (u : Field Space) (X : ℝ → Space → Space) : Prop
text:
def MaterialFlow (u : Field Space) (X : ℝ → Space → Space) : Prop :=
  (∀ a : Space, X 0 a = a) ∧
  (∀ (a : Space) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t →
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => X s a) (u t (X t a)) (Ici 0) t) ∧
  (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 < T → ∀ (a : Space) (γ : ℝ → Space),
    TrajectoryOn u a T γ → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, γ t = X t a)

def EvaluatesMixed (c : Program) (f : Field Space) : Prop :=

name: OAI.Solenoidal.Fluid.FluidAssertions
head: def FluidAssertions (ν : ℝ) (U f : Field) : Prop
text:
def FluidAssertions (ν : ℝ) (U f : Field) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ ∞ U ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ SpatiallyPeriodic U ∧ SpatiallyPeriodic f ∧
  (∀ q : SpaceTime, 0 ≤ q 0 → diverge f q = 0) ∧
  (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → spatialMean f t = 0) ∧
  (∀ q : SpaceTime, 0 ≤ q 0 →
    partialD 0 U q + advection U q = ν • laplacian U q + f q) ∧
  (∀ q : SpaceTime, 0 ≤ q 0 → diverge U q = 0) ∧
  (∀ x : Space, U (point 0 x) = 0) ∧
  (∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ (v : Field) (p : Pressure), ClassicalSolutionOn ν f v p T →
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ x : Space, v (point t x) = U (point t x) ∧ p (point t x) = 0)

name: OAI.Solenoidal.Fluid.BoundedPeriodicAssertions
head: def BoundedPeriodicAssertions (U f : Field) : Prop
text:
def BoundedPeriodicAssertions (U f : Field) : Prop :=
  BoundedMixed U ∧ BoundedMixed f ∧
  (∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → energy U t ≤ C) ∧
  PeriodicAfterOne U ∧ PeriodicAfterOne f ∧ ZeroNearIntegers U f

name: OAI.CriticalFourierSupport.CurrentFalconer.halfDimensional_manuscriptFourier_with_cutoff
head:
theorem halfDimensional_manuscriptFourier_with_cutoff (χ : SchwartzMap V ℂ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (μ ξ : Measure V), IsProbabilityMeasure μ →
      IsFiniteMeasure ξ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, χ x = 1) →
      ∀ (K L H R : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 1 ≤ L → 1 ≤ H → H ≤ R →
      (∀ (x : V) (r : ℝ), H⁻¹ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        μ (Metric.ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K*r^((Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ)/2))) →
      ξ Set.univ ≤ 1 → (∀ᵐ w ∂ξ, ‖w‖ = 1) →
      (∀ (w : V), ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ r : ℝ, R⁻¹ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        ξ (Metric.ball w r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L*r^((Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ)/2))) →
      (∫ s : ℝ in Set.Icc (-H) H,
        ∫ w : V, ‖manuscriptFourier μ (s • w)‖^2 ∂ξ) ≤
          C*L*K*(1+Real.log H)

head:

    (c z : ℂ) (m k : ℤ) (y r s : ℝ)
    (hm : |(m : ℝ)| ≤ 100)
    (hnorm : z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) ^ m * y)
    (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hrot : barrierOctantRotate k z = ⟨r, s⟩)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hs : |s| ≤ r / 2) (hk : |k| ≤ 4)
    (hpos : k = 4 → s ≤ 0) (hneg : k = -4 → 0 < s) :
    |(c * Complex.log z).re - barrierWeightedComplexLogApprox c m k y (s / r)| ≤
      ‖c‖ * (1 / 1000000000000000 : ℝ)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_tail_pair_hasSum
head:
theorem manuscript_tail_pair_hasSum (z r w s : ℂ)
    (hz : ‖z‖ < 1) (hw : ‖w‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ =>
      (r * z ^ (k + 1)) * (s * w ^ (k + 1)) / ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))
      (-(r * s * Complex.log (1 - z * w)))

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_tail_row_hasSum
head:
private theorem manuscript_tail_row_hasSum (z r : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ < 1)
    (ys : List (ℂ × ℂ)) (hy : ∀ ws ∈ ys, ‖ws.1‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (r * z ^ (k + 1)) * manuscriptTailMoment ys (k + 1) /
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))
      (-(ys.map (fun ws => r * ws.2 * Complex.log (1 - z * ws.1))).sum)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_tail_bilinear_hasSum
head:
theorem manuscript_tail_bilinear_hasSum (xs ys : List (ℂ × ℂ))
    (hx : ∀ zr ∈ xs, ‖zr.1‖ < 1) (hy : ∀ ws ∈ ys, ‖ws.1‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => manuscriptTailMoment xs (k + 1) *
      manuscriptTailMoment ys (k + 1) / ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))
      (-manuscriptTailLogPair xs ys)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_tail_square_hasSum
head:

    (htail : ∀ zr ∈ tail, ‖zr.1‖ < 1)
    (hreal : ∀ k : ℕ, (manuscriptTailMoment tail (k + 1)).im = 0) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (manuscriptTailMoment tail (k + 1)).re ^ 2 /
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (-(manuscriptTailLogPair tail tail).re)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_norm_log_row_eq
head:
theorem manuscript_norm_log_row_eq (ys : List (ℂ × ℂ)) (zr : ℂ × ℂ) :
    -((ys.map (fun ws => zr.2 * ws.2 * Complex.log (1 - zr.1 * ws.1))).sum).re =
      manuscriptNormLogRow ys zr

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_norm_log_sum_eq

    (htail : ∀ zr ∈ tail, ‖zr.1‖ < 1)
    (hreal : ∀ k : ℕ, (manuscriptTailMoment tail (k + 1)).im = 0) :
    barrierTrialNormSq (barrierTrial cs tail) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range cs.length,
        (((cs.getD k 0 : ℝ) / 100000000) ^ 2 +
          2 * ((cs.getD k 0 : ℝ) / 100000000) * (manuscriptTailMoment tail (k + 1)).re) /
            ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) - (manuscriptTailLogPair tail tail).re

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscriptAtanJ_neg
head: private theorem manuscriptAtanJ_neg (t : ℝ) : barrierAtanJ (-t) = -barrierAtanJ t

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_atanJ_nonneg_interval
head:
theorem manuscript_atanJ_nonneg_interval (t : ℝ)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.arctan t ∈ Set.Icc (barrierAtanJ t) (barrierAtanJ t + t ^ 49 / 49)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_atanJ_neg_interval
head:
theorem manuscript_atanJ_neg_interval (t : ℝ)
    (ht0 : t < 0) (ht : |t| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.arctan t ∈ Set.Icc (barrierAtanJ t - |t| ^ 49 / 49) (barrierAtanJ t)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_atan_interval
head:
theorem manuscript_atan_interval (t : ℚ) (ht : |(t : ℝ)| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.arctan (t : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((manuscriptAtanInterval t).1 : ℝ)
      ((manuscriptAtanInterval t).2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_pi_quarter_interval

      (manuscriptPiQuarterInterval.2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_arg_interval
head:
theorem manuscript_arg_interval (k : ℤ) (t : ℚ) (ht : |(t : ℝ)| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 4) + Real.arctan (t : ℝ) ∈
      Set.Icc ((manuscriptArgInterval k t).1 : ℝ) ((manuscriptArgInterval k t).2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_complex_arg_interval
head:
theorem manuscript_complex_arg_interval (k : ℤ) (z : ℂ) (r s : ℚ)
    (hrot : barrierOctantRotate k z = ⟨(r : ℝ), (s : ℝ)⟩)
    (hr : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ)) (hs : |(s : ℝ)| ≤ (r : ℝ) / 2)
    (hk : |k| ≤ 4) (hpos : k = 4 → (s : ℝ) ≤ 0)
    (hneg : k = -4 → (0 : ℝ) < (s : ℝ)) :
    Complex.arg z ∈ Set.Icc ((manuscriptArgInterval k (s / r)).1 : ℝ)
      ((manuscriptArgInterval k (s / r)).2 : ℝ)

      ((manuscriptLogHInterval y).2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_scaled_log_interval
head:
theorem manuscript_scaled_log_interval (m : ℤ) (y : ℚ)
    (hy : (y : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) :
    Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (y : ℝ)) ∈
      Set.Icc ((manuscriptScaledLogInterval m y).1 : ℝ)
        ((manuscriptScaledLogInterval m y).2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.InternalCatalan.manuscript_fixed_log_interval
head:

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.MainEndpoint
head: def MainEndpoint : Prop
text:
def MainEndpoint : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : ℝ) (z : ℕ → GaussianInt),
    (∀ t, Irreducible (z t)) → Function.Injective z →
    (∀ t, dist (z (t + 1) : ℂ) (z t : ℂ) ≤ D) → False

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.UniformEndpoint
head: def UniformEndpoint : Prop
text:
def UniformEndpoint : Prop :=
  ∀ D : ℝ, ∃ B : ℕ,
    (∀ p : PrimeVertex, (component D p).Finite ∧ (component D p).ncard ≤ B) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (z : Fin n → GaussianInt),
      (∀ i, Irreducible (z i)) → Function.Injective z →
      (∀ i j : Fin n, j.val = i.val + 1 → dist (z j : ℂ) (z i : ℂ) ≤ D) →
      n ≤ B)

    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ᶠ B : ℕ in atTop,

      (∑ a : Fin m × Fin (channelBlockCount m B), channelMesh (channelFineCount m B) *

    (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁) (hM₂ : 0 ≤ M₂) (hL₁ : 0 ≤ L₁) (hL₂ : 0 ≤ L₂)
    (hF₁ : ∀ ξ, ∀ i ∈ J₁, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (channelLower (channelFineCount m B) i)
      (channelUpper (channelFineCount m B) i), ‖F₁ ξ x‖ ≤ M₁)
    (hF₂ : ∀ ξ, ∀ i ∈ J₂, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (channelLower (channelFineCount m B) i)
      (channelUpper (channelFineCount m B) i), ‖F₂ ξ x‖ ≤ M₂)
    (hI₁ : ∀ ξ, ∀ i ∈ J₁, IntervalIntegrable (F₁ ξ) volume
      (channelLower (channelFineCount m B) i) (channelUpper (channelFineCount m B) i))
    (hI₂ : ∀ ξ, ∀ i ∈ J₂, IntervalIntegrable (F₂ ξ) volume
      (channelLower (channelFineCount m B) i) (channelUpper (channelFineCount m B) i))
    (hLip₁ : ∀ ξ, ∀ i ∈ J₁, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (channelLower (channelFineCount m B) i)

head:
theorem manuscript_amplitude_fourier_bounds {m B q : ℕ} [NeZero q]

    (g : (auxiliaryPrimes B → Bool) → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1)

    (hF : ∀ i ∈ J, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (channelLower (channelFineCount m B) i)

    (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B) (J : Finset (Fin (channelFineCount m B)))

      ∀ J : Finset (Fin (channelFineCount m B)),
      ∀ g : (auxiliaryPrimes B → Bool) → ℝ,
      ∀ (F : Fin (channelFineCount m B) → ℂ) (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M →
      (∀ i ∈ J, ‖F i‖ ≤ M) →
      (∑ h : ZMod q, ‖unitResidueFourier
        (fun r => ∑ i ∈ J, (channelMesh (channelFineCount m B) : ℂ)*

name: OAI.ContinuumTemperature.Admissible
head: def Admissible (φ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Admissible (φ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Measurable (radialPotential φ) ∧
  (∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → a ≤ b →
    BddAbove (φ '' Icc a b) ∧ BddBelow (φ '' Icc a b)) ∧
  Tendsto φ (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) atTop ∧
  (∃ r₁ r₂ a : ℝ, 0 < r₁ ∧ r₁ < r₂ ∧ 0 < a ∧
    ∀ r ∈ Icc r₁ r₂, φ r ≤ -a) ∧
  (∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2 * |φ r|) (Ioi R)) ∧
  (∃ B : ℝ, ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : Fin N → Space),
    ((-B * (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ energy φ x)

  ∀ β ρ : ℝ, 0 < β → 0 < ρ →

      atTop (𝓝 (-β * f β ρ))

name: OAI.ContinuumTemperature.MainStatement

def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (I : Set ℝ) (βc : ℝ),
    Admissible φ ∧
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop φ (fun r : ℝ => r ^ (-3 : ℤ)) ∧
    HasCanonicalFreeEnergy φ f ∧
    IsOpen I ∧ OrdConnected I ∧ I.Nonempty ∧ I ⊆ Ioi 0 ∧
    βc ∈ Ioo (1 / 2 : ℝ) (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    ∀ ρ ∈ I, ∃ dminus dplus : ℝ,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun β => f β ρ) dminus (Iic βc) βc ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun β => f β ρ) dplus (Ici βc) βc ∧
      dplus < dminus

name: OAI.FKCRT.MetricMeasureData.Valid

  ∃ m : MetricSpace X.Carrier,

  (∀ y y', dist (Sum.inr y : X.Carrier ⊕ Y.Carrier) (Sum.inr y') = Y.distance y y')
