text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℝ, 4 < q → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
    ∀ (Ω : Type) (mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω) (P : @Measure Ω mΩ),
      @IsProbabilityMeasure Ω mΩ P →
      ∀ B : Fin 3 → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ,
        (∀ i, @IsBrownianReal Ω mΩ (B i) P) →
        @iIndepFun Ω (Fin 3) mΩ (fun _ => ℝ≥0 → ℝ) (fun _ => inferInstance)
          (fun i ω t => B i t ω) P →
        ∀ F : MetricMeasureData → ℝ, IsGHPTest F →
          Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => finiteExpectation q (c / Real.sqrt (n + 1)) n F)
            atTop (𝓝 (@brownianExpectation Ω mΩ P B F))

name: OAI.PlanarFPP.manuscriptMain
head:
theorem manuscriptMain (Ω : Type) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) (τ : Edge → Ω → ℝ)
    (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) :
    ∃ μ : Plane → ℝ, TimeConstantNorm μ ∧ IsTimeConstant P τ μ ∧
      DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin μ ∧ UniqueNormalizedSupports μ ∧ C1UnitSphere μ ∧
      (∀ v ∈ frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}, ∃! L : Set Plane,
        ∃ g : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ, g ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ z, μ z ≤ 1 → g z ≤ g v) ∧ L={z | g z=g v}) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}, HasC1CurveChart (frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}) v)

name: OAI.Problem367.treeAdj
head: def treeAdj {d : ℕ} (u v : TreeVertex d) : Prop

name: OAI.Problem367.ConnectedFinset
head: def ConnectedFinset {d : ℕ} (D : Finset (TreeVertex d)) : Prop
text:
def ConnectedFinset {d : ℕ} (D : Finset (TreeVertex d)) : Prop :=
  D.Nonempty ∧
    ∀ u ∈ D, ∀ v ∈ D,
      Relation.ReflTransGen
        (fun x y : TreeVertex d => x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ treeAdj x y) u v

name: OAI.Problem367.HasFreeIsingLaw
head:
def HasFreeIsingLaw {d : ℕ} (theta : ℝ)
    (mu : Measure (TreeVertex d → IsingSpin)) : Prop
text:
def HasFreeIsingLaw {d : ℕ} (theta : ℝ)
    (mu : Measure (TreeVertex d → IsingSpin)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : Finset (TreeVertex d)), ConnectedFinset D →
    ∀ eta : TreeVertex d → IsingSpin,
      mu {x | ∀ v ∈ D, x v = eta v} = freeCylinderWeight theta D eta

name: OAI.Problem367.IsFactorOfIID
head: def IsFactorOfIID (d : ℕ) (theta : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsFactorOfIID (d : ℕ) (theta : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ Phi : (TreeVertex d → ℝ) → (TreeVertex d → IsingSpin),
    Measurable Phi ∧
    HasFreeIsingLaw theta (Measure.map Phi (labelMeasure d)) ∧
    ∀ g : TreeAut d,
      ∀ᵐ U ∂labelMeasure d, Phi (relabel g U) = relabel g (Phi U)

name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.BallBound
head: def BallBound {d : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop

name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.InverseVolumeStatement
head: def InverseVolumeStatement : Prop
text:
def InverseVolumeStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    ∀ ν : Measure (Ambient d), IsProbabilityMeasure ν → BallBound ν →
      ∀ u : Ambient d, (∫⁻ z,inverseVolume u z ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (d/100) => ν)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (C*d*(d/100:ℕ)))

name: OAI.KernelPotential.BoundedDensity
head: def BoundedDensity {d : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop
text:
def BoundedDensity {d : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : ℝ, 0 < H ∧ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H • sphereProbability d

name: OAI.KernelPotential.CoercivityStatement
head: def CoercivityStatement : Prop
text:
def CoercivityStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    (∀ ν : Measure (Ambient d), IsProbabilityMeasure ν → BoundedDensity ν →
      (1/2:ℝ)*(InformationTheory.klDiv ν (sphereProbability d)).toReal-C*d ≤ Phi ν) ∧
    Phi (sphereProbability d) ≤ (2*(d/16):ℕ)*Real.log 2 ∧
    (∀ (q : ℕ) (w : Fin q → ℝ), (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∑ i,w i)=1 →
      ∀ ν : Fin q → Measure (Ambient d), (∀ i,IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)) →
      (∀ i,BoundedDensity (ν i)) →
      Phi (∑ i,ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • ν i) ≤ ∑ i,w i*Phi (ν i))

name: OAI.KernelPotential.DriftStatement
head: def DriftStatement : Prop
text:
def DriftStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
    Real.log N ≤ (d:ℝ)^2 → ∀ μ : Measure (Ambient d × Fin N), IsProbabilityMeasure μ →
    μ.map Prod.fst=sphereProbability d → ∀ rule : BlockRule d N,
      averagePhi (outgoingLaw μ rule) ≤ averagePhi μ+C*d

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.IsPartition
head: def IsPartition {d k : ℕ} (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) : Prop
text:
def IsPartition {d k : ℕ} (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂gaussian d, ∃! i, x ∈ A i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.AllPartitions
head: def AllPartitions : Prop
text:
def AllPartitions : Prop :=
  (∀ (d k : ℕ), 0 < d → 0 < k → ∀ A : Fin k → Set (Space d),
    IsPartition A → value A ≤ 9 / (8 * Real.pi)) ∧
  (∀ (d k : ℕ), 2 ≤ d → 3 ≤ k →
    IsPartition (propeller d k) ∧ value (propeller d k) = 9 / (8 * Real.pi))

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.SubquadraticMemory
head: def SubquadraticMemory : Prop
text:
def SubquadraticMemory : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d : ℝ)) (fun d => (d : ℝ) ^ 2) →
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
    0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : Learner d (M d) T Ω, L.Admissible ρ →
    (((2 : ℕ) / (3 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε ∨
      ∀ s, ((2 : ℕ) / (3 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.success ρ ε s) →
    c * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1 / ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FixedQuadraticMemory
head: def FixedQuadraticMemory : Prop
text:
def FixedQuadraticMemory : Prop :=
  ∀ A₀ : ℝ, 0 < A₀ → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ,
    ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ M T : ℕ, (M : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : Learner d M T Ω, L.Admissible ρ →
    ((2 : ℕ) / (3 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε →
    c * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1 / ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.CompanionFPP.HasTimeConstant
head: def HasTimeConstant (μ : TimeNorm) : Prop
text:
def HasTimeConstant (μ : TimeNorm) : Prop :=
  ∀ᵐ ω ∂environmentLaw, ∀ x : Vertex,
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => passageTime ω (0, 0) (scaleVertex n x) / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 (μ.seminorm (embed x)))

name: OAI.CompanionFPP.StrictlyConvexLimitShape
head: def StrictlyConvexLimitShape (μ : TimeNorm) : Prop
text:
def StrictlyConvexLimitShape (μ : TimeNorm) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y : Plane, x ∈ frontier {z | μ.seminorm z ≤ 1} →
    y ∈ frontier {z | μ.seminorm z ≤ 1} → x ≠ y →
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 → μ.seminorm ((1 - t) • x + t • y) < 1

name: OAI.CompanionFPP.MainTarget
head: def MainTarget : Prop
text:
def MainTarget : Prop := (∃ μ : TimeNorm, HasTimeConstant μ) ∧
  ∀ μ : TimeNorm, HasTimeConstant μ → StrictlyConvexLimitShape μ

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.ValidDisclosure
head: def ValidDisclosure {n N t : ℕ} (Q : Disclosure n N t) : Prop
text:
def ValidDisclosure {n N t : ℕ} (Q : Disclosure n N t) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, Measurable (fun zh : Coordinate n × History N (i.val + 1) => Q i zh.1 zh.2)) ∧
  (∀ i, (Set.range (fun zh : Coordinate n × History N (i.val + 1) => Q i zh.1 zh.2)).Finite) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ initialCube n, ∀ w : History N t, ∀ i,
    z ∈ cellSet (Q i z (through w i)) ∧ cellSet (Q i z (through w i)) ⊆ initialCube n) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ initialCube n, ∀ w : History N t, ∀ i j : Fin t, i ≤ j →
    cellSet (Q j z (through w j)) ⊆ cellSet (Q i z (through w i)))

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (n N t : ℕ), n₀ ≤ n → 1 ≤ N → ∀ rules : Rules n N t,
      (2 / (n / 8 : ℕ) + Real.exp (-c * (n / 16 : ℕ))) * Real.log N ≤ C₀ * (n + 1) →
      ∃ Q : Disclosure n N t, ValidDisclosure Q ∧
        mutualInformation (augmentedLaw rules Q) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (n + 1) * t) ∧
        (∫ zw, (finalLevel Q zw : ℝ) ∂experimentLaw rules) ≤ C * t

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.Descendant
head: def Descendant {n : ℕ} (Q R : Cell n) : Prop
text:
def Descendant {n : ℕ} (Q R : Cell n) : Prop :=
  Q.1 ≤ R.1 ∧ cellSet R ⊆ cellSet Q

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.Heavy
head: def Heavy {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q R : Cell n) : Prop
text:
def Heavy {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q R : Cell n) : Prop :=
  Descendant Q R ∧ Q.1 < R.1 ∧ threshold n (R.1-Q.1) < (P (cellSet R)).toReal

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.FirstHeavy
head: def FirstHeavy {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q R : Cell n) : Prop
text:
def FirstHeavy {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q R : Cell n) : Prop :=
  Heavy P Q R ∧ ∀ E : Cell n, Heavy P Q E → Descendant E R → E = R

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.Terminates
head: def Terminates {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n) (z : Coordinate n) : Prop
text:
def Terminates {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n) (z : Coordinate n) : Prop :=
  ∃ N, (state P Q (run P Q N z)).stopped = true

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.Regular
head: def Regular {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n) : Prop

name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.FiniteEntropyStatement
head: def FiniteEntropyStatement : Prop
text:
def FiniteEntropyStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ Q : Cell n, ∀ P : Measure (Coordinate n),
    IsProbabilityMeasure P → P ≪ uniformCell Q → InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞ →
      (∀ᵐ z ∂P, Terminates P Q z) ∧ Measurable (terminalLog P Q) ∧
      (∀ h : Log n, P {z | terminalLog P Q z = h} ≠ 0 →
        Descendant Q (terminalCell P Q h) ∧ Regular (terminalLaw P Q h) (terminalCell P Q h)) ∧
      Integrable (fun z => (depth P Q z : ℝ)) P ∧
      Integrable (fun z => (attempts P Q z : ℝ)) P ∧
      (∫ z,(attempts P Q z : ℝ) ∂P) ≤ 2*(1+∫ z,(depth P Q z : ℝ) ∂P) ∧
      (∫⁻ z,InformationTheory.klDiv (terminalLaw P Q (terminalLog P Q z))
          (uniformCell (terminalCell P Q (terminalLog P Q z))) ∂P) +
        ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.log 2/4)*n*(∫ z,(depth P Q z : ℝ) ∂P)) ≤
          InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) + ENNReal.ofReal (2/Real.exp 1)

name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.TVAtMost
head:
def TVAtMost {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E]
    (μ ν : Measure E) (ε : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def TVAtMost {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E]
    (μ ν : Measure E) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : Set E, MeasurableSet s → |μ.real s - ν.real s| ≤ ε

name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.CanSample
doc: A uniform sampler with a deterministic query budget on every execution and total-variation error at most one tenth.
head: def CanSample (d q : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def CanSample (d q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Ω : Type) (_ : MeasurableSpace Ω) (μ : Measure Ω)
    (_ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) (A : OracleAlgorithm Ω d q),
    ∀ V : Point d → ℝ, Admissible V →
      Measurable (A.run V) ∧ TVAtMost (μ.map (A.run V)) (gibbs V) (1 / 10)

doc: The quantified dimension-exponent upper bound with every positive exponent slack.

name: OAI.MatroidProphet.Feasible
head: def Feasible {n bits : ℕ} (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (A : OnlineRule n bits) : Prop
text:
def Feasible {n bits : ℕ} (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (A : OnlineRule n bits) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : Seed bits) (s v : Weights n) (π : ArrivalOrder n) (t : ℕ),
    (∀ e, 0 ≤ s e) → (∀ e, 0 ≤ v e) →
    M.Indep (acceptedThrough A r s v π t : Set (Fin n))

name: OAI.MatroidProphet.OneSampleChallenge.
head: def OneSampleChallenge.{u} : Prop
text:
def OneSampleChallenge.{u} : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : Matroid (Fin n)), M.E = Set.univ →
    ∃ (bits : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Seed bits)), IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ (A : OnlineRule n bits), Feasible M A ∧
      ∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (S V : Ω → Weights n) (R : Ω → Seed bits),
        Measurable S → Measurable V → Measurable R →
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ e, 0 ≤ S ω e) →
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ e, 0 ≤ V ω e) →
        iIndepFun (pairedCoordinates S V) μ →
        (∀ e, Measure.map (fun ω => S ω e) μ = Measure.map (fun ω => V ω e) μ) →
        IndepFun (fun ω => (S ω, V ω)) R μ →
        Measure.map R μ = ν →
        Integrable (fun ω => optimum M (V ω)) μ →
        ∀ (π : Ω → ArrivalOrder n), Measurable π →
          Integrable (fun ω => reward A (R ω) (S ω) (V ω) (π ω)) μ ∧
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ 310)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, optimum M (V ω) ∂μ) ≤
            ∫ ω, reward A (R ω) (S ω) (V ω) (π ω) ∂μ

name: OAI.MatroidProphet.HiddenVectorChallenge
head: def HiddenVectorChallenge : Prop
text:
def HiddenVectorChallenge : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : Matroid (Fin n)), M.E = Set.univ →
    ∃ (bits : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Seed bits)), IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ (A : HiddenRule n bits),
      (∀ (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
        ∀ (r : Seed bits) (π : ArrivalOrder n) (t : ℕ),
          M.Indep (hiddenAcceptedThrough A r w π t : Set (Fin n))) ∧
      ∀ (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ 293)⁻¹ * optimum M w ≤
          ∫ r, hiddenWorstReward A w r ∂ν

name: OAI.MatroidProphet.SamePrefix
doc: Full permutations describing the same ordered observation prefix.
head: def SamePrefix {n : ℕ} (K : ℕ) (σ π : ArrivalOrder n) : Prop
text:
def SamePrefix {n : ℕ} (K : ℕ) (σ π : ArrivalOrder n) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : Fin n, k.val < K → σ k = π k

name: OAI.MatroidProphet.SecretaryFeasible
doc: Feasibility is pointwise for every seed, vector, order, and arrival prefix.
head:
def SecretaryFeasible {n : ℕ} {Q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Q]
    (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (A : SecretaryRule n Q) : Prop
text:
def SecretaryFeasible {n : ℕ} {Q : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Q]
    (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (A : SecretaryRule n Q) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : Q) (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
    ∀ (π : ArrivalOrder n) (t : ℕ),
      M.Indep (secretaryAcceptedThrough A q w π t : Set (Fin n))

name: OAI.MatroidProphet.SecretaryChallenge.
doc: The full order-oblivious conclusion of `cor:secretary`, including a measurable history-only rule, every-prefix feasibility, prefix rejection, arbitrary full-seed suffix adversaries, and the unchanged `2⁻²⁹³` ratio.
head: def SecretaryChallenge.{u} : Prop
text:
def SecretaryChallenge.{u} : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : Matroid (Fin n)), M.E = Set.univ →
    ∃ (q : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Fin q)), IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ (A : SecretaryRule n (Fin q)), SecretaryFeasible M A ∧
      ∀ (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
      ∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (Q : Ω → Fin q) (σ π : Ω → ArrivalOrder n),
        Measurable Q → Measurable σ → Measurable π →
        Measure.map Q μ = ν →
        Measure.map σ μ = Secretary.uniformArrivalLaw n →
        IndepFun Q σ μ →
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, SamePrefix (A.prefixLength (Q ω)).val (σ ω) (π ω)) →
        Integrable (fun ω => secretaryReward A (Q ω) w (π ω)) μ ∧
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ 293)⁻¹ * optimum M w ≤
            ∫ ω, secretaryReward A (Q ω) w (π ω) ∂μ

name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.GaussianReplicaBlock
head: def GaussianReplicaBlock : Prop
text:
def GaussianReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    let k := 2 * (d / 16)
    let t := k + 1
    let ℓ := 4 * k
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (L : ℝ),
      Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ L) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (κ : Kernel (Data d k) (Fin N)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        conditionalInformation (sideLaw ℓ (signalMessageLaw p κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (messageEntropy (signalMessageLaw p κ) / (t : ℝ) +
            C * (d : ℝ) + C * Real.log (2 + Real.log L))

name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.EqualLabelMeasureIdentity
head: def EqualLabelMeasureIdentity : Prop
text:
def EqualLabelMeasureIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ (d k m : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ m → k + m ≤ d - 2 →
    ∀ (base : BaseLaw) (f : Vec d → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable f →
      (∃ L : ℝ≥0∞, L ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ x, f x ≤ L) →
      equalLabelLeft (k := k) (m := m) base f (fun _ => 1) < ∞ ∧
      ∀ H : Rows d k × Labels k × Tuple d m → ℝ≥0∞,
        Measurable H → equalLabelLeft base f H = equalLabelRight base f H

name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.DistanceReplicaBlock
head: def DistanceReplicaBlock : Prop
text:
def DistanceReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (b : ℝ),
      0 ≤ b → Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ Real.exp b) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (κ : Kernel (Data d (d / 16)) (Fin N)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        conditionalInformation (sideLaw (d / 2) (signalMessageLaw p κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (messageEntropy (signalMessageLaw p κ) / ((d / 8 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            C * ((d : ℝ) + b / (d : ℝ)))

name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.SyntheticReplicaBlock
head: def SyntheticReplicaBlock : Prop
text:
def SyntheticReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 16 ≤ d →
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (L : ℝ),
      1 ≤ L → Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ L) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z : Data d (d / 8) → Fin N) (hz : Measurable z),
        conditionalInformation
          (sideLaw (d / 2) (signalMessageLaw p (Kernel.deterministic z hz))) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (N : ℝ) / ((d / 8 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            C * ((d : ℝ) + Real.log (1 + Real.log L)))

name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.IncidenceReplicaBlock
head: def IncidenceReplicaBlock : Prop
text:
def IncidenceReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (F : ℝ),
      1 ≤ F → Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ F) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (κ : Kernel (Data d (d / 16)) (Fin N)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        conditionalInformation (sideLaw (d / 4) (signalMessageLaw p κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (N : ℝ) / ((d / 16 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            C * (d : ℝ) + C * Real.log (1 + Real.log F))

name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.EqualLabelVersions
head: def EqualLabelVersions : Prop
text:
def EqualLabelVersions : Prop :=
  ∀ (d k m : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ m → k + m ≤ d - 2 →
    ∀ (base : BaseLaw) (f : Vec d → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable f →
      (∃ L : ℝ≥0∞, L ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ x, f x ≤ L) →
      let ν := (base.measure d).withDensity f
      (Measurable (fun z : Rows d k × Labels k => projectedDensity base f z.1 z.2)) ∧
      (Measurable (fun z : Rows d k × Labels k => ballDensityVersion ν z.1 z.2)) ∧
      (Measurable (fun z : Rows d k × Labels k => gaussianDensityVersion ν z.1 z.2)) ∧
      (∀ A : Rows d k, LinearIndependent ℝ A →
        ν.map (labels A) = volume.withDensity (projectedDensity base f A) ∧
        projectedDensity base f A =ᵐ[volume] ballDensityVersion ν A ∧
        projectedDensity base f A =ᵐ[volume] gaussianDensityVersion ν A) ∧
      (∀ᵐ u ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ν),
        LinearIndependent ℝ (differences u) ∧
        ∀ᵐ A ∂constrainedRows k u,
          LinearIndependent ℝ A ∧
          (∀ i, labels A (u i) = labels A (u 0)) ∧
          (base = .spherical → ‖liftLabel A (labels A (u 0))‖ < 1) ∧
          0 < projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) ∧
          projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) ≠ ∞ ∧
          projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) =
            ballDensityVersion ν A (labels A (u 0)) ∧
          projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) =
            gaussianDensityVersion ν A (labels A (u 0)))

name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.HaarReplicaBlock
head: def HaarReplicaBlock : Prop
text:
def HaarReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 64 ≤ d →
    ∀ (V W : ℕ) [NeZero V] [NeZero W]
      (q : Measure (Vec d × Fin V)) [IsProbabilityMeasure q],
      q.fst = sphereLaw d →
      ∀ (κ : Kernel (Fin V × Data d (d / 16)) (Fin W)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        cmi (stateHaarSideLaw (d / 4) (stateMessageLaw q κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (terminalConditionalEntropy (stateMessageLaw q κ) /
            ((d / 16 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + C * (d : ℝ) +
            Real.log (1 + C * (d : ℝ) + finiteEntropy q.snd) +
            C * (finiteEntropy q.snd + Real.log (d : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ)^2)

name: OAI.PosteriorRegression.KernelSubquadraticMemory
head: def KernelSubquadraticMemory : Prop
text:
def KernelSubquadraticMemory : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d : ℝ)) (fun d => (d : ℝ)^2) →
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
    0<ε → ε≤1/10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ E : JointKernelExperiment d (M d) T Ω ρ,
    (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ E.uniformSuccess ε →
    c * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.AllBallMass
head: def AllBallMass (ν : Measure E) (K a : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def AllBallMass (ν : Measure E) (K a : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : E, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ν (Metric.closedBall b t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * t ^ a)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.FixedQuadraticMemory
head: def FixedQuadraticMemory : Prop
text:
def FixedQuadraticMemory : Prop :=
  ∀ A₀ : ℝ, 0 < A₀ → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ,
    ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ M T : ℕ, (M : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * (d : ℝ)^2 →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
    ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
    (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ seededSuccess K ρ ε →
    c*(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (T:ℝ)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.JointSuccessMeasurable
head: def JointSuccessMeasurable (K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T) (ρ : Measure Ξ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def JointSuccessMeasurable (K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T) (ρ : Measure Ξ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  AEMeasurable (fun z : UnitSphere d × (Ξ × Samples d T) =>
    (K z.2.1).conditionalSuccess ε z.1 z.2.2)
    ((uniformSphere d).prod (ρ.prod (sampleLaw d T)))

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.SubquadraticMemoryWithPointwise
head: def SubquadraticMemoryWithPointwise : Prop
text:
def SubquadraticMemoryWithPointwise : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d : ℝ)) (fun d => (d:ℝ)^2) →
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
    0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
    ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d (M d) T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
    ((2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ seededSuccess K ρ ε ∨
      (JointSuccessMeasurable K ρ ε ∧ ∀ s, (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ seededPointwiseSuccess K ρ ε s)) →
    c*(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (T:ℝ)

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.IntegratedFrameMoment
head: def IntegratedFrameMoment : Prop
text:
def IntegratedFrameMoment : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (d k q : ℕ) (β K R : ℝ)
      (ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
      (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (u : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      1 ≤ k → 2 ≤ q → k+q ≤ d → 0 < β → β ≤ d →
      1 ≤ β-k-((q:ℝ)-2) → 0 ≤ K → 0 < R →
      ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R → AllBallMass ν K β →
      Orthonormal ℝ u →
      (∀ᵐ A ∂frameLaw u, ν.map (coordinateMap A) ≪ (volume : Measure (Fin k → ℝ))) →
      Measurable (coordinateDensity ν k) ∧
      (∀ᵐ A ∂frameLaw u,
        (volume : Measure (Fin k → ℝ)).withDensity (fun y => coordinateDensity ν k (A,y)) =
          ν.map (coordinateMap A)) ∧
      (∀ (A : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), Orthonormal ℝ A →
        ∀ y : Fin k → ℝ,
          R < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (y-coordinateMap A z)‖ → coordinateDensity ν k (A,y) = 0) ∧
      (∫⁻ A, ∫⁻ y : Fin k → ℝ, coordinateDensity ν k (A,y)^q ∂volume ∂frameLaw u) ^ (1/(q:ℝ)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C^d * (C*Real.sqrt d)^((k:ℝ)*(1-1/(q:ℝ))) *
          K * R^(β-(k:ℝ)*(1-1/(q:ℝ))))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.NormalizedUnitBallMoment
head: def NormalizedUnitBallMoment : Prop
text:
def NormalizedUnitBallMoment : Prop :=
  ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D →
    ∃ C_D : ℝ, 0 < C_D ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 32 ≤ d →
      let k := d/16
      let lam : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      ∀ (ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
        (u : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        ν Set.univ ≤ 1 → ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1 →
        AllBallMass ν (D^d) lam → Orthonormal ℝ u →
        (∀ᵐ X ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))),
          ν.map (rowMap (polarRows u X)) ≪ (volume : Measure (Label k))) →
        Measurable (normalizedDensity ν k u) ∧
        (∀ᵐ X ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))),
          ((unitBallVolume k)⁻¹ • (volume : Measure (Label k))).withDensity
            (fun y => normalizedDensity ν k u (X,y)) = ν.map (rowMap (polarRows u X))) ∧
        (∀ X y, 1 < ‖y‖ → normalizedDensity ν k u (X,y) = 0) ∧
        (∫⁻ X, ∫⁻ y, normalizedDensity ν k u (X,y)^k ∂unitBallLaw k
          ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (C_D*d*k))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.AllRadiiSphereMoment
head: def AllRadiiSphereMoment : Prop
text:
def AllRadiiSphereMoment : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 16 ≤ d →
      let k := d/4
      let β : ℝ := (d:ℝ)-1-k
      ∀ f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ≥0∞,
      Measurable f → (∀ s, f s ≤ 1) →
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K →
      AllBallMass (NoiselessRegression.ambientSphereLaw.withDensity f) K β →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ u : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Orthonormal ℝ u →
      let μ := sphereWeightedRestriction f (Metric.closedBall z R)
      Measurable (coordinateDensity μ k) ∧
      (∀ A : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Orthonormal ℝ A →
        (volume : Measure (Fin k → ℝ)).withDensity (fun y => coordinateDensity μ k (A,y)) =
          μ.map (coordinateMap A)) ∧
      (∀ A : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Orthonormal ℝ A →
        ∀ y : Fin k → ℝ, R < ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (y-coordinateMap A z)‖ →
          coordinateDensity μ k (A,y) = 0) ∧
      (∫⁻ A, ∫⁻ y : Fin k → ℝ, coordinateDensity μ k (A,y)^k ∂volume ∂frameLaw u) ^ (1/(k:ℝ)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C^d*(C*Real.sqrt d)^((k:ℝ)*(1-1/(k:ℝ)))*
          K*R^(β-(k:ℝ)*(1-1/(k:ℝ))))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.PositiveCapDomination
head: def PositiveCapDomination : Prop
text:
def PositiveCapDomination : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 32 ≤ d →
      let k := d/16
      let α : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      ∀ (c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖c‖ = 1 →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 → ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∀ K : Fin N → (Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) × Label k → ℝ≥0∞,
      (∀ j, Measurable (K j)) → (∀ z, ∑ j, K j z ≤ 1) →
      (∑ j, capReference (K j) c r) ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ j, ∃ D : CapDictionary c r α, ∃ a : D.I → ℝ,
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) ∧ Summable (fun i => a i*(r/D.radius i)^α) ∧
        (∑' i, a i*(r/D.radius i)^α) ≤ Real.exp (C*d)*(capReference (K j) c r).toReal^(1-1/(k:ℝ)) ∧
        (capMeasure c r).withDensity (capKernelValue (K j)) ≤
          Measure.sum (fun i => ENNReal.ofReal (a i) • capMeasure (D.center i) (D.radius i)) ∧
        (Measure.sum (fun i => ENNReal.ofReal (a i) • capMeasure (D.center i) (D.radius i))) Set.univ < ∞

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.DeterministicOffsetDensity
head: def DeterministicOffsetDensity : Prop
text:
def DeterministicOffsetDensity : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 16 ≤ d →
      let k := d/8
      let α : ℝ := (d:ℝ)/2
      ∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable h → (∀ s, h s ≤ 1) →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ →
      ∀ H : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), MeasurableSet H → H ⊆ Metric.closedBall z ρ →
      rieszPotential α h < ∞ ∧
      Measurable (lowerDensity (sphereWeightedRestriction h H) k) ∧
      (∀ A : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), LinearIndependent ℝ A →
        volume.withDensity (fun y => lowerDensity (sphereWeightedRestriction h H) k (A,y)) =
          (sphereWeightedRestriction h H).map (rowMap A)) ∧
      (∀ b : Label k, (∫⁻ A, (lowerDensity (sphereWeightedRestriction h H) k (A,rowMap A z+b))^k
          ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))))^(1/(k:ℝ)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C^d) * rieszPotential α h * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ^(α-k))) ∧
      (∀ A y, ‖rowMap A‖*ρ < ‖y-rowMap A z‖ →
        lowerDensity (sphereWeightedRestriction h H) k (A,y) = 0)

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.AllRadiiBlockBound
head: def AllRadiiBlockBound : Prop
text:
def AllRadiiBlockBound : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 16 ≤ d →
      let k := d/4
      let β : ℝ := (d:ℝ)-1-k
      ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ f : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ≥0∞,
      (∀ j, Measurable (f j)) → (∀ j s, f j s ≤ 1) →
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K →
      (∀ j, AllBallMass (NoiselessRegression.ambientSphereLaw.withDensity (f j)) K β) →
      ∀ Q : Fin N → (Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) × Label k → ℝ≥0∞,
      (∀ j, Measurable (Q j)) → (∀ z, ∑ j, Q j z ≤ 1) →
      AllBallMass (NoiselessRegression.ambientSphereLaw.withDensity (fractionalBlock Q f))
        (C^d*(N:ℝ)^(1/(k:ℝ))*K) β

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.HaarStreamingCost
head: def HaarStreamingCost : Prop
text:
def HaarStreamingCost : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ d M T : ℕ, 16 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      let k := d/4
      let Nstar : ℝ := ((k:ℝ)+2)*2^M
      seededSuccess K ρ ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C^d*ε^k*(C^d*Nstar^(1/(k:ℝ)))^((T+k-1)/k))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.RieszStreamingCost
head: def RieszStreamingCost : Prop
text:
def RieszStreamingCost : Prop :=
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ d M T : ℕ, 16 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      let q := d/8
      let W : ℝ := ((T:ℝ)+2)*2^M
      seededSuccess K ρ ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C₀^d*ε^((d:ℝ)/2-1)*(1+C₀^d*(1+Real.log (1/ε))*W^(1/(q:ℝ)))^((T+q-1)/q))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.CapFixedStoppingCost
head: def CapFixedStoppingCost : Prop
text:
def CapFixedStoppingCost : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d M T : ℕ, 32 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ T →
      let k := d/16
      let α : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      seededFixedSuccess K ρ ε t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.exp (C*d)*(ε/2)^α*(Real.exp (C*d)*(2:ℝ)^((M:ℝ)/k))^((t+k-1)/k))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.CapTotalStoppingCost
head: def CapTotalStoppingCost : Prop
text:
def CapTotalStoppingCost : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d M T : ℕ, 32 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      let k := d/16
      let α : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      seededSuccess K ρ ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (((T:ℝ)+1)*Real.exp (C*d)*(ε/2)^α*
          (Real.exp (C*d)*(2:ℝ)^((M:ℝ)/k))^((T+k-1)/k))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.CapFixedStoppingAsymptotic
head: def CapFixedStoppingAsymptotic : Prop
text:
def CapFixedStoppingAsymptotic : Prop :=
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d:ℝ)) (fun d => (d:ℝ)^2) →
      ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d (M d) T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ T →
      let k := d/16
      let α : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      seededFixedSuccess K ρ ε t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.exp (C*d*(1+((t+k-1)/k:ℕ)))*(ε/2)^α)

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.CapTotalStoppingAsymptotic
head: def CapTotalStoppingAsymptotic : Prop
text:
def CapTotalStoppingAsymptotic : Prop :=
    ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < C₁ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d:ℝ)) (fun d => (d:ℝ)^2) →
      ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d (M d) T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      seededSuccess K ρ ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (((T:ℝ)+1)*Real.exp (C₁*d+C₂*T-(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε)/3))

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.KernelModelBridge
head: def KernelModelBridge : Prop
text:
def KernelModelBridge : Prop :=
  ∀ d M T : ℕ, 3 ≤ d → ∀ K : FiniteKernelLearner d M T, K.CompletedRules →
    ∃ (ρ : Measure (Tape M T)) (L : Learner d M T (Tape M T)),
      IsProbabilityMeasure ρ ∧ L.MeasurableRules ∧ L.Admissible ρ ∧
      (∀ ε, L.uniformSuccess ρ ε = K.uniformSuccess ε) ∧
      (∀ ε t, L.uniformFixedSuccess ρ ε t = K.uniformFixedSuccess ε t)

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  IntegratedFrameMoment ∧ NormalizedUnitBallMoment ∧ AllRadiiSphereMoment ∧
  PositiveCapDomination ∧ DeterministicOffsetDensity ∧ AllRadiiBlockBound ∧
  HaarStreamingCost.{u} ∧ RieszStreamingCost.{u} ∧ CapFixedStoppingCost.{u} ∧
  CapTotalStoppingCost.{u} ∧ CapFixedStoppingAsymptotic.{u} ∧
  CapTotalStoppingAsymptotic.{u} ∧ KernelModelBridge ∧
  NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.SubquadraticMemoryWithPointwise.{u} ∧
  NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.FixedQuadraticMemory.{u}

name: OAI.RadialTransition.IsPackingDensity
head: def IsPackingDensity (p : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsPackingDensity (p : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun L : ℝ => (packingNumber L : ℝ) / L ^ 3) atTop (nhds p)

name: OAI.RadialTransition.IsBoundedPotential
head: def IsBoundedPotential (φ : Potential) : Prop
text:
def IsBoundedPotential (φ : Potential) : Prop :=
  ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ r : ℝ≥0, |φ r| ≤ M

name: OAI.RadialTransition.StableWith
head: def StableWith (φ : Potential) (B : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def StableWith (φ : Potential) (B : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : Fin N → Position), -(B * N) ≤ energy φ x

name: OAI.RadialTransition.AlgebraicDecayWith
head: def AlgebraicDecayWith (φ : Potential) (C : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def AlgebraicDecayWith (φ : Potential) (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ r : ℝ≥0, 1 ≤ r → |φ r| ≤ C * (r : ℝ) ^ (-(3 : ℝ) - 1 / 32)

name: OAI.RadialTransition.IsCanonicalFreeEnergy
head: def IsCanonicalFreeEnergy (φ : Potential) (ρ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsCanonicalFreeEnergy (φ : Potential) (ρ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β →
    Tendsto (fun L : ℝ =>
      -(Real.log (partition φ L ⌊ρ * L ^ 3⌋₊ β) / (β * L ^ 3)))
      atTop (nhds (f β))

name: OAI.RadialTransition.StrictTemperatureCorner
head: def StrictTemperatureCorner (f : ℝ → ℝ) (βc : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def StrictTemperatureCorner (f : ℝ → ℝ) (βc : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ dLeft dRight : ℝ,
    HasDerivWithinAt f dLeft (Iic βc) βc ∧
    HasDerivWithinAt f dRight (Ici βc) βc ∧
    dRight < dLeft ∧ ¬DifferentiableAt ℝ f βc

name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.SatisfiesClause
head: def SatisfiesClause {n k : ℕ} (σ : Assignment n) (C : ProperClause n k) : Prop
text:
def SatisfiesClause {n k : ℕ} (σ : Assignment n) (C : ProperClause n k) : Prop :=
  ∃ i : Fin n, C.val i = some (σ i)

name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.Satisfies
head: def Satisfies {n k m : ℕ} (σ : Assignment n) (F : Formula n k m) : Prop
text:
def Satisfies {n k m : ℕ} (σ : Assignment n) (F : Formula n k m) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, SatisfiesClause σ (F j)

name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.Satisfiable
head: def Satisfiable {n k m : ℕ} (F : Formula n k m) : Prop
text:
def Satisfiable {n k m : ℕ} (F : Formula n k m) : Prop :=
  ∃ σ : Assignment n, Satisfies σ F

name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.HasLimitingThreshold
head: def HasLimitingThreshold (k : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def HasLimitingThreshold (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧
    (∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → c < α →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => properSATProbability n k ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) ∧
    (∀ c : ℝ, α < c →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => properSATProbability n k ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

name: OAI.RandomKSAT.Satisfies
head: def Satisfies {n k : ℕ} (c : Clause n k) (a : Assignment n) : Prop
text:
def Satisfies {n k : ℕ} (c : Clause n k) (a : Assignment n) : Prop :=
  ∃ v : c.1.1, a v = c.2 v

name: OAI.RandomKSAT.PrefixSAT
head: def PrefixSAT {n k : ℕ} (ω : Stream n k) (m : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def PrefixSAT {n k : ℕ} (ω : Stream n k) (m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : Assignment n, ∀ i < m, Satisfies (ω i) a

name: OAI.SKGap.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement (β : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def MainStatement (β : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => disorderLaw β n (poincareEvent n C)) atTop (nhds 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => disorderLaw β n {g | 1 / (C * (n : ℝ)) ≤ discreteGap g})
      atTop (nhds 1)

name: OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.IsMinimizer
head: def IsMinimizer (W : BrownianSystem Ω) (γ : OrderParameter) : Prop
text:
def IsMinimizer (W : BrownianSystem Ω) (γ : OrderParameter) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : OrderParameter, parisi W γ ≤ parisi W η

name: OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.IsStieltjesMeasure
head: def IsStieltjesMeasure (γ : OrderParameter) (μ : Measure Time) : Prop
text:
def IsStieltjesMeasure (γ : OrderParameter) (μ : Measure Time) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : Time, μ (Set.Iic t) = ENNReal.ofReal (γ.val t)

name: OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.IsDiffusion
head:
def IsDiffusion (W : BrownianSystem Ω) (γ : OrderParameter)
    (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsDiffusion (W : BrownianSystem Ω) (γ : OrderParameter)
    (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsProgressive (Filtration.natural W.B (fun t => (W.measurable t).stronglyMeasurable)) X ∧
  (∀ᵐ ω ∂W.law, ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => X (Real.toNNReal t) ω) (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
    X 0 ω = 0 ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      X (Real.toNNReal t) ω = W.B (Real.toNNReal t) ω +
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, extend γ.val s *
          gradient W γ s (X (Real.toNNReal s) ω))

name: OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.FullSupportConclusion
head: def FullSupportConclusion (W : BrownianSystem Ω) (γ : OrderParameter) : Prop
text:
def FullSupportConclusion (W : BrownianSystem Ω) (γ : OrderParameter) : Prop :=
  (∃ μ : Measure Time, IsStieltjesMeasure γ μ) ∧
  (∃ X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ, IsDiffusion W γ X) ∧
  (∀ μ : Measure Time, IsStieltjesMeasure γ μ → μ.support = Set.univ) ∧
  (∀ a b : Time, a < b → γ.val a < γ.val b) ∧
  ∀ X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ, IsDiffusion W γ X → ∀ t : Time,
    squareMoment W γ X t = (t : ℝ) ∧
    (∫ ω, (curvature W γ t (X (Real.toNNReal t) ω))^2 ∂W.law) = 1

name: OAI.SKValue.Admissible
head: def Admissible (W : BrownianSpace) (t : ℝ) (α : ℝ≥0 → W.Ω → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def Admissible (W : BrownianSpace) (t : ℝ) (α : ℝ≥0 → W.Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsProgressive (shiftedFiltration W t) α ∧ ∀ s ω, |α s ω| ≤ 1

name: OAI.SKValue.IsMinimizer
head: def IsMinimizer (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter) : Prop
text:
def IsMinimizer (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : OrderParameter, parisi W γ ≤ parisi W η

name: OAI.SKValue.IsDiffusion
head: def IsDiffusion (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter) (X : ℝ → W.Ω → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def IsDiffusion (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter) (X : ℝ → W.Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Adapted W.filtration (fun t ω ↦ X (min (t : ℝ) 1) ω) ∧
  (∀ᵐ ω ∂W.μ, ContinuousOn (fun t ↦ X t ω) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      X t ω = W.B (Real.toNNReal t) ω +
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, γ.coeff s * gradient W γ s (X s ω))

name: OAI.SKValue.ScalarValueConclusion
head:
def ScalarValueConclusion (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter)
    (X : ℝ → W.Ω → ℝ) : Prop
text:
def ScalarValueConclusion (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter)
    (X : ℝ → W.Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto groundStateSequence atTop (𝓝 groundStateValue) ∧
  ∃ U : W.Ω → ℝ,
    Martingale (gradientStopped W γ X U) W.filtration W.μ ∧
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂W.μ, |U ω| ≤ 1 ∧ (U ω)^2 = 1 ∧
      Tendsto (fun t ↦ gradient W γ t (X t ω)) (𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (U ω))) ∧
    Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∫ ω, (gradient W γ t (X t ω) - U ω)^2 ∂W.μ)
      (𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) ∧
    groundStateValue = (∫ ω, |X 1 ω| ∂W.μ) - ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t * γ.coeff t ∧
    groundStateValue = ∫ ω, U ω * W.B 1 ω ∂W.μ ∧
    groundStateValue = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ ω, curvature W γ t (X t ω) ∂W.μ ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ ∫ ω, curvature W γ t (X t ω) ∂W.μ) volume 0 1

name: OAI.SKValue.FiniteGaussianConclusion
head:
def FiniteGaussianConclusion (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter)
    (X : ℝ → W.Ω → ℝ) (T : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def FiniteGaussianConclusion (W : BrownianSpace) (γ : OrderParameter)
    (X : ℝ → W.Ω → ℝ) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ᶠ N in atTop, ∀ j < N, 0 < normalizer W γ T N j) ∧
  Tendsto (shiftedCoefficientSum W γ T) atTop
    (𝓝 (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ∫ ω, curvature W γ t (X t ω) ∂W.μ)) ∧
  Tendsto (fun S ↦ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..S, ∫ ω, curvature W γ t (X t ω) ∂W.μ)
    (𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 groundStateValue)

name: OAI.SignedSweeps.SignedOccurrence
head:
def SignedOccurrence {u v l n : ℕ} (h : u + v + l = n)
    (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l) (lam : Partition n) : Prop
text:
def SignedOccurrence {u v l n : ℕ} (h : u + v + l = n)
    (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l) (lam : Partition n) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : ((Specht α ⊗[ℂ] Specht β.transpose) ⊗[ℂ] Specht γ) →ₗ[ℂ] Specht lam,
    Function.Injective f ∧
    ∀ (a : SymmetricGroup u) (b : SymmetricGroup v) (c : SymmetricGroup l) x,
      f (TensorProduct.map
        (TensorProduct.map (spechtRepresentation α a) (spechtRepresentation β.transpose b))
        (spechtRepresentation γ c) x) =
      spechtRepresentation lam (blockEmbedding h a b c) (f x)

name: OAI.SphericalPerceptron.SphericalLinearFieldFormula
head: def SphericalLinearFieldFormula : Prop
text:
def SphericalLinearFieldFormula : Prop :=
  (∀ (k : ℕ) (w : Fin (k+1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hw1 : ∑ i, w i=1),
    (∀ h : Fin (k+1) → ℝ, Monotone h → 0 ≤ h 0 →
      ∃ q : Fin (k+1) → Time, Monotone q ∧ (q (Fin.last k):ℝ) < 1 ∧
        IsLeast (finiteSphericalDualValues w h (fun i => (hw i).le) hw1)
          (finiteSphericalDualObjective w h (fun i => (hw i).le) hw1 q)) ∧
    (∀ K : Set (Fin (k+1) → ℝ), IsCompact K →
      (∀ h ∈ K, Monotone h ∧ 0 ≤ h 0) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n h => finiteSphericalFieldValue n k w h)
        (fun h => sInf (finiteSphericalDualValues w h (fun i => (hw i).le) hw1)) atTop K)) ∧
  (∀ (B : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (hB1 : B < 1) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (q : Time → Time) (hq : Monotone q),
      (∀ᵐ u ∂timeLaw, (q u:ℝ) ≤ B) →
      entropy (quantileTrial q) < ∞ ∧
      (∀ᵐ u ∂timeLaw, 2*stationaryQuantileField q hq B hB0 hB1 u=quantileA q (q u)) ∧
      |boundedSphericalFieldValue (stationaryQuantileField q hq B hB0 hB1) n-
        ((entropy (quantileTrial q)).toReal-
          ∫ u, stationaryQuantileField q hq B hB0 hB1 u*(q u:ℝ) ∂timeLaw)| < ε)

name: OAI.SphericalPerceptron.Progressive
head: def Progressive (P : Measure BrownianPath) (v : Time → BrownianPath → ℝ) : Prop

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.InvariantBinaryLaw
head:
def InvariantBinaryLaw {Γ : Type u_4} [Group Γ]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool)) : Prop
text:
def InvariantBinaryLaw {Γ : Type u_4} [Group Γ]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool)) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : Γ,
    Measure.map (leftTranslate g) (μ : Measure (Γ → Bool)) =
      (μ : Measure (Γ → Bool))

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.HasEquivariantIIDFactor
head:
def HasEquivariantIIDFactor {Γ : Type u_5} [Group Γ] [MeasurableSpace Γ]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool)) : Prop
text:
def HasEquivariantIIDFactor {Γ : Type u_5} [Group Γ] [MeasurableSpace Γ]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool)) : Prop :=
  ∃ Phi : (Γ → UnitLabel) → (Γ → Bool),
    Measurable Phi ∧
    (∀ (g : Γ) (u : Γ → UnitLabel),
      Phi (leftTranslate g u) = leftTranslate g (Phi u)) ∧
    Measure.map Phi (iidUnitLabels Γ) = (μ : Measure (Γ → Bool))

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.StronglyRayleighFinite
head:
def StronglyRayleighFinite {F : Type u_7} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) : Prop
text:
def StronglyRayleighFinite {F : Type u_7} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) : Prop :=
  ∀ z : F → ℂ, (∀ i : F, 0 < (z i).im) → finiteGeneratingValue μ z ≠ 0

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.StronglyRayleighCountable
head:
def StronglyRayleighCountable {I : Type u_10}
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool)) : Prop
text:
def StronglyRayleighCountable {I : Type u_10}
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool)) : Prop :=
  ∀ S : Finset I, ∀ z : S → ℂ,
    (∀ i : S, 0 < (z i).im) → marginalGeneratingValue μ S z ≠ 0

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.PositiveContractionFinite
head:
def PositiveContractionFinite {F : Type u_16} [Fintype F]
    (K : F → F → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def PositiveContractionFinite {F : Type u_16} [Fintype F]
    (K : F → F → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i j, K i j = conj (K j i)) ∧
  ∀ c : F → ℂ,
    0 ≤ (∑ i : F, ∑ j : F, conj (c i) * K i j * c j).re ∧
    (∑ i : F, ∑ j : F, conj (c i) * K i j * c j).re ≤
      ∑ i : F, Complex.normSq (c i)

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw
head:
def IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw {F : Type u_17} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) (K : F → F → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw {F : Type u_17} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) (K : F → F → ℂ) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact ∀ A : Finset F,
    (((μ : Measure (F → Bool)) {x | ∀ i ∈ A, x i = true}).toReal : ℂ) =
      Matrix.det (fun i j : A => K i.1 j.1)

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.PositiveContractionKernel
head:
def PositiveContractionKernel {I : Type u_18}
    (K : I → I → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def PositiveContractionKernel {I : Type u_18}
    (K : I → I → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i j, K i j = conj (K j i)) ∧
  ∀ (S : Finset I) (c : S → ℂ),
    0 ≤ (∑ i : S, ∑ j : S, conj (c i) * K i.1 j.1 * c j).re ∧
    (∑ i : S, ∑ j : S, conj (c i) * K i.1 j.1 * c j).re ≤
      ∑ i : S, Complex.normSq (c i)

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.IsDeterminantalLaw
head:
def IsDeterminantalLaw {I : Type u_19}
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool)) (K : I → I → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def IsDeterminantalLaw {I : Type u_19}
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool)) (K : I → I → ℂ) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact ∀ A : Finset I,
    (((μ : Measure (I → Bool)) {x | ∀ i ∈ A, x i = true}).toReal : ℂ) =
      Matrix.det (fun i j : A => K i.1 j.1)

name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.TranslationInvariantKernel
head:
def TranslationInvariantKernel {Γ : Type u_20} [Group Γ]
    (K : Γ → Γ → ℂ) : Prop
text:
def TranslationInvariantKernel {Γ : Type u_20} [Group Γ]
    (K : Γ → Γ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ g h k : Γ, K (g * h) (g * k) = K h k

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.KernelLearner.CompletedRules
head: def CompletedRules {d M T : ℕ} (L : KernelLearner d M T) : Prop
text:
def CompletedRules {d M T : ℕ} (L : KernelLearner d M T) : Prop :=
  ∀ t q dest, AEMeasurable (fun obs => L.transition t q obs dest) (observationReference d)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.ExplicitPrecision
head: def ExplicitPrecision : Prop
text:
def ExplicitPrecision : Prop :=
  ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d : ℝ)) (fun d => (d : ℝ) ^ 2) →
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
    0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : SeededLearner d (M d) T Ω, L.Admissible ρ →
    ((2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε ∨
      ∀ s, (2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.success ρ ε s) →
    (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 16 * (d : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (1 / ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.RadiusWeightedFullEstimate
head: def RadiusWeightedFullEstimate : Prop
text:
def RadiusWeightedFullEstimate : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    (∀ W : ℝ, 1 ≤ W → ∀ (V : Type v) [Fintype V] [Nonempty V],
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ W →
      ∀ κ : V → Observation d (d/16) → ℝ≥0∞,
      (∀ v, Measurable (κ v)) → (∀ obs, ∑ v, κ v obs ≤ 1) →
      ∀ g : V → Sphere d → ℝ≥0∞,
      (∀ v, Measurable (g v)) → (∀ v s, g v s ≤ 1) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, (d : ℝ)/2 ≤ n → n ≤ d →
      norm d n (blockInput κ g) ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal W)^(1/((d/16 : ℕ) : ℝ))*ENNReal.ofReal (C^d)*(⨆ v, norm d (n-2) (g v))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, (d : ℝ)/2 ≤ n → n ≤ d →
      ∀ π : Measure (Sphere d), IsProbabilityMeasure π →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      norm d n (terminalInput π ε) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C^d)*(ENNReal.ofReal ε)^((d : ℝ)/16))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.HalfPrecision
head: def HalfPrecision : Prop
text:
def HalfPrecision : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d : ℝ)) (fun d => (d : ℝ)^2) →
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
    0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : SeededLearner d (M d) T Ω, L.Admissible ρ →
    (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε →
    c * (d : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (1/ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.BorelRules
head: def BorelRules (L : Stream E J T) : Prop
text:
def BorelRules (L : Stream E J T) : Prop :=
  ∀ n q a, Measurable (fun obs => L.transition n q obs a)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.DimensionEstimate
head: def DimensionEstimate : Prop
text:
def DimensionEstimate : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 2 ≤ C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ j m : ℕ,
    (d : ℝ)/2 + 2*j ≤ m → m ≤ d →
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : Ω → Stream (Vector m) (Fin (2^(d^2))) (j*(d/32)),
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂ρ, (L ω).BorelRules) →
    AEMeasurable (fun z : Sphere (Vector m) × (Ω × (Fin (j*(d/32)) → Vector m)) =>
      (L z.2.1).euclideanSuccess η z.1.val z.2.2)
      ((sphereLaw (Vector m)).prod (ρ.prod (rowsLaw (Vector m) (j*(d/32))))) →
    (∫⁻ z : Sphere (Vector m) × (Ω × (Fin (j*(d/32)) → Vector m)),
      (L z.2.1).euclideanSuccess η z.1.val z.2.2
        ∂(sphereLaw (Vector m)).prod (ρ.prod (rowsLaw (Vector m) (j*(d/32)))))
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((C^(j+1)*η)^((d : ℝ)/32))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Affine.AllAffineFullEstimate
head: def AllAffineFullEstimate : Prop
text:
def AllAffineFullEstimate : Prop :=
  ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ k : ℕ,
    (d+1)/2 + 2*k ≤ d → ∀ W : ℝ, 1 ≤ W →
    ∀ (J : Type v) [Fintype J] [Nonempty J] [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSingletonClass J],
    (Fintype.card J : ℝ) ≤ W → W^(1/((d/8 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^d →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : Ω → Fixed.Stream (Vector d) J (k*(d/16)),
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂ρ, (L ω).BorelRules ∧ ∀ q, ∀ᵐ y ∂(L ω).output q, ‖y‖ = 1) →
    ∀ ell : ℕ, ell ≤ k → ∀ v : J, ∀ n : ℕ, (d+1)/2 + 2*ell ≤ n →
    ∀ A : Test d n,
    (∫⁻ z : Sphere A.space × (Ω × (Fin (ell*(d/16)) → Vector d)),
      ((L z.2.1).suffix ((k-ell)*(d/16)) (ell*(d/16)) v).angularSuccess ε (A.point z.1) z.2.2
        ∂(sphereLaw A.space).prod (ρ.prod (Fixed.rowsLaw (Vector d) (ell*(d/16)))))
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((16 * ((1000 : ℝ)^32)^ell * ε)/A.radius)^(2*(d/32)))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.MixtureEstimate
head:
def MixtureEstimate (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] : Prop
text:
def MixtureEstimate (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] : Prop :=
  (∀ (V N : Submodule ℝ E), V ≤ N → 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V →
    Module.finrank ℝ V < Module.finrank ℝ N → Module.finrank ℝ N < Module.finrank ℝ E →
    ∀ e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1,
    directionLaw V N ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E •
      (SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw + latitudeLaw V e
        (((Module.finrank ℝ N : ℝ)-(Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ))/2)
        (((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)-(Module.finrank ℝ N : ℝ))/2))) ∧
  (∀ N : Submodule ℝ E, 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ N →
    directionLaw ⊥ N = SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw) ∧
  (∀ (V : Submodule ℝ E) (t : ℕ), 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E →
    directionJointLaw V ⊤ t =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin t => SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.CurrentMainScope
head: def CurrentMainScope : Prop
text:
def CurrentMainScope : Prop :=
  ExplicitPrecision.{u} ∧
  Weighted.RadiusWeightedFullEstimate.{v} ∧
  HalfPrecision.{u} ∧
  Affine.AllAffineFullEstimate.{u,v} ∧
  Fixed.DimensionEstimate.{u} ∧
  (∀ (E : Type w) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E], Mixture.MixtureEstimate E)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.SubquadraticMemory
head: def SubquadraticMemory : Prop
text:
def SubquadraticMemory : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d : ℝ)) (fun d => (d : ℝ) ^ 2) →
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
    0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : Learner d (M d) T Ω, L.Admissible ρ →
    ((2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε ∨
      ∀ s, (2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.success ρ ε s) →
    c * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1 / ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.FixedQuadraticMemory
head: def FixedQuadraticMemory : Prop
text:
def FixedQuadraticMemory : Prop :=
  ∀ A₀ : ℝ, 0 < A₀ → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ,
    ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ M T : ℕ, (M : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : Learner d M T Ω, L.Admissible ρ →
    (2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε →
    c * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1 / ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.WeightedCompatibilityTheorem
head: def WeightedCompatibilityTheorem : Prop
text:
def WeightedCompatibilityTheorem : Prop :=
  ∃ L C₀ m₀ : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < C₀ ∧ 0 < m₀ ∧
    ∀ A D : ℕ,
    let n : ℝ := A * D
    let m := Real.sqrt n
    let θ := 1 - L / Real.log m
    m₀ ≤ m → 0 < θ → m / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ A → (A : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * m →
    m / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ D → (D : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * m →
    ∀ (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
      (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ),
    (∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) → (∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ) →
    weightedCompatibility A D w v ≤
      Real.exp (C₀ * n ^ (((54 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((100 : ℕ) : ℝ))) *
        (∏ i, marginalFactor θ (w i)) * (∏ k, marginalFactor θ (v k))

name: OAI.ThorpNine.Casimir.Thorp.CasimirBounds.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=

    (∀ d k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 2^d → ∀ x : Fin k ↪ Card d,
      (palindromeRowMoment d x (1/64))^(64/65:ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (C*levelScale (2^d) k)) ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ) (μ : YoungDiagram) (e : Card d ≃ Specht.Cell μ),
      0 < μ.card-μ.rowLen 0 →
        ‖K d μ e‖ ≤ Real.exp (-a*levelScale (2^d) (μ.card-μ.rowLen 0)) ∧
        (Module.finrank ℂ (Specht.space μ):ℝ) * traceMoment d μ e 65 ≤
          Real.exp (C*levelScale (2^d) (μ.card-μ.rowLen 0))) ∧
    (∃ l : ℕ, 0 < l ∧ ∀ starts : (d : ℕ) → Equiv.Perm (Card d),
      Tendsto (fun d => fromDistance d (l*d) (starts d)) atTop (nhds 0))

name: OAI.ThorpNine.Contact.Thorp.SparseContact.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:

  ∃ Cstar C : ℝ, 0 < Cstar ∧ 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (d : ℕ), 1 ≤ d → ∀ (μ : YoungDiagram) (e : Card d ≃ Specht.Cell μ),
      let k := μ.card - μ.rowLen 0
      1 ≤ k → k < 2^d → ∀ reverse : Bool,
        ‖sweepOperator d μ e reverse‖^2 ≤
          min 1 ((Cstar * d * k / (2:ℝ)^d) ^ ((k:ℝ)/2)) ∧
        (k = 1 → sweepOperator d μ e reverse = 0) ∧
        ‖sweepOperator d μ e reverse‖^2 ≤
          C^k * (1+(d:ℝ))^(C*k) * ((k:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^d)^((k:ℝ)/2)

name: OAI.ThorpNine.Harmonic.Thorp.HarmonicBounds.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ c C ζ δ cTail c₁ c₂ : ℝ, ∃ p₀ : ℕ,
    0<c ∧ 0<C ∧ 0<ζ ∧ 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<cTail ∧ 0<c₁ ∧ 0<c₂ ∧ 0<p₀ ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ) (μ : YoungDiagram) (e : Card d ≃ Specht.Cell μ),
      0<μ.card-μ.rowLen 0 →
      let L := levelScale (2^d) (μ.card-μ.rowLen 0)
      let f : ℝ := Module.finrank ℂ (Specht.space (tail μ))
      let D : ℝ := Module.finrank ℂ (Specht.space μ)
      W d μ e ≤ Real.exp (-c*L) ∧
      W d μ e ≤ Real.exp (C*L)*f^(-ζ) ∧
      (∀ rev : Bool, ‖SparseContact.sweepOperator d μ e rev‖ ≤
        Real.exp (-cTail*(L+Real.log f))) ∧
      W d μ e ≤ Real.exp (-c₁*L)*D^(-c₂)) ∧
    (∀ d k : ℕ, 1≤k → k≤2^d → ∀ (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (rev : Bool),
      (∀ x : Tuples d k,
        finiteMean (fun y => ((Fintype.card (Tuples d k):ℝ)*
          reflectedKernel d k order rev x y)^(1+δ)) ≤
        Real.exp (C*levelScale (2^d) k)) ∧
      tupleTrace d k order rev p₀ ≤ Real.exp (C*levelScale (2^d) k))

name: OAI.ThorpNine.HighTail.Thorp.HighHeight.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ b δ C : ℝ, 0<b ∧ 0<δ ∧ 0<C ∧ ∃ J₀ : ℕ, 1≤J₀ ∧
    (∀ d k : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin k ↪ Card d, ∀ J : ℕ, J₀≤J →
      Real.log (finiteMean (fun ω : BenesCoins d => ((2:ℝ)^b)^(highCost J d x ω)))/Real.log 2 ≤
        C*k*(2:ℝ)^(-b*J)) ∧
    (∀ d k : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin k ↪ Card d,
      Real.log (finiteMean (fun ω : BenesCoins d => ((2:ℝ)^b)^(palindromeCost d x ω)))/Real.log 2 ≤
        C*k*((k:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^d)^δ) ∧
    (∀ r s k : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin k ↪ Card (s+r), ∀ J : ℕ, J₀≤J → 2*s<J →
      ∀ (X : SwitchIndex (s+r) → Bool) (lo : Card r × SwitchIndex s → Bool),
      Real.log (finiteMean (fun hi : Card s × SwitchIndex r → Bool =>
        ((2:ℝ)^b)^(highCost J (s+r) x (assembleBits r s lo hi,X))))/Real.log 2 ≤
          C*k*(2:ℝ)^(-b*J))

name: OAI.ThorpNine.Smoothing.Thorp.StrongSmoothing.MainStatement

      ∀ x y : Tuples d l,

name: OAI.ThorpNine.SparseSaving.Thorp.SparseRegime.MainStatement
head: def MainStatement : Prop
text:

      let k := μ.card - μ.rowLen 0
      1 ≤ k → k < 2^d → (d:ℝ)^((3:ℝ)/4) ≤ Real.log ((2:ℝ)^d/k) →

name: OAI.ThorpNine.Tail.Thorp.StrongTail.DensityAt
head: def DensityAt (p C : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def DensityAt (p C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d l : ℕ), l ≤ 2^d → ∀ (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (rev : Bool)
    (x : StrongSmoothing.Tuples d l),
    let H := StrongSmoothing.reflectedKernel d l order rev
    (Thorp.finiteMean (fun y => ((Fintype.card (StrongSmoothing.Tuples d l):ℝ)*H x y)^p)
      ≤ Real.exp (C*l)) ∧
    (Thorp.finiteMean (fun y => ((Fintype.card (StrongSmoothing.Tuples d l):ℝ)*H y x)^p)
      ≤ Real.exp (C*l)) ∧
    (((2:ℝ)^d)^l)⁻¹ * (∑ y, ((((2:ℝ)^d)^l)*H x y)^p) ≤ Real.exp (C*l) ∧
    (((2:ℝ)^d)^l)⁻¹ * (∑ y, ((((2:ℝ)^d)^l)*H y x)^p) ≤ Real.exp (C*l)

name: OAI.Problem346.IsFoulkesMap
head:
def IsFoulkesMap (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V)) : Prop
text:
def IsFoulkesMap (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V)) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Fin b → Fin a → V,
    μ (symMonomial b (SymPow a V) (fun j => symMonomial a V (v j))) =
      foulkesFormula a b V v

name: OAI.Problem346.IsPlethysmAction
head:
def IsPlethysmAction (outer inner : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (L : SymPow outer (SymPow inner V) →ₗ[ℂ]
      SymPow outer (SymPow inner V)) : Prop
text:
def IsPlethysmAction (outer inner : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (L : SymPow outer (SymPow inner V) →ₗ[ℂ]
      SymPow outer (SymPow inner V)) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Fin outer → Fin inner → V,
    L (symMonomial outer (SymPow inner V)
        (fun i => symMonomial inner V (v i))) =
      symMonomial outer (SymPow inner V)
        (fun i => symMonomial inner V (fun j => g (v i j)))

name: OAI.Problem346.IsGLEquivariantEmbedding
text:
def IsGLEquivariantEmbedding (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (ι : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b (SymPow a V)) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective ι ∧
    ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V,
      ∃ Lsource : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b (SymPow a V),
      ∃ Ltarget : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
        IsPlethysmAction b a V g Lsource ∧
        IsPlethysmAction a b V g Ltarget ∧
        Function.Bijective Lsource ∧
        Function.Bijective Ltarget ∧
        Lsource.comp ι = ι.comp Ltarget

name: OAI.Problem346.IsSymmetricMultilinearForm
text:
def IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V) : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (x : Fin a → SymPow b V),
    T (fun i => x (σ i)) = T x

name: OAI.KLInvariance.BruhatStep

def BruhatStep (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (x y : W) : Prop :=

def IsUnitary {G V : Type*} [Group G] [NormedAddCommGroup V]

text:
def IsUnitary {G V : Type*} [Group G] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ V] (ρ : Representation ℂ G V) : Prop :=
  ∀ g x y, inner ℂ (ρ g x) (ρ g y) = inner ℂ x y

name: OAI.PartialPermutation.LeftCosetCap
head:
def LeftCosetCap {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    (f : G → ℝ) (H : Subgroup G) (B : ℝ) : Prop
text:
def LeftCosetCap {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    (f : G → ℝ) (H : Subgroup G) (B : ℝ) : Prop :=
  by classical exact ∀ g, ∑ h : H, f (g * h) ≤ B / H.index

name: OAI.PartialPermutation.ComplementaryCosetsFiniteStatement
head: def ComplementaryCosetsFiniteStatement : Prop
text:
def ComplementaryCosetsFiniteStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : Type*) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (b : ℕ) (_ : 0 < b) (M : Fin b → Set X),
    (∀ i, (M i).Nonempty) →
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (M i) (M j)) → (⋃ i, M i) = Set.univ →
    ∀ (V : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ V]
      [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (ρ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V),
      Representation.IsIrreducible ρ → IsUnitary ρ →
      ∀ (f : Equiv.Perm X → ℝ) (B u : ℝ),
      (∀ g, 0 ≤ f g) → mass f ≤ 1 → 0 < u →
      (∀ i, LeftCosetCap f (blockSubgroup (M i)) B) →
      (hsNormSq (complexFourier ρ (fun g => f g)) ≤
        b * B * symmetricDegreeConstant u *
          (Module.finrank ℂ V : ℝ)^(-1+(u+2)/(b : ℝ))) ∧
      (‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (complexFourier ρ (fun g => f g))‖^2 ≤
        b * B * symmetricDegreeConstant u *
          (Module.finrank ℂ V : ℝ)^(-1+(u+2)/(b : ℝ)))

name: OAI.PartitionPilot.Forcing.SetFormula.SeparationSchema
head: def SeparationSchema (U : Set ZFSet.{u}) : Prop
text:
def SeparationSchema (U : Set ZFSet.{u}) : Prop :=
  ∀ {n} (φ : SetFormula (n + 1)) (params : Fin n → ZFSet.{u}),
    (∀ i, params i ∈ U) → ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ y ∈ U,
      ∀ z ∈ U, z ∈ y ↔ z ∈ x ∧ Realize U φ (extend z params)

name: OAI.PartitionPilot.Forcing.SetFormula.CollectionSchema

text:
def CollectionSchema (U : Set ZFSet.{u}) : Prop :=
  ∀ {n} (φ : SetFormula (n + 2)) (params : Fin n → ZFSet.{u}),
    (∀ i, params i ∈ U) → ∀ a ∈ U,
      (∀ x ∈ U, x ∈ a → ∃ y ∈ U, Realize U φ (extend x (extend y params))) →
      ∃ b ∈ U, ∀ x ∈ U, x ∈ a →
        ∃ y ∈ U, y ∈ b ∧ Realize U φ (extend x (extend y params))

name: OAI.PartitionPilot.Forcing.SetFormula.ReplacementSchema
head: def ReplacementSchema (U : Set ZFSet.{u}) : Prop
text:
def ReplacementSchema (U : Set ZFSet.{u}) : Prop :=
  ∀ {n} (φ : SetFormula (n + 2)) (params : Fin n → ZFSet.{u}),
    (∀ i, params i ∈ U) → ∀ A ∈ U,
      (∀ x ∈ U, x ∈ A → ∃ y ∈ U, Realize U φ (extend x (extend y params)) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ U, Realize U φ (extend x (extend z params)) → z = y) →
      ∃ B ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, y ∈ B ↔ ∃ x ∈ U, x ∈ A ∧ Realize U φ (extend x (extend y params))

name: OAI.PartitionPilot.Forcing.SetFormula.ZFRealization

name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.IsSpherical

name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.LiftedFace
head: def LiftedFace (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (a b : LiftedCell M) : Prop
text:
def LiftedFace (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (a b : LiftedCell M) : Prop :=
  a.2.1 ⊆ b.2.1 ∧ ∃ w : List S,
    (∀ s ∈ w, s ∈ b.2.1) ∧
    M.toCoxeterSystem.length (wordCoxeter M w) = w.length ∧
    (∀ v : coxeterParabolic M a.2.1,
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (wordCoxeter M w) ≤
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (wordCoxeter M w * v)) ∧
    a.1 = b.1 * wordArtin M w

name: OAI.EilenbergGanea.HasClassifyingSpace
doc: Ordinary K(G,1) of dimension at most n. The cell and space types have no finiteness or countability restriction. The contractible surjective covering is the usual universal-cover characterization of a classifying space.
head: def HasClassifyingSpace (G : Type*) [Group G] (n : ℕ) : Prop
text:
def HasClassifyingSpace (G : Type*) [Group G] (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (X : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace X) (_ : T2Space X)
    (_ : Topology.CWComplex (Set.univ : Set X)),
    (∀ k : ℕ, n < k → IsEmpty (Topology.CWComplex.cell (Set.univ : Set X) k)) ∧
    PathConnectedSpace X ∧
    ∃ x : X, Nonempty (FundamentalGroup X x ≃* G) ∧
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace E), ContractibleSpace E ∧
    ∃ p : E → X, IsCoveringMap p ∧ Function.Surjective p
